questions.question_text: What Ministry position did Rufus Scrimgeour hold before becoming Minister for Magic?
questions.correct_answer: Head of the Department of Magical Law Enforcement
distractors: Head of the Department of Mysteries
Head Auror trainer only, with no departmental role
Head of the Department of International Magical Cooperation
questions.explanation: Before becoming Minister, Scrimgeour headed the Department of Magical Law Enforcement.

questions.question_text: What is the name of Ron Weasley's pet rat, later revealed to be Peter Pettigrew in disguise?
questions.explanation: Ron's rat Scabbers is eventually revealed to be Peter Pettigrew, an unregistered Animagus hiding from justice.

questions.question_text: What is the name of Neville Longbottom's toad, which he is constantly losing?
questions.explanation: Neville's toad Trevor is a recurring source of trouble, as Neville frequently misplaces him.

questions.question_text: What species of owl is Harry Potter's owl Hedwig?
questions.explanation: Hedwig is a snowy owl, given to Harry by Hagrid as a birthday gift before his first year.

questions.question_text: What is the name of Hagrid's large, cowardly boarhound dog?
questions.explanation: Fang is Hagrid's dog, who despite his fearsome appearance is quite timid.

questions.question_text: What is the name of the three-headed dog Hagrid keeps to guard the Philosopher's Stone?
questions.explanation: Fluffy is the enormous three-headed dog Hagrid acquired to help guard the trapdoor to the Stone.

questions.question_text: Which Hogwarts house does Percy Weasley belong to?
questions.explanation: Percy Weasley, like all of his siblings, is sorted into Gryffindor.

questions.question_text: What is the name of Hermione Granger's ginger, bandy-legged cat?
questions.explanation: Hermione buys Crookshanks in Diagon Alley in her third year; he later proves suspicious of Scabbers.

questions.question_text: Where does Arthur Weasley work at the Ministry of Magic?
questions.correct_answer: The Misuse of Muggle Artifacts Office
distractors: The Department of International Magical Cooperation
The Department of Magical Law Enforcement
questions.explanation: Arthur Weasley works in the Misuse of Muggle Artifacts Office, fitting his fascination with Muggle objects.

questions.question_text: What is Dudley Dursley's favorite hobby, at which he even competes?
questions.explanation: Dudley Dursley takes up boxing, and his parents are enormously proud of his amateur bouts.

questions.question_text: What model of car do the Weasleys own that famously flies to Hogwarts in Chamber of Secrets?
questions.explanation: Arthur Weasley's enchanted, flying Ford Anglia carries Ron and Harry to Hogwarts after they miss the train.

questions.question_text: Who arranges for Harry to receive a Nimbus 2000 broomstick after spotting his natural flying talent in his first year?
questions.explanation: McGonagall breaks the first-year no-broomsticks rule to get Harry a Nimbus 2000 and a spot on the Quidditch team.

questions.question_text: Which professor teaches Potions and serves as Head of Slytherin House during Harry's early years?
questions.explanation: Severus Snape teaches Potions and heads Slytherin House for most of the series.

questions.question_text: What subject does Professor Quirrell teach during Harry's first year?
questions.explanation: Quirinus Quirrell teaches Defense Against the Dark Arts, secretly sharing his body with Voldemort.

questions.question_text: Which Hogwarts house's ghost is known as "Nearly Headless Nick"?
questions.explanation: Sir Nicholas, nicknamed Nearly Headless Nick, is the resident ghost of Gryffindor House.

questions.question_text: What is the name of the Hufflepuff house ghost?
questions.explanation: The Fat Friar is the jovial ghost associated with Hufflepuff House.

questions.question_text: What is the name of the mischievous poltergeist who torments students and staff throughout Hogwarts?
questions.explanation: Peeves is a poltergeist, not a ghost, known for pranks like dropping objects on students' heads.

questions.question_text: What is the name of the giant, ancient spider that Hagrid raised and considers a friend?
questions.explanation: Aragog is an Acromantula that Hagrid raised secretly since his own school days.

questions.question_text: What are the names of Draco Malfoy's two large, loyal henchmen at Hogwarts?
questions.explanation: Vincent Crabbe and Gregory Goyle serve as Draco Malfoy's constant companions and enforcers.

questions.question_text: Which Hogwarts house's ghost is the sinister Bloody Baron?
questions.explanation: The Bloody Baron, covered in silver bloodstains, is the ghost of Slytherin House.

questions.question_text: What position does Cedric Diggory play on the Hufflepuff Quidditch team?
questions.explanation: Cedric Diggory is Hufflepuff's Seeker, famously beating Harry fairly in a Quidditch match during a storm.

questions.question_text: Who is the caretaker who patrols Hogwarts's corridors searching for rule-breaking students?
questions.explanation: Argus Filch is the Hogwarts caretaker, notorious for his hatred of students and love of punishments.

questions.question_text: What kind of magical creature is Buckbeak, cared for by Hagrid?
questions.explanation: Buckbeak is a proud hippogriff, part eagle and part horse, introduced in Care of Magical Creatures class.

questions.question_text: Who first takes Harry to Diagon Alley to buy his school supplies before his first year?
questions.explanation: Hagrid escorts Harry to Diagon Alley, introducing him to the wizarding world's shops and Gringotts.

questions.question_text: What is the name of Albus Dumbledore's phoenix?
questions.explanation: Fawkes is Dumbledore's loyal phoenix companion, known for his healing tears and fiery rebirths.

questions.question_text: Who is the youngest Weasley sibling, and the only girl among them?
questions.explanation: Ginny Weasley is the youngest of the Weasley children and their only daughter.

questions.question_text: What is the name of the tiny owl Ron receives to replace Scabbers?
questions.explanation: Pigwidgeon, an excitable miniature owl, is a gift from Sirius Black to Ron.

questions.question_text: What magical item does Neville's grandmother send him so he can check whether he's forgotten something?
questions.explanation: Neville receives a Remembrall, a glass ball that glows red when its owner has forgotten something.

questions.question_text: Which professor teaches Transfiguration and serves as Head of Gryffindor House?
questions.explanation: Minerva McGonagall teaches Transfiguration and leads Gryffindor House throughout the series.

questions.question_text: What is the name of Harry's cousin, with whom he grows up at Privet Drive?
questions.explanation: Dudley Dursley is Harry's spoiled cousin, the son of Vernon and Petunia.

questions.question_text: Where do the Dursleys make Harry sleep for much of his childhood before Hogwarts?
questions.explanation: Harry is forced to sleep in the cramped cupboard under the stairs at 4 Privet Drive.

questions.question_text: Who serves as the Minister for Magic during Harry's first several years at Hogwarts?
questions.explanation: Cornelius Fudge is Minister for Magic through Harry's early years, until he is replaced in Half-Blood Prince.

questions.question_text: What is Hagrid's official title at Hogwarts before he becomes a professor?
questions.explanation: Hagrid serves Hogwarts as Keeper of Keys and Grounds, later also teaching Care of Magical Creatures.

questions.question_text: Whose Invisibility Cloak does Harry inherit before his first Christmas at Hogwarts?
questions.explanation: Dumbledore returns James Potter's old Invisibility Cloak to Harry as a Christmas gift.

questions.question_text: Which two Weasley brothers are famous for their pranks and later open a joke shop?
questions.explanation: Fred and George Weasley, the mischievous twins, eventually found Weasley's Wizard Wheezes.

questions.question_text: What special position does Percy Weasley already hold when Harry begins his first year?
questions.explanation: Percy is a Gryffindor prefect during Harry's first year, a role he takes very seriously.

questions.question_text: Who is the brightest witch of her year and one of Harry's two closest friends?
questions.explanation: Hermione Granger quickly proves herself the top student of her year and becomes Harry's close friend.

questions.question_text: What rare magical ability does Harry discover he shares with Voldemort, allowing him to talk to snakes?
questions.explanation: Harry can speak Parseltongue, the language of snakes, an ability he unknowingly inherited a trace of from Voldemort.

questions.question_text: Which professor is revealed to be secretly sharing his body with Voldemort at the end of Harry's first year?
questions.explanation: Quirrell hides Voldemort's weakened spirit under his turban, attached to the back of his head.

questions.question_text: Which Hogwarts house were both of Harry's parents, James and Lily Potter, sorted into?
distractors: James in Gryffindor, Lily in Ravenclaw
questions.explanation: Both James and Lily Potter were Gryffindors during their time at Hogwarts.

questions.question_text: Which ghostly professor teaches History of Magic, having taught the subject even after his death?
questions.explanation: Cuthbert Binns is the only ghost who teaches at Hogwarts, droning on in History of Magic.

questions.question_text: Who teaches Divination at Hogwarts, predicting doom with unsettling frequency?
questions.explanation: Sybill Trelawney is the eccentric Divination professor, famous for predicting Harry's death repeatedly.

questions.question_text: Whose flying motorbike does Hagrid borrow to deliver baby Harry to Privet Drive?
questions.explanation: Hagrid arrives at Privet Drive on Sirius Black's flying motorbike, which Sirius lends him on the night of the Potters' deaths.

questions.question_text: Which Weasley brother works as a curse-breaker for Gringotts Bank in Egypt?
questions.explanation: Bill Weasley works overseas as a curse-breaker for Gringotts before returning to Britain.

questions.question_text: What is the name of the village where Harry was born and where his parents are buried?
questions.explanation: Godric's Hollow is the Potters' former home and the site of James and Lily's graves.

questions.question_text: Which Weasley twin ultimately dies during the Battle of Hogwarts?
questions.explanation: Fred Weasley is killed by an explosion during the Battle of Hogwarts, devastating his family.

questions.question_text: Which Weasley twin loses an ear during the Battle of the Seven Potters?
questions.explanation: George loses an ear to a curse from Snape (deflecting Sectumsempra) during the escape from Privet Drive.

questions.question_text: What is the name of the bitter house-elf who serves the Black family at Grimmauld Place?
questions.explanation: Kreacher is the Black family's house-elf, initially hostile to Sirius and Harry before his loyalty shifts.

questions.question_text: Which house-elf does Harry free from the Malfoy family using a sock hidden in a book?
questions.explanation: Harry tricks Lucius Malfoy into handing Dobby a sock, which frees him from servitude.

questions.question_text: Which house-elf, once serving the Crouch family, is freed and later found working in the Hogwarts kitchens?
questions.explanation: Winky is freed by Barty Crouch Sr. after the Dark Mark incident at the Quidditch World Cup and struggles with her freedom.

questions.question_text: What distinguishing feature does the retired Auror Alastor "Mad-Eye" Moody have, letting him see in all directions?
questions.explanation: Moody's magical eye can rotate 360 degrees and see through solid objects, including invisibility cloaks.

questions.question_text: Which Order of the Phoenix member and Auror eventually becomes Minister for Magic after the war?
questions.explanation: Kingsley Shacklebolt, a skilled Auror and Order member, becomes Minister for Magic following Voldemort's defeat.

questions.question_text: Which Triwizard champion represents Beauxbatons Academy?
questions.explanation: Fleur Delacour is selected as the Beauxbatons champion for the Triwizard Tournament.

questions.question_text: Which Triwizard champion is also the star Seeker of the Bulgarian national Quidditch team?
questions.explanation: Viktor Krum represents Durmstrang in the tournament and is famous across the wizarding world for his Quidditch skill.

questions.question_text: Who is the imposing headmistress of Beauxbatons Academy of Magic during the Triwizard Tournament?
questions.explanation: Madame Maxime, part-giantess like Hagrid, leads the Beauxbatons delegation to Hogwarts.

questions.question_text: Which senior Ministry official, Head of Magical Law Enforcement, is murdered by Voldemort personally?
questions.explanation: Amelia Bones, Susan Bones's aunt, is killed by Voldemort himself, a death that deeply unsettles the wizarding world.

questions.question_text: Who is Head of the Department of Magical Games and Sports and organizes the Triwizard Tournament and Quidditch World Cup?
questions.explanation: Ludo Bagman oversees magical sports and games, including the World Cup and Triwizard Tournament.

questions.question_text: Which Ravenclaw student betrays the existence of Dumbledore's Army to Dolores Umbridge?
questions.explanation: Marietta Edgecombe tells Umbridge about the D.A. and is left with a curse spelling "SNEAK" in pimples across her face.

questions.question_text: Which Hufflepuff member of Dumbledore's Army is notably arrogant and skeptical of Harry at first?
questions.explanation: Zacharias Smith repeatedly questions Harry's credibility during early D.A. meetings.

questions.question_text: Which Hufflepuff student, a member of the D.A., is the niece of Amelia Bones?
questions.explanation: Susan Bones is a Hufflepuff student and the niece of Amelia Bones, Head of Magical Law Enforcement.

questions.question_text: Which Hufflepuff student marries Neville Longbottom, according to later canon accounts?
questions.explanation: Hannah Abbott, a Hufflepuff classmate, later marries Neville Longbottom.

questions.question_text: Which Muggle-born Hufflepuff student is petrified by the Basilisk in Chamber of Secrets?
questions.explanation: Justin Finch-Fletchley, a Muggle-born Hufflepuff, is petrified after seeing the Basilisk's reflection.

questions.question_text: Which pompous Hufflepuff prefect briefly suspects Harry of opening the Chamber of Secrets?
questions.explanation: Ernie Macmillan initially believes Harry is the Heir of Slytherin after hearing him speak Parseltongue.

questions.question_text: Which Ravenclaw student is a member of Dumbledore's Army and later fights in the Battle of Hogwarts?
questions.explanation: Terry Boot is one of several Ravenclaws who joins Dumbledore's Army.

questions.question_text: Which Ravenclaw boy briefly dates Ginny Weasley before she dates Dean Thomas?
questions.explanation: Michael Corner dates Ginny Weasley in her fourth year, later switching his loyalty to Cho Chang.

questions.question_text: Which Slytherin girl fights Hermione Granger in a scuffle during Chamber of Secrets?
questions.explanation: Millicent Bulstrode grapples with Hermione during their brief Dueling Club match.

questions.question_text: Which Slytherin girl is Draco Malfoy's close companion and, according to later canon, eventually marries him?
questions.explanation: Pansy Parkinson is consistently shown as Draco's closest friend and admirer throughout the series.

questions.question_text: Which Slytherin boy, said to have connections to vampires through his family, is in Harry's year?
questions.explanation: Blaise Zabini is a Slytherin classmate whose mother is rumored to have married many wealthy husbands who mysteriously died.

questions.question_text: Which Gryffindor Chaser becomes the Quidditch team's captain after Angelina Johnson graduates?
questions.explanation: Katie Bell takes over as captain of the Gryffindor Quidditch team in Harry's sixth year.

questions.question_text: Which quiet Slytherin boy in Harry's year is the son of a known Death Eater and later part of the Inquisitorial Squad?
questions.explanation: Theodore Nott is a reserved Slytherin student whose father is a Death Eater, and he later joins the Inquisitorial Squad.

questions.question_text: Which Gryffindor Chaser captains the Quidditch team before Katie Bell takes over?
questions.explanation: Angelina Johnson captains the Gryffindor Quidditch team in Harry's fifth year.

questions.question_text: Which Gryffindor Chaser plays alongside Angelina Johnson and Katie Bell for several years?
questions.explanation: Alicia Spinnet is a longtime Gryffindor Chaser during Harry's Quidditch career.

questions.question_text: Which student loses out to Ron Weasley for the Gryffindor Keeper position during sixth-year tryouts?
questions.explanation: Cormac McLaggen competes with Ron for Keeper and loses out, partly due to Hermione's interference with a Confundus Charm.

questions.question_text: Which infatuated student gives Harry a box of chocolate cauldrons spiked with a love potion?
questions.explanation: Romilda Vane slips Harry love-potion-laced chocolates, which Ron accidentally eats instead.

questions.question_text: Whose younger sister does Harry rescue from the lake during the Triwizard Tournament's second task?
questions.explanation: Harry rescues Fleur's little sister, Gabrielle Delacour, after Fleur is unable to complete the task herself.

questions.question_text: Which Order of the Phoenix member, notorious for petty thievery, abandons his post guarding Harry's family early in Order of the Phoenix?
questions.explanation: Mundungus Fletcher leaves his guard duty to chase a deal on cauldrons, angering Moody and Molly Weasley.

questions.question_text: Which Order of the Phoenix member helps escort Harry from Privet Drive at the start of Order of the Phoenix?
questions.explanation: Emmeline Vance is among the Order members who escort Harry safely away from Privet Drive.

questions.question_text: Which eccentric wizard, known for wearing a purple top hat, is part of the welcoming committee that greets the Dursleys at the start of Order of the Phoenix?
questions.explanation: Dedalus Diggle, who once celebrated Voldemort's downfall in Diagon Alley, greets the Dursleys as an Order member.

questions.question_text: Which Order of the Phoenix member is imprisoned in Azkaban after being caught trespassing at the Ministry of Magic?
questions.explanation: Sturgis Podmore is arrested and jailed for trespassing while trying to retrieve a weapon for the Order.

questions.question_text: Which Order of the Phoenix member helps guard Harry during his journeys and is mentioned as living near Privet Drive?
questions.explanation: Hestia Jones is one of the lesser-known Order members tasked with protecting Harry.
questions.source_ref: Order of the Phoenix / Deathly Hallows

questions.question_text: Which of the three Black sisters was disowned by her family for marrying a Muggle-born wizard?
questions.explanation: Andromeda Black was burned off the family tapestry after marrying Ted Tonks, a Muggle-born.

questions.question_text: What is the profession and background of Ted Tonks, Nymphadora Tonks's father?
distractors: He is a Muggle with no magic
questions.explanation: Ted Tonks is Muggle-born, which led to Andromeda being disowned by the Black family for marrying him.

questions.question_text: Which relative of Voldemort's is framed for murdering the Riddle family, a crime Voldemort actually committed?
questions.explanation: Morfin Gaunt is framed by Voldemort for murdering the Riddles, a memory Dumbledore and Harry later view in a Pensieve.

questions.question_text: Which relative of Voldemort's owns the ring that later becomes one of his Horcruxes?
questions.explanation: Marvolo Gaunt possesses the ring bearing the Peverell/Resurrection Stone before Voldemort turns it into a Horcrux.

questions.question_text: What happened to Neville Longbottom's parents that leaves them permanently hospitalized at St Mungo's?
questions.correct_answer: They were tortured into insanity with the Cruciatus Curse
distractors: They were killed in the first war
They were turned into Squibs by a curse
They were placed under the Imperius Curse
questions.explanation: Frank and Alice Longbottom were tortured to insanity by Bellatrix Lestrange and other Death Eaters seeking Voldemort's whereabouts.

questions.question_text: Who raises Neville Longbottom after his parents are incapacitated?
questions.explanation: Neville is raised by his stern but loving grandmother, Augusta Longbottom.

questions.question_text: Which centaur breaks with his herd to teach Divination at Hogwarts?
questions.explanation: Firenze agrees to teach at Hogwarts, a decision that angers the other centaurs in the Forbidden Forest.

questions.question_text: Who is Grawp, whom Hagrid keeps hidden in the Forbidden Forest?
distractors: An escaped giant enemy of Hagrid's
questions.explanation: Grawp is Hagrid's much larger, younger half-brother, whom Hagrid brings to Britain and tries to civilize.

questions.question_text: Who is Colin Creevey's younger brother, also sorted into Gryffindor?
questions.explanation: Dennis Creevey, Colin's younger brother, joins Gryffindor and later fights in the Battle of Hogwarts.

questions.question_text: Who captains the Holyhead Harpies, the professional Quidditch team Ginny Weasley later joins?
questions.explanation: Gwenog Jones captains the all-witch Holyhead Harpies, the team Ginny plays for after Hogwarts.
questions.source_ref: Established from Order of the Phoenix onward

questions.question_text: What is unusual about Rita Skeeter's magical quill, which she uses to "interview" people?
questions.correct_answer: It writes exaggerated, embellished quotes on its own
distractors: It can only write true statements
It transcribes thoughts instead of speech
questions.explanation: Rita Skeeter's Quick-Quotes Quill embellishes and fabricates quotes automatically as it writes.

questions.question_text: What is the name of the portrait who guards the entrance to the Gryffindor common room?
questions.explanation: The Fat Lady's portrait swings open to admit Gryffindors who give the correct password.

questions.question_text: Which Ravenclaw boy, alongside Terry Boot, joins Dumbledore's Army as one of the Ravenclaw members?
questions.explanation: Anthony Goldstein is one of the Ravenclaw students who signs up for Dumbledore's Army.

questions.question_text: In which of Harry's school years does Percy Weasley become Head Boy?
questions.explanation: Percy is named Head Boy during Prisoner of Azkaban, Harry's third year at Hogwarts.

questions.question_text: What is Lord Voldemort's full birth name, which rearranges into his chosen title?
questions.explanation: "Tom Marvolo Riddle" is an anagram of "I am Lord Voldemort," revealed by the diary Horcrux in Chamber of Secrets.

questions.question_text: What is notable about Tom Riddle Sr., Voldemort's father?
questions.explanation: Tom Riddle Sr. was a wealthy Muggle who abandoned Merope Gaunt upon learning she was a witch.

questions.question_text: Who is Lord Voldemort's mother, a descendant of Salazar Slytherin who died shortly after giving birth to him?
questions.explanation: Merope Gaunt dies in a Muggle orphanage shortly after Tom Riddle's birth, having been abandoned by his father.

questions.question_text: Where does young Tom Riddle grow up before attending Hogwarts?
questions.correct_answer: Wool's Orphanage, a Muggle orphanage in London
distractors: A wizarding orphanage in Diagon Alley
questions.explanation: Tom Riddle is raised at Wool's Orphanage, where Dumbledore later visits him to offer his Hogwarts place.

questions.question_text: Which elderly magical historian, a friend of the Dumbledore family, lives in Godric's Hollow and later becomes a source for Rita Skeeter?
questions.explanation: Bathilda Bagshot, author of A History of Magic, is an old friend of the Dumbledores who later suffers a tragic fate in Deathly Hallows.

questions.question_text: What animal is Aberforth Dumbledore known for keeping and being fined for enchanting?
questions.explanation: Aberforth Dumbledore has a running reputation for keeping goats, including once being charged for casting an improper charm on one.
questions.source_ref: Order of the Phoenix / Deathly Hallows

questions.question_text: Who is Ariana Dumbledore, mentioned in Rita Skeeter's controversial biography?
questions.correct_answer: Albus and Aberforth Dumbledore's younger sister
questions.explanation: Ariana Dumbledore, whose uncontrolled magic followed a childhood trauma, dies young in a duel involving her brothers and Grindelwald.

questions.question_text: Who is Kendra Dumbledore, as revealed in accounts of Albus Dumbledore's family history?
questions.explanation: Kendra Dumbledore, Albus's mother, dies in a magical accident connected to Ariana's condition.

questions.question_text: Why is Percival Dumbledore, Albus's father, imprisoned in Azkaban, where he later dies?
questions.correct_answer: For attacking three Muggle boys who had attacked his daughter Ariana
distractors: For attempting to break into Gringotts
For practicing Dark Arts on Muggles unprovoked
questions.explanation: Percival Dumbledore attacks the Muggle boys who traumatized Ariana, and is imprisoned for it, dying in Azkaban.

questions.question_text: In what year does Albus Dumbledore famously defeat the dark wizard Gellert Grindelwald in a legendary duel?
questions.explanation: Dumbledore's defeat of Grindelwald in 1945 is commemorated on his Chocolate Frog card.

questions.question_text: Who is Perenelle, mentioned alongside her husband Nicolas Flamel as co-owner of the Philosopher's Stone's secret?
questions.explanation: Perenelle Flamel is Nicolas's wife, and the two of them have lived for centuries using the Sorcerer's Stone.

questions.question_text: Who is credited as the author of the Hogwarts textbook "Fantastic Beasts and Where to Find Them"?
questions.explanation: Newt Scamander is the celebrated magizoologist credited as the author of the Care of Magical Creatures textbook.

questions.question_text: Who teaches Ancient Runes at Hogwarts, a subject Hermione takes but Harry and Ron do not?
questions.explanation: Bathsheda Babbling is named as the Ancient Runes professor at Hogwarts.

questions.question_text: Who substitutes as the Care of Magical Creatures teacher while Hagrid is absent in Order of the Phoenix?
questions.explanation: Wilhelmina Grubbly-Plank fills in for Hagrid, teaching more conventional lessons than his.
questions.source_ref: Goblet of Fire / Order of the Phoenix

questions.question_text: Which Hogwarts professor, who teaches Muggle Studies, is murdered by Voldemort at the very start of Deathly Hallows?
questions.explanation: Charity Burbage is killed by Voldemort at the Malfoy Manor meeting for her sympathetic views on Muggles.

questions.question_text: Who taught Care of Magical Creatures at Hogwarts before Hagrid took over the post?
questions.explanation: Silvanus Kettleburn retired from teaching Care of Magical Creatures after losing several limbs to the creatures he taught.

questions.question_text: How did Professor Binns, the History of Magic teacher, become a ghost?
questions.correct_answer: He died in his sleep in the staffroom and simply got up to teach the next day, unaware he had died
distractors: He was murdered by a student's curse gone wrong
He was killed defending Hogwarts in a past battle
He drowned in the Hogwarts lake
questions.explanation: Binns famously never noticed his own death, leaving his body behind and continuing to teach as a ghost.

questions.question_text: Who writes Albus Dumbledore's obituary for the Daily Prophet, defending him as an old friend?
questions.explanation: Elphias Doge, a longtime friend of Dumbledore, writes a heartfelt obituary that Harry reads at the start of Deathly Hallows.

questions.question_text: What is the title of Rita Skeeter's scandal-mongering biography of Albus Dumbledore, published after his death?
questions.correct_answer: The Life and Lies of Albus Dumbledore
distractors: The Rise and Fall of Albus Dumbledore
questions.explanation: Rita Skeeter capitalizes on Dumbledore's death with a tell-all book, The Life and Lies of Albus Dumbledore.

questions.question_text: Who leads the group of Snatchers that captures Harry, Ron, and Hermione in the forest during Deathly Hallows?
questions.explanation: Scabior leads the Snatchers who capture the trio and take them to Malfoy Manor.

questions.question_text: Which Death Eater infiltrates the Ministry of Magic's administration after it falls under Voldemort's control?
questions.explanation: Yaxley is present at the Malfoy Manor meeting in the opening chapter and later works within the compromised Ministry.

questions.question_text: Which Ministry official is placed under the Imperius Curse and used as a puppet Minister for Magic by Voldemort's regime?
questions.explanation: Pius Thicknesse is Imperiused and installed as Minister for Magic, giving Voldemort effective control of the Ministry.

questions.question_text: Who becomes Minister for Magic after Cornelius Fudge is forced to resign?
questions.explanation: Rufus Scrimgeour, a former Auror, becomes Minister for Magic in Half-Blood Prince.

questions.question_text: Which Ministry executioner is originally sent to carry out Buckbeak's execution and later becomes an active Death Eater?
questions.explanation: Walden Macnair, the Committee for the Disposal of Dangerous Creatures' executioner, later fights openly as a Death Eater.

questions.question_text: Which two Death Eater siblings are installed as Hogwarts teachers under the Death Eater-controlled administration in Deathly Hallows?
questions.explanation: Amycus and Alecto Carrow teach the Dark Arts and Muggle Studies (as propaganda) at Hogwarts under the new regime.

questions.question_text: Which Death Eater curses Hermione during the battle at the Ministry of Magic in Order of the Phoenix?
questions.explanation: Antonin Dolohov strikes Hermione with a distinctive dark curse during the battle in the Death Chamber.

questions.question_text: Why does Fenrir Greyback bite Remus Lupin when Lupin is just a young child?
questions.correct_answer: As an act of revenge against Lupin's father
distractors: Because Lupin's father was also a werewolf
As punishment for trespassing on Greyback's territory
questions.explanation: Greyback deliberately attacks young Remus to punish his father, who had offended him.
questions.source_ref: Order of the Phoenix / Half-Blood Prince

questions.question_text: What are the names of Sirius Black's parents, whose portraits and family tree hang at Grimmauld Place?
questions.explanation: Orion and Walburga Black are Sirius's parents; Walburga's portrait famously screams abuse at intruders in Grimmauld Place.

questions.question_text: What is the motto inscribed on the Black family crest at Grimmauld Place?
questions.explanation: The Black family motto, "Toujours Pur," reflects their obsession with maintaining pure-blood lineage.

questions.question_text: Which former Hogwarts headmaster, a portrait hanging in both Grimmauld Place and the Headmaster's office, is a Black family ancestor?
questions.explanation: Phineas Nigellus Black, considered the least popular Hogwarts headmaster, links the two locations through his dual portraits.

questions.question_text: Which goblin, who once worked at Gringotts, helps Harry, Ron, and Hermione plan and carry out their break-in during Deathly Hallows?
questions.explanation: Griphook, who had briefly appeared helping Harry in his first year, later assists the trio's Gringotts heist before betraying them.

questions.question_text: Which Gringotts goblin is placed under the Imperius Curse to help the trio access the Lestrange vault?
questions.explanation: Bogrod, a Gringotts employee, is Imperiused by Hermione to assist with entering the Lestrange vault.

questions.question_text: Which kidnapped wandmaker does the trio discover being held captive in the cellar of Malfoy Manor?
questions.explanation: Ollivander has been held prisoner at Malfoy Manor for months, questioned by Voldemort about wandlore.

questions.question_text: What is wandmaker Mr. Ollivander's first name?
questions.explanation: Ollivander's first name, Garrick, is used when he is reunited with the trio after his captivity.

questions.question_text: Why does Xenophilius Lovegood ultimately betray Harry to Death Eaters at his home?
questions.correct_answer: To try to save his daughter Luna, who had been kidnapped
distractors: Because he was Imperiused into doing so
To win favor and a Ministry position
Because he secretly supported Voldemort all along
questions.explanation: Xenophilius alerts Death Eaters to Harry's presence in a desperate attempt to get Luna back safely.

questions.question_text: Which continental wandmaker does Voldemort hunt down, believing he holds the secret to the Elder Wand?
questions.explanation: Voldemort tracks down Gregorovitch, who reveals the wand was stolen from him years earlier by a young thief.

questions.question_text: What Ministry department does Barty Crouch Sr. head at the time of the Quidditch World Cup and Triwizard Tournament?
questions.correct_answer: The Department of International Magical Cooperation
distractors: The Department of Magical Law Enforcement
The Department for the Regulation and Control of Magical Creatures
questions.explanation: By Goblet of Fire, Crouch Sr. has moved from Magical Law Enforcement to head International Magical Cooperation.

questions.question_text: Which professional Quidditch team did Ludo Bagman famously play Beater for in his youth?
questions.explanation: Ludo Bagman was a celebrated Beater for the Wimbourne Wasps before his career in Ministry sports administration.

questions.question_text: What position does Dolores Umbridge hold at the Ministry before becoming a Hogwarts professor?
questions.correct_answer: Senior Undersecretary to the Minister for Magic
distractors: Head of the Improper Use of Magic Office
questions.explanation: Umbridge serves as Cornelius Fudge's Senior Undersecretary before being installed as a Hogwarts teacher and later Headmistress.

questions.question_text: What is ultimately revealed about Nagini, Voldemort's snake companion?
questions.correct_answer: She is one of his Horcruxes
distractors: She is secretly a transformed Death Eater
She is immune to all magical attacks
She was originally Bellatrix Lestrange's familiar
questions.explanation: Nagini is revealed to be Voldemort's final, unintended Horcrux, requiring Neville to destroy her with the sword of Gryffindor.

questions.question_text: How does Peter Pettigrew ultimately die during the events at Malfoy Manor?
questions.correct_answer: His own silver hand strangles him for hesitating to kill Harry
distractors: He is killed by Bellatrix for treachery
He is struck by a stray curse from Ron
questions.explanation: The silver hand Voldemort gave Pettigrew turns on him and chokes him to death after he hesitates out of a life-debt to Harry.

questions.question_text: How did Igor Karkaroff originally avoid a full sentence in Azkaban after his capture as a Death Eater?
questions.correct_answer: He gave the Ministry the names of fellow Death Eaters in exchange for a reduced sentence
distractors: He proved he was acting under the Imperius Curse
He was pardoned by Dumbledore personally
questions.explanation: Karkaroff's early release was secured by naming other Death Eaters, a fact that fuels his fear once Voldemort returns.

questions.question_text: What is notable about Professor Flitwick's ancestry, according to background details about the Charms professor?
distractors: He is a former Triwizard champion
He is descended from a Hogwarts founder
questions.explanation: Filius Flitwick is described as having some goblin ancestry, contributing to his small stature.

questions.question_text: Who actually delivers the real prophecy about the one with power to vanquish the Dark Lord, only partially overheard by Snape?
questions.explanation: Trelawney enters a genuine trance and delivers the prophecy about Harry and Voldemort to Dumbledore during her job interview.

questions.question_text: Sybill Trelawney claims descent from which celebrated historical Seer?
questions.explanation: Trelawney frequently cites her great-great-grandmother Cassandra Trelawney, a renowned Seer, to bolster her credibility.
questions.source_ref: Order of the Phoenix / Half-Blood Prince

questions.question_text: Why is Firenze banished by the centaur herd in the Forbidden Forest?
questions.correct_answer: For agreeing to teach humans at Hogwarts, seen as a betrayal of centaur customs
distractors: For revealing centaur prophecies to Voldemort
For allowing Umbridge into the forest
questions.explanation: Firenze's herd, led by Bane, considers teaching humans a shameful act, and banishes him from their ranks.

questions.question_text: Which centaur most vocally opposes Firenze's decision to teach at Hogwarts?
questions.explanation: Bane leads the centaur herd's condemnation of Firenze for cooperating with humans.
questions.source_ref: Philosopher's Stone / Order of the Phoenix

questions.question_text: Why was Rubeus Hagrid expelled from Hogwarts in his third year, though he was later reinstated as a staff member?
questions.correct_answer: He was framed by Tom Riddle for opening the Chamber of Secrets
distractors: He was caught smuggling a dragon egg
He was caught practicing illegal Dark Arts
questions.explanation: Tom Riddle framed Hagrid and his pet Aragog for the death caused by the Basilisk, leading to Hagrid's expulsion and snapped wand.

questions.question_text: What happens to Dumbledore's hand after he destroys the ring Horcrux with the Sword of Gryffindor?
questions.correct_answer: It becomes blackened and cursed, slowly killing him
distractors: It is instantly healed by Fawkes's tears
It is regrown using a Skele-Gro potion
questions.explanation: The ring carried a curse that Snape only partially contained, leaving Dumbledore's hand blackened and his life shortened.

questions.question_text: Which wealthy elderly witch does a young Tom Riddle murder in order to steal Hufflepuff's cup and Slytherin's locket?
questions.explanation: Tom Riddle, working at Borgin and Burkes, murders Hepzibah Smith and frames her house-elf to steal both treasured heirlooms.

questions.question_text: Which house-elf is framed for Hepzibah Smith's murder after Voldemort kills her and alters her memory?
questions.explanation: Voldemort frames Hepzibah's elderly house-elf, Hokey, for the poisoning he himself committed to steal her treasures.

questions.question_text: Who is the shopkeeper who purchases Slytherin's locket from a desperate Merope Gaunt in Bob Ogden's memory?
questions.correct_answer: Caractacus Burke, of Borgin and Burkes
questions.explanation: Merope sells the locket for a pittance to Caractacus Burke, co-founder of Borgin and Burkes, shortly before Voldemort's birth.

questions.question_text: The Ravenclaw house ghost, the Grey Lady, is revealed to be the daughter of which Hogwarts founder?
questions.explanation: The Grey Lady is Helena Ravenclaw, who stole her mother Rowena's diadem before her own death.

questions.question_text: What is the tragic connection between the Slytherin ghost, the Bloody Baron, and the Grey Lady?
questions.correct_answer: He murdered her out of unrequited love, then killed himself in remorse
distractors: He was her betrothed, killed defending her from Slytherin's monster
He accidentally killed her with a botched spell
They were siblings who died together in a duel
questions.explanation: The Bloody Baron killed Helena Ravenclaw when she refused him, then took his own life out of guilt, which is why he wears chains as penance.

questions.question_text: Whose confused, elderly testimony does Rita Skeeter rely on as her primary source for scandalous claims in her Dumbledore biography?
questions.explanation: Skeeter exploits the elderly, increasingly confused Bathilda Bagshot, who had once been close to the Dumbledore family.

questions.question_text: What gruesome fate has befallen Bathilda Bagshot's body by the time Harry and Hermione visit her in Godric's Hollow?
questions.correct_answer: Voldemort's snake Nagini has been hiding inside her corpse, animating it as a trap
distractors: She had been Transfigured into a statue by Death Eaters
She had been placed under the Imperius Curse
She had been turned into an Inferius by Voldemort
questions.explanation: Nagini inhabits Bathilda's body to lure Harry to Godric's Hollow, springing the trap once he realizes the truth.

questions.question_text: In Dumbledore's will, which specific items does he leave to Harry, Ron, and Hermione respectively?
questions.correct_answer: The Golden Snitch (Harry), the Deluminator (Ron), and Tales of Beedle the Bard (Hermione)
distractors: The Elder Wand (Harry), the Sorting Hat (Ron), a Pensieve (Hermione)
The Invisibility Cloak (Harry), a Foe-Glass (Ron), a spellbook (Hermione)
A phoenix feather (Harry), a Sneakoscope (Ron), the Marauder's Map (Hermione)
questions.explanation: Dumbledore's will grants Harry his old Snitch, Ron the Deluminator, and Hermione a children's story book, each containing hidden significance.

questions.question_text: Tracing its ownership, who does the Elder Wand belong to immediately before Draco Malfoy unknowingly wins its allegiance?
questions.explanation: Dumbledore had held the Elder Wand since defeating Grindelwald in 1945, until Draco disarms him atop the Astronomy Tower.

questions.question_text: When Voldemort finally confronts the wandmaker Gregorovitch, what does Gregorovitch claim happened to the powerful wand Voldemort seeks?
questions.correct_answer: It was stolen from him years earlier by a young thief
distractors: He sold it to Ollivander decades ago
It was destroyed in a workshop fire
He gave it willingly to Dumbledore
questions.explanation: Gregorovitch reveals the wand was stolen from him long ago, a theft later understood to have been carried out by a young Grindelwald.

questions.question_text: During the three-way duel that kills Ariana Dumbledore, whose curse is ever definitively confirmed to have struck her?
questions.correct_answer: It is never definitively confirmed whose curse killed her
questions.explanation: The duel between Albus, Aberforth, and Grindelwald ends with a stray curse killing Ariana, but the books never confirm who cast it.

questions.question_text: Under the Death Eater-controlled Hogwarts administration, which subject does Alecto Carrow teach, twisting it into anti-Muggle propaganda?
distractors: Defense Against the Dark Arts (renamed the Dark Arts)
questions.explanation: Alecto Carrow teaches a propagandized version of Muggle Studies while her brother Amycus takes over the Dark Arts.

questions.question_text: Which Death Eater, an Unspeakable working in the Department of Mysteries, is suspected of leaking Ministry secrets to Voldemort's side?
questions.explanation: Augustus Rookwood, a former Department of Mysteries Unspeakable, is identified as a Death Eater who passed along Ministry secrets.

questions.question_text: Under Polyjuice Potion, what false Ministry identity does Hermione assume to infiltrate the Ministry of Magic in Deathly Hallows?
questions.explanation: Hermione poses as Mafalda Prewett, a fictitious Ministry transfer, to sneak into the Ministry with Harry and Ron.

questions.question_text: Whose Ministry identity does Ron assume via Polyjuice Potion during the trio's infiltration of the Ministry?
questions.explanation: Ron poses as Reginald Cattermole, a Maintenance Office worker, complete with his lime-green robes.

questions.question_text: Who is Mary Cattermole, whom the trio encounters during their Ministry infiltration in Deathly Hallows?
questions.correct_answer: Reginald Cattermole's wife, on trial as a Muggle-born
distractors: A Death Eater posing as a Ministry witness
questions.explanation: Mary Cattermole is being persecuted at a sham Muggle-born registration tribunal that Harry witnesses in disguise.

questions.question_text: Which Death Eater's Ministry identity does Harry assume via Polyjuice Potion to infiltrate the Ministry in Deathly Hallows?
questions.explanation: Harry disguises himself as the imposing Death Eater Albert Runcorn to move through the Ministry undetected.

questions.question_text: What form does Dolores Umbridge's Patronus reportedly take?
questions.explanation: Umbridge's Patronus is a cat, fitting her fondness for the ornamental kitten plates that decorate her office.

questions.question_text: What suspicious detail surrounds the discovery of Amelia Bones's body after Voldemort murders her?
questions.correct_answer: She was found in a room locked from the inside
distractors: No trace of a struggle was found anywhere in her home
She was found in a Ministry office, not her home
questions.explanation: Amelia Bones, a formidable duelist, is found dead in a room locked from within, underscoring Voldemort's terrifying power.

questions.question_text: What happens to Order of the Phoenix member Emmeline Vance, whose disappearance is mentioned early in Half-Blood Prince?
questions.correct_answer: She is killed by Death Eaters
distractors: She goes into hiding and survives the war
questions.explanation: Snape confirms to Narcissa and Bellatrix that Emmeline Vance has been killed, one of several Order losses mentioned early in the book.

questions.question_text: What ultimately happens to Igor Karkaroff after he flees to hide from Voldemort's followers?
questions.correct_answer: He is found dead, murdered by Death Eaters as punishment for betraying them
distractors: He is captured and imprisoned in Azkaban
He successfully escapes to another country and is never found
He is killed by Aurors during a raid
questions.explanation: Karkaroff's body is found with the Dark Mark hovering above, a signal that Death Eaters caught up with him.

questions.question_text: Which Diagon Alley shopkeeper, owner of an ice cream parlor, disappears under suspicious circumstances in Half-Blood Prince?
questions.explanation: Florean Fortescue, owner of the ice cream parlor, vanishes, with signs of a struggle left behind in his shop.

questions.question_text: Why is Harry unable to legally keep the sword of Gryffindor after Dumbledore's will names it for him?
questions.correct_answer: The Ministry rules the sword belongs to Hogwarts, not Dumbledore, so he had no right to bequeath it
distractors: Only a Gryffindor prefect may legally possess it
It had already been destroyed in the Chamber of Secrets
Filch confiscates it as an illegal object
questions.explanation: The Ministry blocks Harry's claim to the sword, ruling it a Hogwarts artifact rather than Dumbledore's personal property to give away.

questions.question_text: Who kills Nagini with the sword of Gryffindor during the Battle of Hogwarts?
questions.explanation: Neville pulls the sword from the burning Sorting Hat and beheads Nagini, destroying Voldemort's final Horcrux.

questions.question_text: What correspondence course does Argus Filch secretly enroll in, hoping to learn magic despite being a Squib?
questions.explanation: Harry and Ron discover a Kwikspell correspondence course pamphlet among Filch's belongings, revealing his secret hope to learn magic.

questions.question_text: Fleur Delacour's part-Veela allure and resistance to fire during the Triwizard Tournament are inherited from which relative?
questions.explanation: Fleur's Veela heritage comes from her grandmother, explaining traits noted throughout Goblet of Fire.

questions.question_text: How do Fred and George Weasley dramatically exit Hogwarts before finishing their final year, during Umbridge's tenure as Headmistress?
questions.correct_answer: They set off a swamp in a corridor and fly away on their broomsticks
distractors: They Apparate out during their final exam
They are formally expelled by the Inquisitorial Squad
They use a Portkey hidden in a Skiving Snackbox
questions.explanation: Fred and George leave Hogwarts in spectacular fashion, unleashing a swamp and fireworks before flying off on their brooms.

questions.question_text: Which of these students is a member of Umbridge's student-enforcement Inquisitorial Squad in Order of the Phoenix?
questions.explanation: Draco Malfoy, along with Crabbe, Goyle, and Pansy Parkinson, joins the Inquisitorial Squad Umbridge creates to police students.

questions.question_text: Slug Club member Marcus Belby is related to which potion-maker, discussed on the Hogwarts Express in Half-Blood Prince?
questions.correct_answer: Damocles Belby, inventor of the Wolfsbane Potion
distractors: Libatius Borage, author of Advanced Potion-Making
questions.explanation: Marcus Belby is invited to Slughorn's compartment partly because his uncle Damocles invented the Wolfsbane Potion.

questions.question_text: Which author and Slug Club guest brings an unusual, blood-averse vampire acquaintance to Slughorn's Christmas party?
questions.explanation: Eldred Worple, author of a vampire biography, brings his vampire subject Sanguini to Slughorn's Christmas party.

questions.question_text: Which goblin ultimately abandons Harry, Ron, and Hermione, taking the sword of Gryffindor and fleeing after the Gringotts break-in?
questions.explanation: After the dramatic escape from Gringotts on the back of a dragon, Griphook takes the sword and runs off rather than honoring his agreement.

questions.question_text: What creature does the Order use to impersonate a bedridden Ron Weasley, supposedly suffering from Spattergroit, while the real Ron is on the run?
distractors: A charmed dummy made of straw
questions.explanation: The Weasleys' attic ghoul is disguised as Ron, supposedly too contagious with Spattergroit for visitors, covering his absence.

questions.question_text: Which elderly, gossiping Weasley relation lends her goblin-made tiara for Fleur and Bill's wedding?
questions.explanation: Great-Aunt Muriel lends her tiara for the wedding and gossips freely about the Dumbledore family at the reception.

questions.question_text: Which Ministry Goblin Liaison Office worker is killed by Snatchers while fleeing alongside Ted Tonks?
questions.explanation: Dirk Cresswell, a Muggle-born Ministry worker, is killed by Snatchers along with Ted Tonks while in hiding.

questions.question_text: Which Black family ancestor, according to Sirius, started the tradition of mounting house-elf heads on the wall at Grimmauld Place?
questions.explanation: Sirius mentions that his ancestor Elladora Black began the grim family custom of displaying elf heads.

questions.question_text: Why can only Harry or Voldemort safely remove their prophecy record from the shelves in the Department of Mysteries?
questions.correct_answer: Only the two people a prophecy concerns are able to remove it without harm
distractors: Only Ministry-registered Unspeakables may touch prophecy orbs
Only the person who made the prophecy may remove it
Any wizard may remove it, but only they can hear it played back
questions.explanation: Prophecy orbs can only be safely handled by the subjects of the prophecy, which is why Voldemort needed Harry to retrieve it for him.

questions.question_text: How does Barty Crouch Jr. originally manage to escape Azkaban years before impersonating Mad-Eye Moody?
questions.correct_answer: His dying mother switches places with him using Polyjuice Potion, and he escapes disguised as her
distractors: He bribes a Dementor guard with dark magic
He tunnels out using a wandless spell
His father secretly arranges his release
questions.explanation: Barty Crouch Sr. secretly frees his son by swapping him with his dying wife, who takes his place and dies in Azkaban disguised as him.

questions.question_text: What is Tonks's actual first name, which she strongly dislikes and forbids people from using?
questions.explanation: Nymphadora Tonks insists on being called simply "Tonks," disliking her given first name.

questions.question_text: Which estranged Weasley sibling dramatically reconciles with his family in the middle of the Battle of Hogwarts?
questions.explanation: Percy returns to fight in the Battle of Hogwarts, publicly admitting he was a fool and reconciling with his family.

questions.question_text: Which Order of the Phoenix Auror is assigned to secretly protect the Muggle Prime Minister at the start of Half-Blood Prince?
questions.explanation: Kingsley Shacklebolt disguises himself among Muggle security to protect the Prime Minister during Voldemort's return to power.

questions.question_text: What ultimately happens to former Minister for Magic Rufus Scrimgeour after Voldemort's forces take over the Ministry?
questions.correct_answer: He is captured, tortured for information about Harry, and killed
distractors: He flees the country and survives in hiding
He is quietly reinstated as a Ministry advisor
He is imprisoned in his own former office
questions.explanation: Bill Weasley reports that Scrimgeour was tortured for Harry's whereabouts and killed rather than betraying him.

questions.question_text: Whose lost diadem does Voldemort transform into a Horcrux and hide inside the Room of Requirement?
questions.explanation: Voldemort turns Ravenclaw's lost diadem into a Horcrux and conceals it among centuries of hidden objects in the Room of Requirement.

questions.question_text: Decades before revealing it to Harry, who did the Grey Lady (Helena Ravenclaw) originally tell about the diadem's hiding place, under deception?
questions.correct_answer: Tom Riddle, who later became Voldemort
questions.explanation: As a student, Tom Riddle charmed Helena Ravenclaw's ghost into revealing where she had hidden her mother's diadem.

questions.question_text: What does Dumbledore force himself to do in order to retrieve a Horcrux hidden in a cave, severely weakening him in the process?
questions.correct_answer: Drink a cursed potion filling a stone basin
distractors: Fight off an army of Inferi single-handedly with no aid
Perform a blood ritual using his own life force
Swim across an enchanted, freezing lake unaided
questions.explanation: Dumbledore drinks a potion that induces horrific visions and thirst in order to reach the locket at the bottom of the basin, gravely weakening him.

questions.question_text: What ultimately happens to Barty Crouch Jr. after he is exposed as Mad-Eye Moody's impersonator?
questions.correct_answer: He receives the Dementor's Kiss before he can be questioned further
distractors: He is sentenced to life in Azkaban
He is executed by the Ministry
questions.explanation: Fudge orders the Dementor's Kiss administered to Crouch Jr. immediately, destroying his soul before Dumbledore can have him questioned.

questions.question_text: Whose old school copy of Advanced Potion-Making, filled with handwritten spells and annotations, does Harry use in sixth year?
questions.correct_answer: Severus Snape's, from his own time as a Hogwarts student
questions.explanation: The secondhand textbook Harry receives once belonged to Snape, who annotated it under the alias "the Half-Blood Prince."

questions.question_text: What is the maiden name of Severus Snape's pure-blood witch mother, the source of his self-given nickname?
questions.explanation: Snape's mother, Eileen Prince, gives him the family name behind his self-styled title "the Half-Blood Prince."

questions.question_text: Why does Severus Snape style himself "the Half-Blood Prince" as a student?
questions.correct_answer: His father was a Muggle and his mother was a pure-blood witch from the Prince family
distractors: He was secretly descended from a Hogwarts founder
It was an insulting nickname given to him by James Potter
He invented it to hide his mother's Muggle heritage
questions.explanation: Snape combines his mixed parentage, a Muggle father and pure-blood Prince mother, into his self-given alias.

questions.question_text: How exactly does Sirius Black die during the battle at the Department of Mysteries?
questions.correct_answer: He falls through the mysterious Veil in the Death Chamber after being struck by Bellatrix's curse
distractors: He is struck by the Killing Curse and dies instantly on the floor
He is bitten fatally by a Death Eater's transformed creature
He drowns in the Fountain of Magical Brethren
questions.explanation: Bellatrix's curse knocks Sirius backward through the ancient Veil, from which nothing that passes through ever returns.

questions.question_text: Whose wand does Neville Longbottom use for most of his years at Hogwarts, before finally getting his own?
questions.correct_answer: His father Frank Longbottom's old wand
distractors: A spare wand borrowed from Ollivander's shop
questions.explanation: Neville uses his father's old wand throughout most of the series, which never suits him as well as his own eventually does.

questions.question_text: How does Colin Creevey, previously petrified by the Basilisk as a second-year, ultimately die in the series?
questions.correct_answer: He sneaks back to fight underage in the Battle of Hogwarts and is killed
distractors: He dies of injuries sustained from the Basilisk years earlier
He is killed by Death Eaters at his family's Muggle home
He dies protecting his younger brother from a curse
questions.explanation: Despite being underage, Colin Creevey returns to fight in the Battle of Hogwarts and is among those killed.

questions.question_text: During Dumbledore's duel with Voldemort in the Ministry Atrium, what does Fawkes the phoenix do to protect him?
questions.correct_answer: He swallows the Killing Curse aimed at Dumbledore
distractors: He shields Dumbledore's body physically with his wings
He carries Dumbledore away before the curse lands
He blinds Voldemort with a burst of flame
questions.explanation: Fawkes swoops in and swallows the Avada Kedavra meant for Dumbledore, sacrificing himself in the process before later reviving.

questions.question_text: Among the members of Dumbledore's Army, whose corporeal Patronus takes the form of a hare?
questions.explanation: Luna Lovegood's Patronus is a hare, one of several distinctive Patronus forms shown among the D.A. members.

questions.question_text: What is the name of the enormous three-headed dog that guards the trapdoor leading to the Philosopher's Stone?
questions.explanation: Fluffy is the three-headed dog Hagrid keeps to guard the Philosopher's Stone.

questions.question_text: What lulls Fluffy the three-headed dog to sleep, allowing others to slip past him safely?
questions.explanation: Fluffy falls asleep whenever he hears music, a weakness Hagrid lets slip to Harry.

questions.question_text: Where does Hagrid say he got Fluffy the three-headed dog?
questions.correct_answer: From a Greek stranger he met at the pub
questions.explanation: Hagrid mentions winning Fluffy off a Greek chap he met at the pub, who happened to have a spare three-headed dog.

questions.question_text: Which Weasley brother works with dragons at a reserve in Romania?
questions.explanation: Charlie Weasley works studying and caring for dragons in Romania.

questions.question_text: What is the name of Aragog's wife, who lives among the Acromantula colony in the Forbidden Forest?
questions.explanation: Mosag is Aragog's wife, one of the giant spiders that make up the Acromantula colony.

questions.question_text: What magical bird is famous for bursting into flame and being reborn from its own ashes?
questions.explanation: Phoenixes, like Dumbledore's Fawkes, periodically burst into flame and are reborn from the ashes.

questions.question_text: What color is described as flowing from a wounded unicorn in the Forbidden Forest?
questions.explanation: Unicorn blood is described as shining and silvery, spilled across the forest floor where Voldemort has been drinking it.

questions.question_text: What creature is Quirrell, possessed by Voldemort, discovered killing in the Forbidden Forest during Harry's first year?
questions.explanation: Quirrell, under Voldemort's control, hunts and drinks the blood of unicorns to sustain a weakened Voldemort.

questions.question_text: Which centaur carries Harry to safety after he stumbles onto Quirrell's unicorn-killing in the Forbidden Forest?
questions.explanation: Firenze the centaur rescues Harry and carries him away from danger in the Forbidden Forest.

questions.question_text: What subject does Hagrid come to teach at Hogwarts, focused on magical beasts?
questions.explanation: Hagrid eventually becomes the Care of Magical Creatures professor at Hogwarts.

questions.question_text: What is unusual about the Care of Magical Creatures textbook called The Monster Book of Monsters?
questions.correct_answer: It tries to bite anyone who opens it
distractors: It can only be read at night
questions.explanation: The Monster Book of Monsters snaps and bites unless it is stroked or otherwise calmed before opening.

questions.question_text: Who wrote the textbook Fantastic Beasts and Where to Find Them, used by Hogwarts students?
questions.explanation: Fantastic Beasts and Where to Find Them is a Care of Magical Creatures textbook authored by magizoologist Newt Scamander.

questions.question_text: What kind of creature is a Kneazle, the species Crookshanks is part of?
questions.explanation: Kneazles are intelligent, cat-like magical creatures known for sensing untrustworthy people.

questions.question_text: In which book do students first encounter Blast-Ended Skrewts in Care of Magical Creatures class?
questions.explanation: Hagrid introduces his class to the unpredictable Blast-Ended Skrewts, his own creation, in Goblet of Fire.

questions.question_text: What creature does Hagrid's class practice handling by having them dig for buried gold?
questions.explanation: Nifflers are drawn to anything shiny, so Hagrid's class uses them to hunt for buried gold.

questions.question_text: What weapon does the mountain troll released by Quirrell carry through Hogwarts?
questions.explanation: The mountain troll Quirrell releases on Halloween carries a huge wooden club.

questions.question_text: How do Harry and Ron manage to knock out the mountain troll in the girls' bathroom?
questions.correct_answer: By levitating the troll's own club and dropping it on its head
distractors: By trapping it inside the room with magic
questions.explanation: Harry and Ron use the Levitation Charm to make the troll's own club knock it unconscious.

questions.question_text: What are house-elves like Dobby traditionally bound to serve?
questions.explanation: House-elves are magically bound in service to a wizarding family or household.

questions.question_text: How is a house-elf traditionally freed from service, as shown when Dobby is freed?
questions.correct_answer: By being given an article of clothing by their master
distractors: By paying a fee to the Ministry
By surviving one full year without magic
questions.explanation: Giving a house-elf clothing is the traditional way to free them, which is how Harry inadvertently frees Dobby.

questions.question_text: What object does Harry hide inside a book to trick Lucius Malfoy into unknowingly freeing Dobby?
questions.explanation: Harry hides his own sock in the diary and gives it to Lucius Malfoy, who hands it, and the sock, to Dobby, freeing him.

questions.question_text: What creature lives in the attic of the Weasleys' home, the Burrow?
questions.explanation: A ghoul lives in the Weasleys' attic, occasionally heard moaning and throwing pipes.

questions.question_text: What small, mischievous creatures does Ron's family clear from the garden at the Burrow by throwing them over the hedge?
questions.explanation: The Weasleys regularly 'de-gnome' their garden, tossing the small creatures over the hedge.

questions.question_text: What is the term for the process of clearing garden gnomes from a yard, as practiced at the Burrow?
questions.explanation: De-gnoming is the regular chore of removing garden gnomes from the Weasleys' garden.

questions.question_text: What does Buckbeak the Hippogriff do to Draco Malfoy that leads to his death sentence?
questions.explanation: Buckbeak scratches and injures Draco Malfoy's arm after Malfoy ignores Hagrid's warnings and insults him.

questions.question_text: What must a wizard never do when approaching a Hippogriff, according to Hagrid's first lesson?
questions.explanation: Hagrid warns his class that insulting a Hippogriff is extremely dangerous, as they are proud creatures.

questions.question_text: What spell is used to make a Boggart take a ridiculous, less frightening shape?
questions.explanation: The Riddikulus charm forces a Boggart into a comical form, defusing the fear it represents.

questions.question_text: What shape does Ron Weasley's Boggart take in Professor Lupin's classroom?
questions.explanation: Ron's greatest fear, and his Boggart's shape, is a giant spider.

questions.question_text: What shape does Neville Longbottom's Boggart take in Prisoner of Azkaban?
questions.explanation: Neville's Boggart takes the form of Professor Snape, his greatest fear.

questions.question_text: What spell does a wizard cast to drive away a Dementor?
questions.explanation: Casting a Patronus is the only known way to repel a Dementor.

questions.question_text: What animal shape does Harry Potter's Patronus take?
questions.explanation: Harry's Patronus takes the form of a stag, echoing his father's Animagus form.

questions.question_text: What animal shape does Hermione Granger's Patronus take?
questions.explanation: Hermione's Patronus is an otter.

questions.question_text: What animal does Rita Skeeter illegally transform into as an unregistered Animagus?
questions.explanation: Rita Skeeter is secretly an unregistered Animagus who turns into a beetle to spy on people.

questions.question_text: What animal is Minerva McGonagall's Animagus form?
questions.explanation: Professor McGonagall can transform into a tabby cat with distinctive markings around the eyes.

questions.question_text: What animal is Sirius Black's Animagus form?
questions.explanation: Sirius Black can transform into a large black dog, nicknamed Padfoot.

questions.question_text: What animal is Peter Pettigrew's Animagus form?
questions.explanation: Peter Pettigrew's Animagus form is a rat, which he used to hide as Scabbers for years.

questions.question_text: What animal is James Potter's Animagus form?
questions.explanation: James Potter's Animagus form is a stag, nicknamed Prongs.

questions.question_text: What kind of pet does Argus Filch's cat companion, who patrols the corridors, belong to?
questions.explanation: Mrs. Norris is Filch's cat, who prowls the halls of Hogwarts alongside him.

questions.question_text: What large magical bank in London do dragons guard deep within its vaults, according to Hagrid?
questions.explanation: Hagrid tells Harry that Gringotts' deepest vaults are guarded by dragons.

questions.question_text: What kind of small, round, furry creature that hums contentedly can be bought as a pet in Diagon Alley's Magical Menagerie?
questions.explanation: Puffskeins are gentle, round, furry creatures sold as easy pets in the Magical Menagerie.

questions.question_text: What miniature relative of the Puffskein do Fred and George Weasley sell at their joke shop?
questions.explanation: Pygmy Puffs are miniature Puffskeins sold at Weasleys' Wizard Wheezes.

questions.question_text: Which Weasley sibling buys and keeps a Pygmy Puff as a pet?
questions.explanation: Ginny Weasley buys a Pygmy Puff from her brothers' joke shop and keeps it as a pet.

questions.question_text: At which wizarding sporting event do Veela and Leprechauns appear as team mascots?
distractors: The British and Irish Quidditch League opener
questions.explanation: Veela and Leprechauns serve as mascots for their national teams at the Quidditch World Cup.

questions.question_text: Which magical beings serve as the Bulgarian National Quidditch team's mascots, mesmerizing the crowd with their dance?
questions.explanation: Veela dance as the Bulgarian team's mascots at the Quidditch World Cup.

questions.question_text: Which magical beings serve as the Irish National Quidditch team's mascots, showering the crowd with gold?
questions.explanation: Leprechauns act as the Irish team's mascots, producing showers of gold for the crowd.

questions.question_text: What eventually happens to the gold that Leprechauns shower over the crowd at the Quidditch World Cup?
questions.explanation: Leprechaun gold is enchanted to disappear a short time after it's given, to the frustration of anyone who spends it.

questions.question_text: What part-magical-creature heritage does Fleur Delacour have?
questions.explanation: Fleur Delacour has Veela heritage through her grandmother, giving her an alluring quality.

questions.question_text: What kind of snake does young Harry accidentally set free from its enclosure at the zoo before starting Hogwarts?
questions.explanation: Harry unknowingly uses his Parseltongue-adjacent ability to talk to and free a boa constrictor at the zoo.

questions.question_text: Which dragon breed does Cedric Diggory face during the Triwizard Tournament's First Task?
questions.explanation: Cedric Diggory draws the Swedish Short-Snout for the First Task.

questions.question_text: Which dragon breed does Fleur Delacour face during the Triwizard Tournament's First Task?
questions.explanation: Fleur Delacour is assigned the Common Welsh Green for the First Task.

questions.question_text: Which dragon breed does Viktor Krum face during the Triwizard Tournament's First Task?
questions.explanation: Viktor Krum faces the Chinese Fireball during the First Task.

questions.question_text: What is the name of Percy Weasley's owl, given to him as a prefect gift?
questions.explanation: Percy is given the owl Hermes as a reward for becoming a prefect.

questions.question_text: What special sense do part-Kneazle cats like Crookshanks have that helps them recognize disguised or untrustworthy people?
questions.correct_answer: They can detect people in disguise, including Animagi
distractors: They can see through Invisibility Cloaks
questions.explanation: Kneazles have a natural instinct for sensing suspicious or disguised individuals, which is why Crookshanks distrusts Scabbers.

questions.question_text: Whom does Voldemort's snake Nagini attack at the Ministry of Magic, an event Harry witnesses in a vision?
questions.explanation: Harry sees, through his scar connection, Nagini attacking Arthur Weasley in the Department of Mysteries.

questions.question_text: What imaginary creature does Luna Lovegood spend much of the series searching for, despite no evidence it exists?
questions.explanation: Luna believes in and searches for the Crumple-Horned Snorkack, a creature unknown to mainstream magizoology.

questions.question_text: According to Luna Lovegood, what invisible creatures cause a person's brain to feel fuzzy by floating into their ears?
questions.explanation: Luna often claims Wrackspurts are responsible for muddled thinking.

questions.question_text: According to Luna Lovegood, what mischievous creatures infest mistletoe?
questions.explanation: Luna warns that Nargles like to infest mistletoe.

questions.question_text: What does Luna Lovegood claim causes wildfires by stampeding across the land?
questions.explanation: Luna describes Heliopaths as fire spirits believed to stampede and cause wildfires.

questions.question_text: What creature must O.W.L.-level Care of Magical Creatures students learn to identify by its hostile reaction to being offered a saucer of milk, since it closely resembles a hedgehog?
questions.explanation: Knarls look just like hedgehogs but react with aggression when offered food, a key way to tell them apart.

questions.question_text: What is the name of the giant chieftain, or Gurg, whom Hagrid and Madame Maxime meet during their diplomatic mission in Goblet of Fire?
questions.explanation: Karkus is the Gurg of the giants when Hagrid and Madame Maxime first visit them.

questions.question_text: Who becomes the new Gurg, or chief, of the giants by the time of Order of the Phoenix, after killing his predecessor?
questions.explanation: Golgomath violently takes over as Gurg of the giants, a development that worries the Order.

questions.question_text: What nickname does Grawp use for Hermione Granger, owing to his limited grasp of English?
questions.explanation: Grawp calls Hermione "Hermy," one of the few names he manages to pronounce.

questions.question_text: What potion allows a werewolf to retain their human mind during a full-moon transformation?
questions.explanation: The Wolfsbane Potion lets a werewolf keep their human mind while transformed, though it doesn't prevent the transformation itself.

questions.question_text: Who brews the Wolfsbane Potion for Remus Lupin during his year teaching at Hogwarts?
questions.explanation: Snape brews the difficult Wolfsbane Potion for Lupin each month, despite their mutual dislike.

questions.question_text: Which werewolf bit and infected Remus Lupin when he was a young child?
questions.explanation: Fenrir Greyback attacked Remus Lupin as a child, infecting him with lycanthropy.

questions.question_text: Which Weasley brother is mauled by Fenrir Greyback and left with some wolf-like traits, though not fully transformed?
questions.explanation: Bill Weasley is attacked by Fenrir Greyback during the Battle of the Astronomy Tower, leaving him permanently scarred with some wolfish traits.

questions.question_text: What nickname do the Marauders give Remus Lupin on the Marauder's Map, reflecting his condition?
questions.explanation: Remus Lupin's Marauder nickname is Moony, a reference to his lycanthropy.

questions.question_text: What nickname do the Marauders give Sirius Black, reflecting his dog Animagus form?
questions.explanation: Sirius Black's Marauder nickname, Padfoot, reflects his large black dog Animagus form.

questions.question_text: What nickname do the Marauders give James Potter, reflecting his stag Animagus form?
questions.explanation: James Potter's Marauder nickname, Prongs, reflects his stag Animagus form.

questions.question_text: What nickname do the Marauders give Peter Pettigrew, reflecting his rat Animagus form?
questions.explanation: Peter Pettigrew's Marauder nickname, Wormtail, reflects his rat Animagus form.

questions.question_text: Why did James Potter, Sirius Black, and Peter Pettigrew secretly become illegal Animagi while at Hogwarts?
questions.correct_answer: To keep Remus Lupin company during his werewolf transformations
questions.explanation: The three became unregistered Animagi specifically to safely accompany their werewolf friend, Remus Lupin, during his transformations.

questions.question_text: Where do students first get an up-close look at a live Grindylow in a classroom setting?
questions.correct_answer: In Professor Lupin's Defense Against the Dark Arts class
distractors: In Hagrid's Care of Magical Creatures class
questions.explanation: Lupin keeps a Grindylow in a tank as part of his third-year Defense Against the Dark Arts curriculum.

questions.question_text: What is Acromantula venom primarily prized for in the wizarding world?
questions.correct_answer: It is an extremely valuable potion-making ingredient
distractors: It is used to power wands
It is used to brew Polyjuice Potion
questions.explanation: Acromantula venom is highly sought after as a rare and valuable potion ingredient.

questions.question_text: Which Hogwarts student was killed by the Basilisk decades earlier after looking directly into its eyes, later becoming a ghost?
questions.explanation: Myrtle Warren died after meeting the Basilisk's gaze directly, and she haunts a Hogwarts bathroom as Moaning Myrtle.

questions.question_text: What happens to someone who sees a Basilisk's gaze only indirectly, such as through a reflection, rather than dying instantly?
questions.correct_answer: They are Petrified instead of killed
distractors: They fall into an incurable coma
questions.explanation: Viewing the Basilisk indirectly, such as through Colin Creevey's camera or a mirror, causes Petrification rather than death.

questions.question_text: Which enchanted diary is responsible for unleashing the Basilisk and endangering students in Chamber of Secrets?
questions.explanation: Tom Riddle's diary, a Horcrux, possesses Ginny Weasley and directs her to open the Chamber of Secrets.

questions.question_text: Who leads the centaur herd in the Forbidden Forest during Order of the Phoenix?
questions.explanation: Magorian serves as the leader of the centaur herd during the events of Order of the Phoenix.

questions.question_text: What danger do Red Caps, a creature studied in Defense classes, pose to travelers?
questions.correct_answer: They are small, murderous goblin-like creatures found where blood has been shed
questions.explanation: Red Caps lurk around old battle sites and dungeons, attacking anyone who wanders too close.

questions.question_text: What is a Hinkypunk, one of the creatures included in Professor Lupin's third-year Defense curriculum?
questions.correct_answer: A one-legged creature that carries a lantern to lure travelers into bogs and marshes
distractors: A tiny dragon that breathes cold mist
A water-dwelling imp that steals shoes
questions.explanation: Hinkypunks lure travelers off safe paths and into bogs using a lantern-like light.

questions.question_text: Where in Diagon Alley can students buy pets such as Puffskeins, toads, and cats?
questions.explanation: The Magical Menagerie is the Diagon Alley shop specializing in magical pets.

questions.question_text: Which calmer alternative to Blast-Ended Skrewts does Hagrid's O.W.L.-level Care of Magical Creatures class handle in Half-Blood Prince?
questions.explanation: With fewer students continuing the subject, Hagrid's remaining O.W.L.-level class handles calmer creatures like Fire Crabs.

questions.question_text: What do Veela transform into when angered, as seen during the brawl after the Quidditch World Cup match?
questions.correct_answer: Fierce, birdlike creatures with wings and beaks
questions.explanation: When enraged, Veela shed their beautiful human appearance for a savage, birdlike form.

questions.question_text: What is a Kelpie, a shape-shifting water demon referenced in Care of Magical Creatures lessons?
questions.correct_answer: A creature that often takes the form of a horse to lure victims into water
questions.explanation: Kelpies are shape-shifting water demons that typically appear as horses to lure the unwary to a watery grave.

questions.question_text: What does Hagrid say is his ultimate dream regarding notoriously dangerous magical creatures like Manticores or Chimaeras?
questions.correct_answer: To breed or successfully cross unusual, dangerous creatures himself
distractors: To hunt and capture one for the Ministry
To domesticate one as an official Hogwarts pet
To sell one to Newt Scamander
questions.explanation: Hagrid has long dreamed of breeding rare and dangerous magical creatures, as shown by his creation of the Blast-Ended Skrewts.

questions.question_text: What is the primary danger posed by a Chimaera, a creature Hagrid once wished to own an egg of?
