questions.question_text: What is the name of the bookshop in Diagon Alley where Hogwarts students buy their textbooks?
questions.explanation: Flourish and Blotts is the main wizarding bookshop in Diagon Alley, selling textbooks and other titles.

questions.question_text: Where do Hogwarts students go in Diagon Alley to be fitted for their school robes?
questions.correct_answer: Madam Malkin's Robes for All Occasions
questions.explanation: Madam Malkin's Robes for All Occasions is where Harry is fitted for his school robes before his first year.

questions.question_text: What joke shop do Fred and George Weasley open in Diagon Alley?
questions.explanation: Fred and George open their own joke shop, Weasleys' Wizard Wheezes, in Diagon Alley.

questions.question_text: What section of the Hogwarts library requires a teacher's written permission to enter?
questions.explanation: Books in the Restricted Section of the library deal with dangerous or dark subjects and require permission to access.

questions.question_text: What is the name of the shop in Diagon Alley that sells owls?
questions.explanation: Eeylops Owl Emporium sells owls of every kind, including the one Hagrid buys Harry as a birthday gift.

questions.question_text: What is the name of the ice cream parlor in Diagon Alley?
questions.explanation: Florean Fortescue's Ice Cream Parlor is a popular Diagon Alley stop, run by its friendly owner Florean Fortescue.

questions.question_text: What was the name of the joke shop in Hogsmeade before Weasleys' Wizard Wheezes existed?
questions.explanation: Zonko's Joke Shop in Hogsmeade sold pranks and novelty items popular with students.

questions.question_text: How do first-year students traditionally arrive at Hogwarts castle on their first night?
questions.correct_answer: By boat, crossing the lake led by Hagrid
distractors: By walking up a mountain path
By Floo Powder into the Great Hall
questions.explanation: First years cross the Black Lake in small boats, led by Hagrid, for their first view of the castle.

questions.question_text: What must be done to a certain brick wall behind the Leaky Cauldron to reveal the entrance to Diagon Alley?
questions.correct_answer: It must be tapped in the correct pattern with a wand
distractors: It must be spoken to in Parseltongue
It must be knocked on three times
It must be sprinkled with Floo Powder
questions.explanation: Tapping the correct bricks in the courtyard behind the Leaky Cauldron causes the wall to open into Diagon Alley.

questions.question_text: What is the name of the Diagon Alley shop that sells magical creatures such as toads and cats?
questions.explanation: The Magical Menagerie sells a range of magical pets, including toads, cats, and rats.

questions.question_text: What shop in Diagon Alley specializes in Quidditch equipment?
questions.explanation: Quality Quidditch Supplies sells broomsticks and other Quidditch gear in Diagon Alley.

questions.question_text: What ordinary-looking object serves as the visitors' entrance to the Ministry of Magic in London?
questions.explanation: Visitors enter the Ministry of Magic through an old red telephone box on a London street.

questions.question_text: In which tower are Astronomy classes held at Hogwarts?
questions.explanation: Astronomy classes take place at night at the top of the Astronomy Tower, one of the castle's tallest points.

questions.question_text: What guards the spiral staircase entrance to the Hogwarts headmaster's office?
questions.explanation: A stone gargoyle leaps aside to reveal a moving staircase once the correct password is given.

questions.question_text: In which country is Hogwarts School of Witchcraft and Wizardry located?
questions.explanation: Hogwarts is located in the Scottish Highlands, hidden from Muggles.

questions.question_text: What community lives beneath the surface of the Black Lake?
questions.explanation: Merpeople live in a village beneath the Black Lake, glimpsed during the Triwizard Tournament's second task.

questions.question_text: What giant spider colony lives deep within the Forbidden Forest?
questions.explanation: Aragog, a giant Acromantula, leads a colony of enormous spiders living deep in the Forbidden Forest.

questions.question_text: What is the name of the shabby pub in Hogsmeade run by Aberforth Dumbledore?
questions.explanation: The Hog's Head is a run-down Hogsmeade pub run by Albus Dumbledore's brother, Aberforth.

questions.question_text: In which town do the Dursleys live?
questions.explanation: The Dursleys live at Number 4, Privet Drive, in the town of Little Whinging, Surrey.

questions.question_text: Near which village is the Weasley family's home, the Burrow, located?
questions.explanation: The Burrow sits in the countryside near the village of Ottery St Catchpole.

questions.question_text: What room at Hogwarts is filled with trophies, plaques, and cups, sometimes used as a detention site?
questions.explanation: The Trophy Room displays generations of Hogwarts awards and is where Filch sometimes assigns detentions.

questions.question_text: Which Hogwarts house has its common room located in the dungeons?
questions.explanation: The Slytherin common room lies behind a hidden entrance in the school's dungeons.

questions.question_text: Which Hogwarts house has its common room located near the kitchens?
questions.explanation: The Hufflepuff common room is tucked away close to the Hogwarts kitchens.

questions.question_text: Which Hogwarts house's common room is reached by answering a riddle?
questions.explanation: The Ravenclaw common room, high in a tower, is entered by correctly answering a riddle posed by a knocker.

questions.question_text: What is the name of the post office in Hogsmeade used to send owls?
questions.explanation: Hogsmeade's Owl Post Office allows students to send letters and packages by owl.

questions.question_text: What is the name of the shop in Diagon Alley that sells cauldrons?
questions.explanation: Potage's Cauldron Shop in Diagon Alley sells cauldrons in a range of metals and sizes.

questions.question_text: What is the number of the ultra-secure Gringotts vault Hagrid visits to retrieve a mysterious package?
questions.explanation: Hagrid retrieves a small package from the highly secure Vault seven hundred and thirteen at Gringotts.

questions.question_text: Platform 9¾ is hidden between which two ordinary platforms at King's Cross Station?
questions.explanation: Students reach Platform 9¾ by walking through the barrier between Platforms Nine and Ten.

questions.question_text: What is the name of the hill where wizards gather to Portkey to the Quidditch World Cup campsite?
questions.explanation: Harry and the Weasleys travel to Stoatshead Hill to catch a Portkey to the Quidditch World Cup.

questions.question_text: What Diagon Alley shop specializes in quills?
questions.explanation: Scrivenshaft's Quill Shop in Diagon Alley sells quills of every variety for students' schoolwork.

questions.question_text: What is the name of the clothing shop found in Hogsmeade?
distractors: Madam Malkin's Robes for All Occasions
questions.explanation: Gladrags Wizardwear, with a branch in Hogsmeade, sells wizarding clothing, including novelty socks.

questions.question_text: What kind of statue conceals a secret passage from Hogwarts to the cellar of Honeydukes?
distractors: A statue of a Hogwarts founder
questions.explanation: Tapping the hump of the one-eyed witch statue and saying 'Dissendium' opens a passage leading to Honeydukes' cellar.

questions.question_text: What is the name of the joke shop in Diagon Alley that existed before Weasleys' Wizard Wheezes?
questions.explanation: Gambol and Japes is a Diagon Alley joke shop mentioned before the Weasley twins opened their own.

questions.question_text: In which part of the Burrow's grounds does Bill and Fleur Weasley's wedding take place?
questions.explanation: A large marquee is set up in the orchard at the Burrow for Bill and Fleur's wedding celebration.

questions.question_text: Where does Argus Filch keep items confiscated from students?
questions.explanation: Filch stores confiscated items, including many banned by Umbridge, in his office at Hogwarts.

questions.question_text: What material are the great entrance doors of Hogwarts castle made of?
questions.explanation: The large oak front doors lead into the Entrance Hall of Hogwarts castle.

questions.question_text: What does the enchanted ceiling of the Great Hall show?
questions.explanation: The Great Hall's ceiling is bewitched to mirror the sky outside, as described in Hogwarts, A History.

questions.question_text: In which village is the Shrieking Shack located?
questions.explanation: The Shrieking Shack stands at the edge of Hogsmeade village.

questions.question_text: Which fifth-floor room at Hogwarts, entered with the password 'Pine Fresh,' does Harry use to solve the golden egg's clue in Goblet of Fire?
questions.explanation: Cedric tips Harry off to open the golden egg underwater in the Prefects' bathroom, accessible to prefects and champions.

questions.question_text: What is the name of the prison Gellert Grindelwald built, in which he is later imprisoned himself?
questions.explanation: Grindelwald built Nurmengard to hold his enemies, and was later imprisoned there himself after his defeat by Dumbledore.

questions.question_text: The Weasley family visits which country to see Bill, who works as a Gringotts curse-breaker there?
questions.explanation: Bill Weasley works for Gringotts in Egypt, and the family visits him there, seeing the pyramids, before Harry's second year.

questions.question_text: In which country does Charlie Weasley work at a dragon reserve?
questions.explanation: Charlie Weasley works with dragons at a reserve in Romania.

questions.question_text: What is the name of the upscale robe shop in Diagon Alley, a pricier alternative to Madam Malkin's?
distractors: Madam Malkin's Robes for All Occasions
questions.explanation: Twilfitt and Tatting's is mentioned as a fashionable, expensive robe shop in Diagon Alley.

questions.question_text: Where in Number Twelve, Grimmauld Place does the shrieking portrait of Sirius's mother hang?
questions.correct_answer: In the entrance hall, behind a curtain
distractors: At the top of the staircase
questions.explanation: Mrs. Black's portrait hangs in the entrance hall, hidden behind curtains that fly open when disturbed.

questions.question_text: Where does Kreacher keep a hidden shrine of stolen family treasures at Grimmauld Place?
questions.correct_answer: In a cupboard under the boiler in the kitchen
questions.explanation: Kreacher hoards stolen items, including a photograph of Regulus, in a hidden nest under the kitchen boiler.

questions.question_text: What is the name of the abandoned manor house in Little Hangleton once owned by Voldemort's father's family?
questions.explanation: The Riddle House is the grand but derelict home of Tom Riddle Sr.'s family, overlooking the village of Little Hangleton.

questions.question_text: In which city is the orphanage where Tom Riddle grew up located?
questions.explanation: Tom Riddle grew up in Wool's Orphanage in London before receiving his Hogwarts letter.

questions.question_text: What coastal location does Dumbledore take Harry to in search of a Horcrux in Half-Blood Prince?
distractors: An island off the coast of Scotland
questions.explanation: Dumbledore and Harry travel to a remote sea cave, reachable only by boat, believed to hide one of Voldemort's Horcruxes.

questions.question_text: Which Hogwarts office, decorated with plates of kittens, becomes the headquarters of the Inquisitorial Squad?
questions.explanation: Umbridge's office, filled with ornamental kitten plates, becomes the base for her Inquisitorial Squad in Order of the Phoenix.

questions.question_text: After Trelawney's dismissal, part of Divination is taught by Firenze in a classroom modeled on which environment?
questions.explanation: Firenze the centaur teaches Divination in a ground-floor classroom transformed to resemble a forest clearing.

questions.question_text: In which body of water is the wizard prison Azkaban located?
questions.explanation: Azkaban is a fortress prison built on a remote island in the North Sea.

questions.question_text: Where does Hagrid hide his giant half-brother Grawp during Order of the Phoenix?
questions.explanation: Hagrid secretly keeps his half-brother Grawp hidden in a clearing deep within the Forbidden Forest.

questions.question_text: What is the name of the statue at the center of the Ministry of Magic's Atrium, before it is destroyed?
questions.explanation: The Fountain of Magical Brethren stood in the Ministry Atrium until it was destroyed during Dumbledore and Voldemort's duel.

questions.question_text: In which underground courtroom is Harry's disciplinary hearing held in Order of the Phoenix?
questions.explanation: Harry's hearing for using underage magic is unusually held before the full Wizengamot in Courtroom Ten.

questions.question_text: At what Diagon Alley street number is Weasleys' Wizard Wheezes located?
questions.explanation: Weasleys' Wizard Wheezes opens for business at Number 93, Diagon Alley.

questions.question_text: Inside the Chamber of Secrets, the basilisk emerges from the mouth of a statue depicting whom?
questions.explanation: A towering stone statue of Salazar Slytherin dominates the Chamber of Secrets, and the basilisk emerges from its mouth.

questions.question_text: Which magical beings claim the depths of the Forbidden Forest as their territory, holding councils there?
questions.explanation: Centaur herds, including Firenze, Bane, and Magorian, live within and protect their territory in the Forbidden Forest.

questions.question_text: What is the name of the St. Mungo's ward that houses long-term spell damage patients, including Neville's parents?
questions.explanation: The Janus Thickey Ward at St. Mungo's cares for patients with permanent spell damage, such as Frank and Alice Longbottom.

questions.question_text: How do the Beauxbatons students travel to Hogwarts for the Triwizard Tournament?
questions.correct_answer: In a giant flying carriage pulled by winged horses
distractors: By Portkey directly into the Great Hall
questions.explanation: Beauxbatons arrives in an enormous powder-blue carriage drawn by Abraxan winged horses.

questions.question_text: How do the Durmstrang students travel to Hogwarts for the Triwizard Tournament?
questions.correct_answer: By ship, which rises from the lake
distractors: By a fleet of enchanted sledges
questions.explanation: The Durmstrang delegation arrives dramatically aboard a ship that surfaces from the Black Lake.

questions.question_text: Where is the hedge maze for the Triwizard Tournament's third task constructed?
questions.explanation: A towering hedge maze is grown directly on the Hogwarts Quidditch pitch for the tournament's final task.

questions.question_text: Where is the enclosure built to house the dragons for the Triwizard Tournament's first task?
questions.correct_answer: A cordoned-off area near the Forbidden Forest
questions.explanation: The four dragons for the first task are kept in a rocky, guarded enclosure near the edge of the Forbidden Forest.

questions.question_text: What is the name of the small station where students disembark from the Hogwarts Express?
questions.explanation: Students arrive at Hogsmeade Station before traveling the rest of the way to the castle.

questions.question_text: What is the name of the Hogsmeade shop that sells magical instruments and equipment, such as Sneakoscopes?
questions.explanation: Dervish and Banges in Hogsmeade sells magical instruments, including the Sneakoscope Ron gives Harry.

questions.question_text: Where is Dobby the house-elf buried after his death in Deathly Hallows?
questions.correct_answer: In the garden at Shell Cottage
questions.explanation: Harry digs Dobby's grave by hand in the garden of Shell Cottage, Bill and Fleur's home.

questions.question_text: Where are Ollivander, Luna Lovegood, and Griphook held captive in Deathly Hallows?
questions.correct_answer: In the cellar of Malfoy Manor
distractors: In a cell at the Ministry
In an attic at Grimmauld Place
questions.explanation: Several prisoners, including Ollivander and Luna, are kept in the cellar beneath Malfoy Manor.

questions.question_text: What magical creature guards the deepest, most secure vaults at Gringotts?
questions.explanation: A chained, half-blind dragon guards the high-security vaults at Gringotts, later ridden out by the trio.

questions.question_text: What charms does the Ministry use to disguise the massive Quidditch World Cup campsite from Muggles?
questions.explanation: The Ministry uses Muggle-Repelling Charms so the huge tent city hosting the World Cup goes unnoticed by nearby Muggles.

questions.question_text: Which level of the Ministry of Magic houses the Auror office, part of the Department of Magical Law Enforcement?
questions.explanation: Level Two of the Ministry houses the Department of Magical Law Enforcement, including the Auror office.

questions.question_text: In the Department of Mysteries, what is the name of the circular chamber filled with ticking clocks and a giant bell jar?
questions.explanation: The Time Room contains countless clocks and a bell jar holding an egg that cycles into a hummingbird and back.

questions.question_text: In which Department of Mysteries room is Ron attacked after touching a floating brain?
questions.explanation: Ron is entangled by thought-ribbons after touching one of the brains in tanks within the Brain Room.

questions.question_text: Which St. Mungo's ward treats Arthur Weasley after he is bitten by Nagini in Order of the Phoenix?
questions.correct_answer: The Dai Llewellyn Ward for Serious Bites
questions.explanation: Arthur Weasley is treated for his snake bite on the ward for creature-induced injuries at St. Mungo's.

questions.question_text: What unusual white creatures roam the grounds of Malfoy Manor?
questions.explanation: Albino peacocks are seen strutting the grounds of Malfoy Manor in Half-Blood Prince and Deathly Hallows.

questions.question_text: Where in the Forbidden Forest do the centaurs drag Dolores Umbridge after she insults them?
questions.correct_answer: Deeper into the forest, to their territory
distractors: To the edge of the Quidditch pitch
questions.explanation: After insulting the centaurs, Umbridge is carried off by the herd, deep into the Forbidden Forest.

questions.question_text: A hidden passage behind a portrait in which Hogsmeade building connects to the Room of Requirement, as used in Deathly Hallows?
questions.explanation: Aberforth's portrait of Ariana in the Hog's Head conceals a passage leading directly into the Room of Requirement.

questions.question_text: Gringotts Wizarding Bank is famously described as being built from what material?
questions.explanation: Gringotts' grand facade is built of gleaming white marble, towering over the rest of Diagon Alley.

questions.question_text: Which Hogwarts founder built the Chamber of Secrets?
questions.explanation: Salazar Slytherin secretly built the Chamber of Secrets before leaving Hogwarts after disagreements with the other founders.

questions.question_text: In which general region of France is Beauxbatons Academy of Magic believed to be located?
questions.correct_answer: The south of France, near the Pyrenees
distractors: In the French Alps near Switzerland
questions.explanation: Beauxbatons is generally understood to be located in southern France, though its exact site is kept secret.

questions.question_text: In which general region is Durmstrang Institute believed to be located?
questions.explanation: Durmstrang's exact location is a closely guarded secret, but it is generally placed somewhere in far northern Europe.

questions.question_text: What household pest infests the curtains of the drawing room at Grimmauld Place, which the Order must clear out?
questions.explanation: The Order of the Phoenix spends time clearing an infestation of doxies from the drawing-room curtains at Grimmauld Place.

questions.question_text: Who is the matron in charge of the Hospital Wing at Hogwarts?
questions.explanation: Madam Pomfrey runs the Hospital Wing, treating students for everything from Quidditch injuries to curses.

questions.question_text: At the start of term in Half-Blood Prince, where does Harry first meet Horace Slughorn, before the Hogwarts Express even departs?
questions.correct_answer: At the home of Tonks's parents
distractors: In the prefects' carriage on the train
In Slughorn's compartment on the Hogwarts Express
questions.explanation: Dumbledore first takes Harry to meet Slughorn at the home of Tonks's parents, persuading the retired professor to return to Hogwarts, before term begins.

questions.question_text: Before opening their Diagon Alley shop, where did Fred and George run their early joke-item mail-order business?
questions.correct_answer: Out of their bedroom at the Burrow
distractors: Out of a rented stall in Hogsmeade
Out of the Hogwarts common room
Out of a warehouse in London
questions.explanation: Fred and George sold their early joke inventions by owl-order, operating out of their room at the Burrow before opening a shop.
questions.source_ref: Established from Order of the Phoenix

questions.question_text: What tiny symbol is engraved on the tap of the sink that conceals the entrance to the Chamber of Secrets?
questions.explanation: A miniature snake engraved on one of the sink's taps marks the hidden entrance to the Chamber of Secrets.

questions.question_text: In which family's Gringotts vault is Helga Hufflepuff's cup hidden as a Horcrux?
questions.explanation: Bellatrix Lestrange's family vault at Gringotts secretly holds Helga Hufflepuff's cup, one of Voldemort's Horcruxes.

questions.question_text: What must someone do outside a blank stretch of wall on the seventh floor to summon the Room of Requirement as Dumbledore's Army's headquarters?
questions.correct_answer: Pace back and forth three times while thinking of what they need
distractors: Knock three times and state a password
Tap the wall with a wand while whispering 'Requirement'
Wait for the room to appear at midnight
questions.explanation: The Room of Requirement appears only after someone paces past its hidden entrance three times, concentrating on their need.

questions.question_text: After the sink opens in Moaning Myrtle's bathroom, how do Harry and Ron actually descend into the Chamber of Secrets?
questions.correct_answer: They slide down a long, slimy pipe
distractors: They climb down a rope ladder
They are lowered by a levitation charm
They walk down a spiral staircase
questions.explanation: Once the entrance opens, Harry and Ron slide down a long, dark, slime-covered pipe deep beneath the school.

questions.question_text: In which location does Severus Snape die in Deathly Hallows?
questions.explanation: Snape is killed by Nagini on Voldemort's orders inside the Shrieking Shack, where he gives Harry his memories.

questions.question_text: After being struck by Voldemort's final Killing Curse, Harry experiences a vision of an afterlife resembling which real location?
questions.explanation: In an ethereal limbo resembling a bright, empty King's Cross Station, Harry speaks with Dumbledore after Voldemort's curse.

questions.question_text: How many people can the enchanted boat crossing the underground lake in Voldemort's Horcrux cave carry at once?
questions.explanation: The boat in the Horcrux cave is bewitched to carry only a single passenger, forcing Dumbledore to make Harry cross separately.

questions.question_text: The Ravenclaw ghost known as the Grey Lady is revealed to be the spirit of which historical figure?
distractors: A servant who died at Hogwarts
questions.explanation: The Grey Lady, haunting Ravenclaw Tower, is revealed in Deathly Hallows to be Helena, daughter of Rowena Ravenclaw.

questions.question_text: What object, originally left behind in the Chamber of Secrets, does Ron use to destroy a Horcrux in Deathly Hallows?
questions.explanation: Ron retrieves a basilisk fang from the Chamber of Secrets' remains to destroy Hufflepuff's cup Horcrux.

questions.question_text: In the drawing room of Malfoy Manor, what creature is kept enchanted to float in a cage above the dining table?
questions.explanation: Voldemort keeps Nagini suspended in an enchanted, floating cage above the table in Malfoy Manor's drawing room.

questions.question_text: What architectural quirk of a Hogwarts staircase does Neville Longbottom repeatedly forget, to his frustration?
distractors: A staircase that only moves at midnight
A step that only appears for Slytherins
A staircase that leads nowhere on Tuesdays
questions.explanation: One of the Hogwarts staircases has a trick step that vanishes if you forget to jump it, something Neville often forgets.

questions.question_text: According to the Marauder's Map, how many secret passages are shown leading out of Hogwarts at the start of Prisoner of Azkaban?
questions.explanation: The Marauder's Map reveals seven secret passages leading out of the school, some already caved in or watched.

questions.question_text: The Vanishing Cabinet inside the Room of Requirement is magically paired with an identical cabinet located where?
questions.correct_answer: Borgin and Burkes, in Knockturn Alley
questions.explanation: The two Vanishing Cabinets, one at Hogwarts and one at Borgin and Burkes, form a linked pair that Draco exploits in Half-Blood Prince.

questions.question_text: Where does the flying Ford Anglia crash after Ron and Harry arrive late to school in Chamber of Secrets?
questions.explanation: The out-of-control flying car smashes into the Whomping Willow, which promptly attacks it.

questions.question_text: What statue replaces the Fountain of Magical Brethren in the Ministry Atrium once the Death Eaters seize control in Deathly Hallows?
questions.explanation: The propagandistic 'Magic is Might' statue, depicting wizards enthroned on carved Muggles, replaces the old fountain under the new regime.

questions.question_text: What uncontrollable magical fire does Vincent Crabbe unleash inside the Room of Requirement during the Battle of Hogwarts?
questions.explanation: Crabbe's attempt to use Fiendfyre against Harry spirals out of control, engulfing the Room of Requirement.

questions.question_text: During the Battle of Hogwarts, the Great Hall's house tables are pushed aside so the room can serve what purpose?
questions.correct_answer: As a place to tend the wounded and lay out the dead
distractors: As a holding cell for captured Death Eaters
questions.explanation: With the house tables cleared, the Great Hall becomes a space to care for the injured and mourn the fallen during the battle.

questions.question_text: In which numbered Hogwarts greenhouse are the Mandrakes grown in Chamber of Secrets?
questions.explanation: Professor Sprout grows the Mandrakes needed to cure the Petrified students in Greenhouse Three.

questions.question_text: What macabre decorations line the staircase walls of Number Twelve, Grimmauld Place?
questions.correct_answer: The mounted, severed heads of former house-elves
distractors: Portraits of every disowned family member
Suits of armor from dueling ancestors
questions.explanation: A row of stuffed house-elf heads, mounted like hunting trophies, lines the staircase at Grimmauld Place, a Black family tradition.

questions.question_text: Aside from the visitor telephone box, how do most Ministry of Magic employees enter the building each day?
questions.correct_answer: Via fireplaces, using the Floo Network
distractors: Through a hidden Apparition point in the Atrium
By walking through Diagon Alley's back wall
questions.explanation: Ministry staff typically arrive for work through a bank of fireplaces connected to the Floo Network.
questions.source_ref: Established from Order of the Phoenix

questions.question_text: In Deathly Hallows, what does the war memorial statue in Godric's Hollow's square transform into as Harry approaches it?
questions.correct_answer: A statue of James, Lily, and baby Harry
distractors: A statue of the four Hogwarts founders
A memorial listing names of the fallen
questions.explanation: The stone war memorial in Godric's Hollow reveals itself, under a wizard's gaze, as a hidden statue of the Potter family.

questions.question_text: Whose house in Godric's Hollow turns out to be a trap, with Nagini disguised as its elderly resident?
questions.explanation: Harry and Hermione are lured into Bathilda Bagshot's house, where Nagini is concealed inside the old woman's reanimated body.

questions.question_text: By the time Harry visits Godric's Hollow in Deathly Hallows, what has become of his parents' ruined cottage?
questions.correct_answer: It has been left standing as a partial ruin, covered with visitors' messages
distractors: It was completely demolished by the Ministry
It was rebuilt as a museum
It was purchased and renovated by a Muggle family
questions.explanation: The Potters' cottage remains a partial ruin, preserved and covered in messages left by well-wishers over the years.

questions.question_text: At whose grave does Peter Pettigrew perform the ritual that resurrects Voldemort in Goblet of Fire?
distractors: The grave of an unknown Muggle
questions.explanation: The rebirthing ritual takes place in the Little Hangleton graveyard at the grave of Voldemort's Muggle father, Tom Riddle Sr.

questions.question_text: Which Weasley is carried into the Chamber of Secrets and left near death by Tom Riddle's diary?
questions.explanation: Possessed by Tom Riddle's diary, Ginny Weasley is drawn into the Chamber of Secrets and left barely alive.

questions.question_text: According to the explanation given in Prisoner of Azkaban, why was the Shrieking Shack originally built?
questions.correct_answer: To give Remus Lupin a safe, isolated place to transform during the full moon
distractors: As a secret Ministry safe house
questions.explanation: The Shrieking Shack was built to provide a hidden, secure place for Lupin's transformations while he attended Hogwarts.

questions.question_text: What chore involving the garden do Harry, Ron, and Hermione perform at the Burrow in Chamber of Secrets?
questions.explanation: The trio spends part of a summer afternoon de-gnoming the Burrow's garden, flinging gnomes over the hedge.

questions.question_text: Which level of the Ministry of Magic houses the Department of Mysteries?
questions.explanation: The Department of Mysteries, staffed by the secretive Unspeakables, is located on Level Nine of the Ministry.

questions.question_text: St. Mungo's Hospital is hidden behind the facade of which fictitious defunct department store?
questions.explanation: St. Mungo's entrance is disguised as the shopfront of a run-down, seemingly closed department store, Purge and Dowse Ltd.

questions.question_text: Where do Fred and George Weasley live after opening their joke shop?
questions.correct_answer: In a flat above Weasleys' Wizard Wheezes
distractors: In a rented room in Hogsmeade
questions.explanation: Fred and George take up residence in the flat above their shop in Diagon Alley.

questions.question_text: During Deathly Hallows, the Weasleys' ghoul is disguised in the attic of the Burrow to impersonate which family member?
questions.explanation: To explain Ron's absence from school, the family ghoul is dressed up in the attic to pose as Ron suffering from spattergroit.

questions.question_text: Courtroom Ten, used for Harry's disciplinary hearing, is notable for being located where in the Ministry?
questions.correct_answer: In the old dungeons, below the usual courtrooms
distractors: On the same floor as the Minister's office
questions.explanation: Courtroom Ten lies in the Ministry's old dungeon level, unused for decades before Harry's hearing is unusually held there.

questions.question_text: According to the sign in its shop window, since what year has Ollivanders been 'Makers of Fine Wands'?
questions.explanation: Ollivanders' shop window famously boasts that it has made fine wands since 382 BC.

questions.question_text: What does the verse engraved on Gringotts' entrance doors warn awaits those who steal from the bank?
questions.correct_answer: A punishment far worse than they could imagine
distractors: A lifetime ban from Diagon Alley
A curse that turns thieves to stone
questions.explanation: The inscription on Gringotts' doors warns that thieves will find a fate 'worse than fire' awaiting them within.

questions.question_text: Where is Buckbeak the Hippogriff kept while awaiting his execution hearing in Prisoner of Azkaban?
questions.correct_answer: Tethered near Hagrid's pumpkin patch, by his hut
distractors: In a paddock beside the greenhouses
Chained in the Care of Magical Creatures classroom
questions.explanation: Buckbeak is tied up near Hagrid's hut, in his pumpkin patch, while the Committee decides his fate.

questions.question_text: What is the name of the elevated VIP seating area at the Quidditch World Cup final, where Harry sits near the Minister for Magic?
questions.explanation: Harry and the Weasleys watch the Quidditch World Cup final from the Top Box, seated near dignitaries including the Minister.

questions.question_text: Where is the Sorting Hat kept for most of the year, when it is not being used for the Sorting Ceremony?
questions.correct_answer: On a shelf in the headmaster's office
questions.explanation: The Sorting Hat resides on a shelf in the headmaster's office between school years and ceremonies.

questions.question_text: What causes a tunnel cave-in that separates Ron from Harry and Lockhart inside the Chamber of Secrets?
questions.correct_answer: Lockhart's backfiring Memory Charm, cast with Ron's broken wand
distractors: A basilisk strike against the tunnel wall
An explosion from Ron's wand malfunctioning naturally
questions.explanation: Lockhart attempts to Obliviate Harry and Ron using Ron's damaged wand, and the spell backfires, bringing down the tunnel.

questions.question_text: Which floor of St. Mungo's houses the Artefact Accidents ward?
questions.explanation: St. Mungo's ground floor handles Artefact Accidents, alongside the hospital's welcome desk.

questions.question_text: Which floor of St. Mungo's houses the Potion and Plant Poisoning ward?
questions.explanation: Potion and Plant Poisoning cases are treated on the third floor of St. Mungo's Hospital.

questions.question_text: In which English county is Malfoy Manor located?
questions.explanation: Malfoy Manor, the Malfoy family's grand estate, is located in Wiltshire.

questions.question_text: In which English county is the Weasley family's home, the Burrow, located?
questions.explanation: The Burrow sits in the Devon countryside, near the village of Ottery St Catchpole.

questions.question_text: To protect it from Muggle intrusion, Hogwarts castle appears to non-magical visitors as what?
questions.correct_answer: A dangerous ruin covered in warning signs
questions.explanation: Powerful enchantments make Hogwarts appear to Muggles as a ruin unsafe to enter, keeping them away.

questions.question_text: The Leaky Cauldron is described as sitting on which real London street?
questions.explanation: The Leaky Cauldron pub, gateway to Diagon Alley, is tucked between shops on Charing Cross Road.

questions.question_text: Number Twelve, Grimmauld Place is hidden between which two ordinary Muggle house numbers?
questions.explanation: Protected by the Fidelius Charm, Number Twelve sits invisibly between Muggle houses Eleven and Thirteen.

questions.question_text: Which level of the Ministry of Magic houses the Minister for Magic's own office?
questions.explanation: The Minister for Magic's office sits at the very top of the Ministry's internal hierarchy, on Level One.

questions.question_text: How do Ron and Hermione manage to reopen the entrance to the Chamber of Secrets in Deathly Hallows?
questions.correct_answer: Ron imitates Parseltongue to open the entrance
distractors: Hermione translates the inscription with a spell
They use the Sword of Gryffindor to force it open
Kreacher opens it with a house-elf's magic
questions.explanation: Ron surprises Hermione by successfully hissing in Parseltongue, learned from watching Harry, to reopen the Chamber's entrance.

questions.question_text: Where do the Beauxbatons students sleep during their stay at Hogwarts for the Triwizard Tournament?
distractors: In a guest wing of the castle
questions.explanation: The Beauxbatons delegation stays aboard their own carriage rather than in the castle itself during the tournament.

questions.question_text: Which Quidditch team's posters famously cover the walls of Ron Weasley's bedroom at the Burrow?
questions.explanation: Ron's bedroom at the Burrow is decorated with posters of his beloved, perpetually underperforming Chudley Cannons.

questions.question_text: What sequence of taps on the bricks opens the wall between the Leaky Cauldron's courtyard and Diagon Alley?
questions.explanation: Hagrid taps the correct brick pattern, three up and two across, to open the entrance to Diagon Alley.

questions.question_text: Where must Hogwarts prefects report at the start of each term aboard the Hogwarts Express?
questions.explanation: Prefects are required to report to a designated prefects' carriage on the train for instructions each term.

questions.question_text: According to Kreacher's account in Deathly Hallows, where was the real Slytherin locket Horcrux kept for years before it was nearly discarded?
questions.correct_answer: In a cabinet at Number Twelve, Grimmauld Place
distractors: Hidden in the Room of Requirement
questions.explanation: Kreacher reveals he kept the real locket in a drawer at Grimmauld Place for years, until Mundungus Fletcher stole it during the Order's house-clearing.

questions.question_text: The Fountain of Magical Brethren in the Ministry Atrium is destroyed during which confrontation?
questions.correct_answer: Dumbledore's duel with Voldemort at the end of Order of the Phoenix
distractors: The Battle of the Department of Mysteries hallway
questions.explanation: The Atrium's grand fountain statue is smashed to pieces during the climactic Ministry duel between Dumbledore and Voldemort.

questions.question_text: In the Hall of Prophecy, on which numbered row does Harry find the shelf holding the prophecy about himself and Voldemort?
questions.explanation: Harry locates the prophecy concerning himself and Voldemort on Row ninety-seven of the towering Hall of Prophecy.

questions.question_text: Roughly how many Death Eaters escape during the mass breakout from Azkaban depicted in Order of the Phoenix?
questions.explanation: A mass breakout frees around ten Death Eaters from Azkaban, including Bellatrix Lestrange, as the Ministry struggles to respond.

questions.question_text: In the Little Hangleton graveyard, what does Harry hide behind while Voldemort is reborn in Goblet of Fire?
questions.explanation: Bound to a statue's plinth and forced to watch, Harry is at one point concealed near a large stone angel in the graveyard.

questions.question_text: According to Dumbledore, a permanently locked room in the Department of Mysteries holds a force considered more mysterious than even death. What is it devoted to?
distractors: The boundary between life and death
questions.explanation: Dumbledore tells Harry that the sealed room holds a force 'more wonderful and more terrible than death' — love itself.

questions.question_text: On which floor of Hogwarts is the entrance to the Room of Requirement located?
questions.explanation: The Room of Requirement's hidden entrance lies on the seventh floor, opposite a particular tapestry.

questions.question_text: What scene does the tapestry opposite the Room of Requirement's entrance depict?
questions.correct_answer: Barnabas the Barmy trying to teach trolls ballet
distractors: The founding of the four houses
A unicorn being tamed by a witch
The signing of the International Statute of Secrecy
questions.explanation: A tapestry showing Barnabas the Barmy's ill-fated attempt to teach trolls ballet hangs opposite the Room of Requirement.

questions.question_text: What does Harry discover decorating the walls of Sirius Black's childhood bedroom at Grimmauld Place?
questions.correct_answer: Gryffindor banners and Muggle motorcycle/pin-up posters
distractors: A shrine to the Black family's pure-blood ancestry
Photographs of James Potter as a child
Slytherin memorabilia left over from his parents
questions.explanation: Sirius's old room reveals his teenage rebellion against his family, plastered with Gryffindor colors and Muggle motorcycle posters.

questions.question_text: Besides Sirius, whose name is also notably burned off the Black family tapestry at Grimmauld Place for marrying a Muggle-born?
questions.explanation: Andromeda's name is scorched from the tapestry alongside Sirius's, disowned for marrying the Muggle-born Ted Tonks.

questions.question_text: Who first discovers the decades-old murders of the Riddle family at the Riddle House in Little Hangleton?
questions.correct_answer: Frank Bryce, the family's gardener and caretaker
questions.explanation: Frank Bryce, long suspected but never charged, is the caretaker who discovered the Riddle family's bodies decades earlier.

questions.question_text: What comically named product does Weasleys' Wizard Wheezes prominently advertise in its shop window during Half-Blood Prince?
questions.correct_answer: U-No-Poo, the Constipation Sensation That's Gripping the Nation
distractors: Skiving Snackboxes, Guaranteed to Get You Out of Class
Portable Swamps, Bring the Bog to You
Weasley Whiz-bangs, Now With Extra Bang
questions.explanation: A giant display for 'U-No-Poo' dominates the shop's window, a joke product punning on Voldemort's 'You-Know-Who' nickname.

questions.question_text: In the graveyard duel at the end of Goblet of Fire, what phenomenon causes echoes of Voldemort's past victims to emerge from his wand?
questions.explanation: Because their wands share a phoenix feather core, the connection causes Priori Incantatem, releasing echoes of Voldemort's past victims.

questions.question_text: What magical creatures illuminate the rose garden outside the Great Hall during the Yule Ball in Goblet of Fire?
questions.explanation: Strings of fairy lights, actual live fairies, decorate the rose bushes in the garden during the Yule Ball.

questions.question_text: In which Ministry department does Percy Weasley take his first job after leaving Hogwarts?
questions.correct_answer: The Department of International Magical Cooperation
distractors: The Department of Magical Law Enforcement
The Department of Magical Games and Sports
questions.explanation: Percy begins his Ministry career working under Barty Crouch Sr. in the Department of International Magical Cooperation.

questions.question_text: Where is the message 'THE CHAMBER OF SECRETS HAS BEEN OPENED. ENEMIES OF THE HEIR, BEWARE' first discovered?
questions.correct_answer: On the wall of a second-floor corridor, near the petrified Mrs. Norris
distractors: Carved into the door of Moaning Myrtle's bathroom
On the floor of the Great Hall
questions.explanation: The ominous message appears written in blood-like liquid on a corridor wall, beside Mrs. Norris's petrified body.

questions.question_text: Via Dumbledore's Pensieve, Harry witnesses the trials of Karkaroff and Ludo Bagman held in what kind of Ministry chamber?
distractors: The Department of Mysteries' Death Chamber
questions.explanation: Dumbledore's Pensieve memories show Harry the Wizengamot courtroom proceedings against Igor Karkaroff and Ludo Bagman.

questions.question_text: What is the name of the cramped, doily-covered Hogsmeade tea shop where Harry has an awkward Valentine's date with Cho Chang?
questions.explanation: Harry's uncomfortable date with Cho takes place at Madam Puddifoot's, a famously frilly, romance-themed Hogsmeade tea shop.

questions.question_text: What dangerous magical item does Xenophilius Lovegood keep in his house, mistaking it for a Crumple-Horned Snorkack horn?
questions.explanation: The supposed Snorkack horn Xenophilius keeps turns out to be a highly explosive Erumpent horn, which detonates during the trio's visit.

questions.question_text: What sinister item does Draco Malfoy purchase from Borgin and Burkes for use as a would-be assassin's tool in Half-Blood Prince?
questions.explanation: Draco is seen purchasing a Hand of Glory, a tool useful for a thief operating unseen in the dark, from Borgin and Burkes.

questions.question_text: On which street in Little Whinging does Arabella Figg, Harry's cat-loving neighbor, live?
questions.explanation: Mrs. Figg, who secretly watches over Harry for the Order, lives nearby on Wisteria Walk in Little Whinging.

questions.question_text: What lasting magical prank do Fred and George leave behind in a Hogwarts corridor during their dramatic departure in Order of the Phoenix?
distractors: A cloud of fireworks that never fades
questions.explanation: As a parting gift to Umbridge's regime, Fred and George conjure a swamp in a school corridor before flying off on their brooms.

questions.question_text: Which Hogwarts professor is said to preserve a portion of Fred and George's corridor swamp as a keepsake, per Half-Blood Prince?
questions.explanation: Half-Blood Prince notes that Flitwick kept a cordoned-off patch of the twins' swamp prank rather than removing it entirely.

questions.question_text: What is the name of the Diagon Alley shop that sells scales, telescopes, and other Potions and Astronomy equipment?
questions.explanation: Wiseacre's Wizarding Equipment supplies students with scales, telescopes, and other required school instruments.

questions.question_text: Which Ministry department, headed by Ludo Bagman, organizes events like the Triwizard Tournament and Quidditch World Cup?
questions.correct_answer: The Department of Magical Games and Sports
distractors: The Department of International Magical Cooperation
The Department of Magical Law Enforcement
The Improper Use of Magic Office
questions.explanation: Ludo Bagman heads the Department of Magical Games and Sports, responsible for organizing major magical sporting events.

questions.question_text: At the start of Order of the Phoenix, Molly Weasley deals with a Boggart hidden inside a wardrobe in which house?
questions.explanation: Molly Weasley confronts a Boggart that has taken up residence in an upstairs wardrobe at the Burrow.

questions.question_text: What five-digit code, spelling a word, must be dialed on the visitors' telephone box to enter the Ministry of Magic?
questions.explanation: Dialing 6-2-4-4-2, which spells 'MAGIC' on the phone's dial, grants entry to the Ministry through the visitors' entrance.

questions.question_text: Why can't wizards simply Apparate directly into Azkaban prison?
questions.correct_answer: The island is warded against Apparition and other means of unauthorized entry
distractors: Dementors block all incoming magic automatically
It's protected only by an Unplottable charm
The prison exists in a separate time stream
questions.explanation: Azkaban's protective enchantments prevent Apparition onto the island, so it must be reached by boat.

questions.question_text: Where is the very first organizational meeting of Dumbledore's Army held?
questions.explanation: Harry, Ron, and Hermione first gather interested students at the Hog's Head to discuss forming Dumbledore's Army.

questions.question_text: How do most guests travel to the Burrow for Bill and Fleur's wedding in Deathly Hallows?
distractors: By Apparating directly onto the lawn
questions.explanation: Wedding guests arrive at the Burrow via a series of Portkeys arranged for the occasion.

questions.question_text: Where does Sirius Black secretly keep Buckbeak hidden inside Number Twelve, Grimmauld Place during Order of the Phoenix?
questions.correct_answer: In his late mother's old bedroom upstairs
distractors: In the kitchen, tied to the table
In the drawing room, beside the tapestry
In the cellar, near the wine racks
questions.explanation: To keep Buckbeak safe after his rescue, Sirius hides the Hippogriff upstairs in his mother's former bedroom.

questions.question_text: The graveyard where Voldemort is reborn in Goblet of Fire adjoins what kind of building?
questions.explanation: The graveyard used for Voldemort's rebirth ritual sits beside an old church on the edge of Little Hangleton.

questions.question_text: Roughly how many members typically sit on the full Wizengamot, as suggested during Harry's disciplinary hearing?
distractors: Just the Minister and department heads
questions.explanation: Harry's unusual full hearing before the entire Wizengamot suggests a body of around fifty members.

questions.question_text: Trapped in the Chamber of Secrets, how does Harry ultimately obtain the Sword of Gryffindor to fight the basilisk?
questions.correct_answer: The Sorting Hat produces it after Fawkes the phoenix delivers the hat to him
distractors: Dumbledore Apparates it directly to him
He finds it already lying in the Chamber
Ginny hands it to him before losing consciousness
questions.explanation: Fawkes brings Harry the Sorting Hat, from which the Sword of Gryffindor emerges just in time to battle the basilisk.

questions.question_text: What happens to Dumbledore's hand after he removes the cursed Gaunt ring from its hiding place?
questions.correct_answer: It becomes blackened, withered, and ultimately fatally cursed
distractors: It temporarily loses all feeling but heals fully
It transforms briefly into a snake's claw
It bursts into flame and is regrown by Madam Pomfrey
questions.explanation: Retrieving the ring Horcrux from the Gaunt shack, Dumbledore is struck by a curse that blackens and withers his hand.

questions.question_text: In which Diagon Alley shop do Arthur Weasley and Lucius Malfoy get into a physical brawl in Chamber of Secrets?
distractors: Madam Malkin's Robes for All Occasions
questions.explanation: A chance encounter at Flourish and Blotts erupts into a fistfight between Arthur Weasley and Lucius Malfoy.

questions.question_text: What form do interoffice memos take as they fly through the halls of the Ministry of Magic?
questions.explanation: Ministry memos are enchanted to fold themselves into paper airplanes and zoom through the corridors to their recipients.

questions.question_text: Besides a witch and wizard, which other magical beings are depicted in the Ministry Atrium's Fountain of Magical Brethren?
questions.correct_answer: A centaur, a goblin, and a house-elf
distractors: A giant, a hag, and a merperson
A dragon, a phoenix, and a unicorn
questions.explanation: The fountain's statue group shows a witch and wizard flanked by a centaur, a goblin, and a house-elf, gazing up adoringly.

questions.question_text: How many years had passed since the Chamber of Secrets was last opened, prior to the events of Chamber of Secrets?
questions.explanation: The Chamber of Secrets had lain closed for fifty years, since Hagrid was wrongly blamed for the earlier attacks.

questions.question_text: Where does Hagrid grow the enormous pumpkins used to decorate the Great Hall for Halloween?
questions.correct_answer: In the pumpkin patch beside his hut
questions.explanation: Hagrid tends a pumpkin patch next to his hut, growing the massive pumpkins used for Halloween decorations.

questions.question_text: According to Hermione's research for S.P.E.W. in Goblet of Fire, roughly how many house-elves work in the Hogwarts kitchens?
questions.explanation: Hermione learns that around a hundred house-elves are employed working in the Hogwarts kitchens.

questions.question_text: Besides merpeople and the giant squid, what small water-dwelling creatures also live in the Black Lake?
questions.explanation: Grindylows, minor water demons with long fingers, inhabit the Black Lake alongside merpeople and the giant squid.

questions.question_text: Where does the Weasleys' abandoned flying Ford Anglia end up living wild, as revealed later in the series?
questions.explanation: The Ford Anglia, having fled into the Forbidden Forest after Chamber of Secrets, is later glimpsed living wild there.

questions.question_text: Which Ministry office sends Harry an official warning letter for using underage magic, both in Chamber of Secrets and Order of the Phoenix?
questions.correct_answer: The Improper Use of Magic Office
questions.explanation: The Improper Use of Magic Office is responsible for issuing Harry's warnings about underage magic outside school.

questions.question_text: Whose appearance does Hermione assume via Polyjuice Potion to infiltrate Gringotts and rob the Lestrange vault in Deathly Hallows?
questions.explanation: Disguised as Bellatrix Lestrange using Polyjuice Potion, Hermione helps the trio break into her vault at Gringotts.

questions.question_text: How does Sirius Black manage to escape from Azkaban in Prisoner of Azkaban, despite the island's Dementor guards?
questions.correct_answer: He transforms into his Animagus dog form and swims away
distractors: He is smuggled out by a corrupt guard
He Apparates past the wards using a stolen wand
He is broken out by Order of the Phoenix members
questions.explanation: As an unregistered Animagus, Sirius slips through the bars of his cell as a dog and swims from the island undetected.

questions.question_text: What creatures pull the carriages carrying students from Hogsmeade Station to the castle, visible only to those who have witnessed death?
questions.explanation: The seemingly horseless carriages are in fact pulled by Thestrals, skeletal winged creatures visible only to those who have seen death.

questions.question_text: Where does Hagrid introduce his Care of Magical Creatures class to the school's resident Thestral herd?
questions.correct_answer: A clearing in the Forbidden Forest
distractors: The edge of the Black Lake
questions.explanation: Hagrid leads his class into a clearing within the Forbidden Forest to observe and feed the Thestral herd.

questions.question_text: Whom does Sirius Black name as the heir to Number Twelve, Grimmauld Place in his will?
distractors: The Order of the Phoenix collectively
questions.explanation: Sirius's will leaves his entire estate, including the house at Grimmauld Place, to his godson, Harry.

questions.question_text: How do Harry, Ron, and Hermione escape the Fiendfyre unleashed inside the Room of Requirement during the Battle of Hogwarts?
questions.correct_answer: By flying out on broomsticks that the Room provides
distractors: Through a trapdoor into the dungeons
By using the Vanishing Cabinet to Borgin and Burkes
questions.explanation: As the Room of Requirement burns, the trio escapes by flying to safety on broomsticks that appear among the room's hidden objects.

questions.question_text: What racing broomstick does Professor McGonagall arrange for Harry to receive as a first-year so he can play Quidditch?
questions.explanation: McGonagall bends the first-year broom rule after spotting Harry's flying talent, and he receives a brand-new Nimbus Two Thousand.

questions.question_text: What top-of-the-line broomstick, capable of going from zero to 150 miles per hour in ten seconds, is anonymously sent to Harry as a Christmas gift?
distractors: The Nimbus Two Thousand and One
questions.explanation: The Firebolt arrives with no name attached, later revealed to be a gift from Sirius Black.

questions.question_text: What is the name of the large red ball that Chasers throw through the hoops to score ten points in Quidditch?
questions.explanation: The Quaffle is the main scoring ball of Quidditch, worth ten points per goal.

questions.question_text: What heavy, enchanted iron ball flies around trying to knock players off their brooms during a Quidditch match?
questions.explanation: Bludgers are batted away by Beaters to protect their teammates from injury.

questions.question_text: What collectible card, found inside packages of Chocolate Frogs, shows a photograph and biography of a famous witch or wizard?
distractors: A Drooble's Best Blowing Gum card
questions.explanation: Chocolate Frog Cards are prized by collectors like Ron, who hopes to complete his set of famous witches and wizards.

questions.question_text: What candy, sold at Hogwarts, comes in flavors that can range from chocolate to earwax or vomit?
questions.explanation: Bertie Bott's Every Flavour Beans are famous, and infamous, for including truly unpleasant flavors alongside normal ones.

questions.question_text: What warm, mildly alcoholic beverage is a favorite treat at the Three Broomsticks and the Hog's Head?
questions.explanation: Butterbeer is a popular, comforting wizarding drink enjoyed by students on Hogsmeade trips.

questions.question_text: What scarlet steam train carries students from Platform Nine and Three-Quarters to Hogwarts each September first?
questions.explanation: The Hogwarts Express departs King's Cross Station at eleven o'clock sharp every September first.

questions.question_text: What kind of enchanted letter bursts open and shouts its message in the sender's amplified voice?
questions.explanation: Mrs. Weasley famously sends Ron a Howler after he and Harry fly the Ford Anglia to Hogwarts.

questions.question_text: What object, delivered by owl, formally invites an eleven-year-old to attend Hogwarts School of Witchcraft and Wizardry?
questions.explanation: Harry's acceptance letter is addressed in emerald-green ink and, after being blocked by the Dursleys, is eventually delivered by Hagrid in person.

questions.question_text: What legendary object, created by Nicolas Flamel, can turn any metal into gold and produce the Elixir of Life?
questions.explanation: The Stone is hidden at Hogwarts for protection before Voldemort attempts to steal it through Professor Quirrell.

questions.question_text: What silver badge is pinned to the robes of a student chosen to be a Hogwarts Prefect?
questions.explanation: Prefects, chosen in their fifth year, wear a distinctive badge marking their responsibilities.

questions.question_text: What flying vehicle does Hagrid use to bring baby Harry to Privet Drive on the night his parents die?
questions.explanation: Sirius lends Hagrid his enchanted flying motorbike to carry infant Harry to safety.

questions.question_text: What flying car do Ron and Harry use to reach Hogwarts after missing the Hogwarts Express in their second year?
questions.explanation: Ron and Harry take Mr. Weasley's flying Ford Anglia when they can't get through the barrier to Platform Nine and Three-Quarters.

questions.question_text: What single item of clothing does Harry trick Lucius Malfoy into giving Dobby, thereby freeing the house-elf?
questions.explanation: Harry hides his own sock inside Tom Riddle's diary, which Lucius hands back to Dobby, unknowingly freeing him.

questions.question_text: What upgraded broomstick model does Lucius Malfoy buy for the entire Slytherin Quidditch team, including his son Draco?
questions.correct_answer: The Nimbus Two Thousand and One
questions.explanation: Malfoy buys the Slytherin team new brooms to secure his son a spot as Seeker.

questions.question_text: What clue-bearing prize does each Triwizard champion retrieve from a dragon during the tournament's first task?
questions.explanation: Each champion must get past a dragon to seize a golden egg containing a clue for the second task.

questions.question_text: What trophy, awarded to the winner of the Triwizard Tournament, is secretly turned into a Portkey during Harry's fourth year?
questions.explanation: The Triwizard Cup is transfigured into a Portkey that transports Harry and Cedric to the graveyard in Little Hangleton.

questions.question_text: What trophy is awarded at the end-of-year feast to the Hogwarts house with the most accumulated points?
questions.explanation: Gryffindor famously wins the House Cup at the last moment in Harry's first year thanks to points awarded by Dumbledore.

questions.question_text: What trophy is awarded each year to the Hogwarts house with the best-performing Quidditch team?
questions.explanation: The Quidditch Cup is a separate honor from the overall House Cup, awarded for success on the pitch.

questions.question_text: What smelly prank item, favored by mischief-makers like Peeves and students alike, releases a foul stench when thrown?
questions.explanation: Dungbombs are a classic joke item known throughout the wizarding world for their terrible smell.

questions.question_text: What brand of wet-start, no-heat fireworks is a well-known novelty item sold to wizarding pranksters?
questions.explanation: Filibuster's fireworks are a popular novelty brand known for their dramatic, safe-to-use sparks and bangs.

questions.question_text: What spectacular fireworks display, one of Fred and George's own products, fills the corridors and evades every attempt to extinguish it during their dramatic exit from Hogwarts?
questions.explanation: Fred and George set off an enormous, self-igniting fireworks display before flying out of Hogwarts on their brooms for good.

questions.question_text: What binocular-like device lets spectators at the Quidditch World Cup replay and slow down the on-field action?
questions.explanation: Omnioculars can capture and replay Quidditch plays in slow motion, and even caption them.

questions.question_text: What magical clock at the Burrow has hands for each family member instead of numbers, pointing to locations like 'home,' 'school,' or 'mortal peril'?
questions.explanation: Instead of telling the time, the Weasleys' unique clock tracks where each family member is and whether they're in danger.

questions.question_text: According to his Chocolate Frog Card, what distinguishing feature does Albus Dumbledore have that is shaped like a map of the London Underground?
questions.correct_answer: A scar above his left knee
questions.explanation: Harry reads on his first Chocolate Frog Card that Dumbledore's distinguishing feature is a scar shaped like the London Underground map.

questions.question_text: What is the name of Fred and George's joke shop that opens in Diagon Alley?
questions.explanation: The twins open their own hugely successful joke shop, funded in part by Harry's Triwizard winnings.

questions.question_text: What joke shop in Hogsmeade sells items like Dungbombs and Nose-Biting Teacups?
questions.explanation: Zonko's is the go-to joke shop for Hogwarts students before Weasleys' Wizard Wheezes opens.

questions.question_text: What Hogsmeade sweetshop has a secret passage connecting its cellar to a tunnel leading into Hogwarts?
questions.explanation: Fred and George show Harry the passage from Honeydukes' cellar as a way to sneak into Hogsmeade.

questions.question_text: What ordinary-looking object turns out to be Voldemort's first Horcrux, capable of writing back to whoever writes in it?
questions.explanation: The diary allows Ginny Weasley to interact with a memory of the young Tom Riddle, who slowly possesses her.

questions.question_text: What device does Colin Creevey use constantly to take photos of Harry Potter throughout his first year at Hogwarts?
questions.explanation: Colin, a Muggle-born fan of Harry's, snaps photos of him at every opportunity.

questions.question_text: What Care of Magical Creatures textbook is notorious for biting and attacking anyone who tries to open it the wrong way?
distractors: Fantastic Beasts and Where to Find Them
questions.explanation: The book must be stroked along its spine to be opened safely, something Hagrid never explains to his students.

questions.question_text: What series of textbooks by Miranda Goshawk teaches Hogwarts students spellwork year by year?
questions.explanation: The Standard Book of Spells is a core textbook series required for every year at Hogwarts.

questions.question_text: What hand-knitted item of clothing does Mrs. Weasley send every family member, and Harry, each Christmas?
questions.correct_answer: A Weasley jumper with the recipient's initial
questions.explanation: Molly Weasley knits a personalized sweater for each of her children, and for Harry, every year.

questions.question_text: What Honeydukes sweet is described as a sherbet ball that makes the eater levitate slightly?
questions.explanation: Fizzing Whizzbees are a popular Honeydukes item that gives a brief floating sensation.

questions.question_text: What Honeydukes sweet makes the eater's teeth chatter as their feet briefly lift off the ground?
questions.explanation: Ice Mice are one of the more unusual novelty candies sold at Honeydukes.

questions.question_text: What quill-shaped Honeydukes sweet can be discreetly sucked on during class?
questions.explanation: Sugar Quills let students appear to be taking notes while actually enjoying a sweet.

questions.question_text: What pastry, sold from the trolley on the Hogwarts Express, is one of Harry's favorite snacks?
questions.explanation: Harry buys a large pile of sweets, including Pumpkin Pasties, from the trolley witch on his first train ride to Hogwarts.

questions.question_text: What small cake, shaped like a cauldron, is sold by the trolley witch on the Hogwarts Express?
questions.explanation: Cauldron Cakes are one of the many treats available from the Hogwarts Express trolley.

questions.question_text: What game, involving giant stone pieces that physically move and destroy each other, does Ron excel at?
questions.explanation: Ron's skill at Wizard's Chess proves crucial in helping the trio get past a giant chessboard guarding the Philosopher's Stone.

questions.question_text: What card game, popular among Hogwarts students, causes the cards to explode periodically?
questions.explanation: Exploding Snap is a common pastime for students relaxing in their common rooms.

questions.question_text: What game, similar to Muggle marbles, squirts a foul-smelling liquid in a player's face when they lose a point?
questions.explanation: Gobstones is a popular wizarding game and even has its own school club at Hogwarts.

questions.question_text: What item does Hagrid carry everywhere that secretly conceals his broken wand, since he is forbidden from doing magic?
questions.explanation: Hagrid's wand was snapped when he was expelled, so he hides the pieces inside his pink umbrella and uses it to cast spells in secret.

questions.question_text: What four giant hourglasses in the Hogwarts Entrance Hall track house points using colored gems?
questions.explanation: Each house's hourglass fills with colored gems as points are awarded or empties as points are lost.

questions.question_text: What object is famously said, according to Ollivander's wandlore, to choose the wizard rather than the other way around?
questions.explanation: Ollivander tells Harry that the wand chooses the wizard, a central piece of wandlore in the series.

questions.question_text: What enchanted chocolate confection, shaped like an amphibian, will hop away if not caught quickly after being unwrapped?
questions.explanation: Chocolate Frogs are charmed to hop once, making them tricky to catch before they escape.

questions.question_text: What pewter vessel does the Hogwarts booklist require first-year students to bring for brewing potions?
questions.explanation: The first-year supply list specifically calls for a pewter cauldron, standard size 2.

questions.question_text: What part of the Basilisk does Harry use to destroy Tom Riddle's diary in the Chamber of Secrets?
questions.explanation: After stabbing the Basilisk with the Sword of Gryffindor, Harry drives one of its fangs through the diary to destroy the Horcrux within.

questions.question_text: What Christmas gift does Hermione give Harry that includes broomstick polish and a pair of clippers for trimming twigs?
questions.explanation: Hermione gives Harry a Broomstick Servicing Kit to help him maintain his Firebolt.

questions.question_text: What two-colored Skiving Snackbox sweet makes the eater vomit until they eat the other end?
questions.explanation: Puking Pastilles are one of the illness-simulating sweets Fred and George develop as part of their Skiving Snackbox line.

questions.question_text: What object does Sirius Black give Harry so the two can communicate directly while Sirius is in hiding?
questions.explanation: Sirius gives Harry a two-way mirror before the Department of Mysteries battle, though Harry doesn't use it in time to prevent Sirius's death.

questions.question_text: What prank do Fred and George install in a Hogwarts corridor as a parting gift, leaving Filch to maintain a permanently marked-off area?
questions.explanation: The twins' Portable Swamp becomes such a fixture that Filch reportedly keeps a small roped-off patch of it for years afterward.

questions.question_text: What decorative objects cover the walls of Dolores Umbridge's Hogwarts office, unsettlingly featuring images of kittens?
questions.correct_answer: Ornamental plates with moving kitten pictures
distractors: Portraits of past Ministers of Magic
questions.explanation: Umbridge's office is decorated with a collection of plates depicting kittens, which she watches move.

questions.question_text: What does Dolores Umbridge repeatedly pin to a board outside the Great Hall throughout Harry's fifth year?
questions.explanation: Umbridge issues a growing number of numbered Educational Decrees restricting student life at Hogwarts.

questions.question_text: What pair of enchanted wardrobes allows Death Eaters to be smuggled into Hogwarts in Draco Malfoy's sixth year?
questions.explanation: One Vanishing Cabinet sits in the Room of Requirement, its twin in Borgin and Burkes, and Draco repairs the connection between them.

questions.question_text: What cursed object, hidden inside a package meant for Dumbledore, injures Katie Bell when she touches it?
questions.explanation: Katie Bell is cursed after handling an opal necklace intended to kill Dumbledore, part of Draco Malfoy's assassination attempts.

questions.question_text: What poisoned drink, meant for Dumbledore via Slughorn, nearly kills Ron instead?
distractors: A cup of poisoned pumpkin juice
A vial of poisoned Polyjuice Potion
questions.explanation: Ron drinks poisoned oak-matured mead meant as a gift for Dumbledore, and is saved only by a bezoar.

questions.question_text: What secondhand textbook does Harry use in Potions class that turns out to be annotated by a mysterious 'Half-Blood Prince'?
distractors: One Thousand Magical Herbs and Fungi
questions.explanation: Harry's used copy of Advanced Potion-Making is filled with handwritten notes and improved spells from its former owner, Severus Snape.

questions.question_text: What object does Hermione enchant with a Protean Charm so that every copy displays the same updated meeting time for Dumbledore's Army?
questions.explanation: Hermione charms fake Galleons so members of Dumbledore's Army know instantly when and where the next meeting is.

questions.question_text: Where does Kreacher secretly hide the fake Horcrux locket for years before Mundungus Fletcher steals it?
questions.correct_answer: In his cupboard at Grimmauld Place
questions.explanation: Kreacher hoards stolen family objects, including the fake locket left by Regulus Black, in his cupboard.

questions.question_text: What large embroidered object at Grimmauld Place displays the Black family's genealogy, with some names burned off entirely?
questions.explanation: The tapestry shows generations of the Black family, with disowned members like Sirius burned out of the cloth.

questions.question_text: What badge does Percy Weasley proudly wear after being named Head Boy?
questions.explanation: Percy's rise to Head Boy is a point of great pride for him throughout the early books.

questions.question_text: Which Horcrux is known to cause whoever wears it for too long to feel a growing sense of dread and paranoia?
questions.explanation: The locket has a noticeably unpleasant psychological effect on whoever wears it during the Horcrux hunt.

questions.question_text: What phrase must be spoken to make the Marauder's Map first reveal its contents?
questions.correct_answer: "I solemnly swear that I am up to no good."
distractors: "I solemnly swear I mean no harm."
questions.explanation: Speaking this phrase activates the map, while 'Mischief managed' wipes it blank again.

questions.question_text: Who is revealed to have originally invented the Deluminator that Ron inherits from Dumbledore's will?
questions.explanation: Dumbledore himself invented the light-controlling device long before leaving it to Ron.

questions.question_text: What glowing glass orb, housed in the Department of Mysteries, is said to contain a recorded prophecy about Harry and Voldemort?
questions.explanation: The Hall of Prophecy stores thousands of these orbs, one of which concerns Harry and Voldemort directly.

questions.question_text: What do Death Eaters wear to disguise their identities during raids and the Battle of the Department of Mysteries?
questions.correct_answer: Silver masks and dark hooded robes
distractors: Plain black cloaks with no masks
questions.explanation: Death Eaters conceal their faces with masks and robes whenever they act as a group.

questions.question_text: What enormous shed skin do Harry and Ron discover in the Chamber of Secrets, confirming the monster's identity?
questions.explanation: The massive discarded skin confirms that the Chamber's monster is a Basilisk.

questions.question_text: After crashing into the Whomping Willow, what happens to the Weasleys' flying Ford Anglia?
questions.correct_answer: It drives off into the Forbidden Forest and goes wild
distractors: It is confiscated by the Ministry
It flies straight back to the Burrow
questions.explanation: The car survives the crash and disappears into the Forbidden Forest, later reappearing to help rescue Harry and friends from Aragog's colony.

questions.question_text: Which professor confiscates Harry's anonymously sent Firebolt to have it checked for hidden curses?
questions.explanation: McGonagall takes the unexplained Firebolt away for safety checks before eventually returning it to Harry.

questions.question_text: What Skiving Snackbox sweet, when eaten, causes a dramatic nosebleed convincing enough to get out of class?
questions.explanation: Nosebleed Nougat is one of the Weasley twins' illness-simulating products.

questions.question_text: What Weasley product temporarily transforms the eater into a canary for about a minute?
questions.explanation: Fred tests a Canary Cream on Hermione at the Burrow, briefly turning her into a canary.

questions.question_text: What joke product, part of the Weasleys' Wizard Wheezes lineup, is a laxative-themed candy whose name puns on Voldemort's alias?
questions.explanation: U-No-Poo, subtitled 'the Constipation Sensation,' is a Weasleys' Wizard Wheezes product referencing 'You-Know-Who.'

questions.question_text: What product do Harry's allies use to escape Death Eaters by plunging the area into total darkness?
questions.explanation: Peruvian Instant Darkness Powder, sold by Weasleys' Wizard Wheezes, blacks out an entire area instantly.

questions.question_text: What small Weasley invention scurries around and creates a loud bang and smoke to distract enemies?
questions.explanation: Decoy Detonators are handy for creating a diversion during tense escapes.

questions.question_text: What silver badges does Umbridge hand out to loyal students forming her Inquisitorial Squad?
questions.explanation: Umbridge rewards students like Draco Malfoy with special badges marking them as part of her enforcement squad.

questions.question_text: What do the four creators of the Marauder's Map collectively call themselves in the map's opening greeting?
questions.correct_answer: Messrs Moony, Wormtail, Padfoot, and Prongs
questions.explanation: The map greets anyone who opens it with a message from its four creators under their nicknames.

questions.question_text: What enchanted quill, used by journalist Rita Skeeter, writes exaggerated and biased articles largely on its own?
questions.explanation: Rita's Quick-Quotes Quill embellishes and distorts quotes to make her articles more sensational.

questions.question_text: What wizarding newspaper, featuring moving photographs, is read daily by most magical households?
questions.explanation: The Daily Prophet is the main wizarding newspaper throughout the series.

questions.question_text: What eccentric wizarding magazine, edited by Xenophilius Lovegood, publishes Harry's exclusive interview in his fifth year?
questions.explanation: Harry gives his side of the story to Rita Skeeter for a Quibbler interview, arranged by Luna's father.

questions.question_text: What Weasley product provides a realistic thirty-minute daydream and is popular enough to prompt an Educational Decree banning it at Hogwarts?
questions.explanation: Patented Daydream Charms become so popular among students that Umbridge bans WWW products outright.

questions.question_text: What protective gloves, made from dragon hide, do students wear when handling dangerous materials in class?
questions.explanation: Dragon-hide gloves are standard protective equipment listed on Hogwarts supply lists.

questions.question_text: What standard size of pewter cauldron does the Hogwarts booklist require students to bring for Potions class?
questions.explanation: The official supply list specifies a pewter cauldron, standard size 2, among the required equipment.

questions.question_text: What measuring instrument, required equipment for Potions class, is used to weigh out ingredients?
questions.explanation: Brass scales are listed on the Hogwarts equipment list for weighing potion ingredients.

questions.question_text: What small beaded handbag does Hermione carry throughout Harry's final year, magically expanded to hold an entire campsite's worth of supplies?
questions.explanation: Hermione's handbag is enchanted with an Undetectable Extension Charm, letting it hold far more than its size suggests.

questions.question_text: What happens to Harry's original holly and phoenix-feather wand during the escape from Malfoy Manor?
questions.correct_answer: It is broken by a stray hex
distractors: It permanently runs out of magic
questions.explanation: Hermione's Stinging Jinx, aimed at Bellatrix, ricochets and snaps Harry's original wand.

questions.question_text: What collective name is given to the Weasley twins' line of illness-simulating sweets, sold individually or as a boxed set?
questions.explanation: Skiving Snackboxes bundle several different fake-illness sweets, letting students choose their symptoms.

questions.question_text: What lime-green hat does Minister Cornelius Fudge habitually wear and nervously fiddle with?
questions.explanation: Fudge's lime-green bowler hat becomes a recognizable, almost comic detail throughout his appearances.

questions.question_text: What healing salve is used by Hermione to treat Ron's splinched arm during the trio's Horcrux hunt?
questions.explanation: Essence of Dittany is applied to Ron's severely injured arm after a botched Apparition splinches him.

questions.question_text: What immediately heals Harry's Basilisk-poisoned arm in the Chamber of Secrets, moments from what would otherwise be a fatal wound?
