questions.explanation: Fawkes weeps healing tears onto Harry's wound, saving his life just before the venom would prove fatal.

questions.question_text: What Knockturn Alley shop, which once employed a young Tom Riddle, deals in cursed and Dark magical artifacts?
questions.explanation: Tom Riddle worked at Borgin and Burkes after leaving Hogwarts, and the shop later houses the Vanishing Cabinet paired with the one at Hogwarts.

questions.question_text: What unusual core, taken from a normally invisible creature, is inside the Elder Wand?
questions.explanation: The Elder Wand's core is a Thestral tail hair, an uncommon and difficult-to-use core.

questions.question_text: What core, taken from his part-Veela grandmother, is inside Fleur Delacour's wand?
questions.explanation: Fleur's wand contains a hair from her grandmother, who was part-Veela.

questions.question_text: What legendary wandmaker, later murdered by Grindelwald's forces, crafted Viktor Krum's wand?
questions.explanation: Krum's wand, made of hornbeam and dragon heartstring, was crafted by the continental wandmaker Gregorovitch.

questions.question_text: What did Voldemort give Peter Pettigrew to replace the hand he sacrificed during the resurrection ritual?
questions.explanation: Pettigrew cuts off his own hand as part of the ritual and is given a silver replacement by Voldemort.

questions.question_text: What must Dumbledore drink to empty the basin protecting the fake locket hidden in the cave, causing him terrible pain and hallucinations?
questions.correct_answer: An unidentified potion filling the basin
questions.explanation: The potion guarding the Horcrux is never given a proper name in canon, but it forces Dumbledore to relive his worst memories as he drinks it.

questions.question_text: What symbol, which Marvolo Gaunt mistakenly believed was his own family's crest, actually marks his ring as a Deathly Hallow?
questions.correct_answer: The sign of the Deathly Hallows (the Peverell coat of arms)
distractors: The Order of the Phoenix crest
questions.explanation: The mark Marvolo shows off as a Gaunt family crest is in fact the Peverell coat of arms and the symbol of the Deathly Hallows.

questions.question_text: Whose wand does Voldemort use to murder the Riddle family before planting it on a relative to frame him?
questions.explanation: Voldemort uses Morfin's own wand to commit the murders, then alters Morfin's memory so he confesses to a crime he didn't commit.

questions.question_text: What two curses protect the treasure inside the Lestrange vault at Gringotts, causing stolen items to multiply and burn?
questions.correct_answer: The Gemino Curse and the Flagrante Curse
distractors: The Imperius Curse and the Cruciatus Curse
The Fidelius Charm and a Confundus Charm
A Freezing Charm and the Full Body-Bind Curse
questions.explanation: Anything touched inside the vault multiplies uncontrollably and grows burning hot, thanks to these two curses.

questions.question_text: According to Griphook, why does goblin-made silver like the Sword of Gryffindor pose a problem for wizard customs of ownership?
questions.correct_answer: Goblins believe such an item belongs to its maker's people forever, not whoever purchases it
distractors: It can only be wielded by purebloods
It loses its magic once sold to a wizard
It must be returned to Gringotts upon the owner's death
questions.explanation: Griphook explains that goblins consider goblin-made objects to remain goblin property regardless of wizard sale, a point of major cultural tension.

questions.question_text: What line, also found inscribed on the Peverell family grave, appears on the headstone of Harry's parents in Godric's Hollow?
questions.correct_answer: "The last enemy that shall be destroyed is death."
distractors: "Do not pity the dead, Harry. Pity the living."
questions.explanation: The same biblical phrase appears on both the Potter and Peverell graves in Godric's Hollow.

questions.question_text: What phrase is inscribed on the Golden Snitch Dumbledore leaves Harry, revealing its hidden message only when Harry accepts he is about to die?
distractors: "The last enemy that shall be destroyed is death."
questions.explanation: The Snitch opens for Harry only in the Forbidden Forest, once he has accepted his own death.

questions.question_text: Besides Fiendfyre, what substance is established as capable of destroying a Horcrux by physically damaging it beyond repair?
questions.explanation: Basilisk venom destroys Tom Riddle's diary and is later specifically sought out to destroy Hufflepuff's cup.

questions.question_text: How does Draco Malfoy become the Elder Wand's true master without ever laying a hand on the wand itself?
questions.correct_answer: By disarming Dumbledore atop the Astronomy Tower
distractors: By killing Dumbledore with the Killing Curse
By stealing it from Dumbledore's tomb
By inheriting it through Dumbledore's will
questions.explanation: Wandlore holds that defeating a wand's owner in combat, even by disarming rather than killing, transfers its allegiance.

questions.question_text: How does the Elder Wand's true allegiance ultimately pass to Harry Potter?
questions.correct_answer: By Harry disarming Draco Malfoy at Malfoy Manor
distractors: By Harry defeating Voldemort in single combat
By Harry inheriting it from Dumbledore's tomb
By Harry winning it from Grindelwald
questions.explanation: Because Harry had already disarmed Draco, the wand's allegiance was his even before he possessed it.

questions.question_text: What wood is Dumbledore's wand, later revealed to be one of the Deathly Hallows, made from?
questions.explanation: Dumbledore's wand is made of elder wood, matching the common name for the Deathly Hallow it turns out to be.

questions.question_text: From which continental wandmaker does a young Gellert Grindelwald steal the Elder Wand?
questions.explanation: Grindelwald steals the Elder Wand from Gregorovitch before fleeing to build his own following.

questions.question_text: After using the Resurrection Stone one last time in the Forbidden Forest, what does Harry do with it?
questions.correct_answer: He drops it, letting it be lost in the forest
distractors: He gives it to Dumbledore's portrait
He destroys it with Basilisk venom
He keeps it for the rest of his life
questions.explanation: Harry deliberately lets the stone fall from his hand into the forest undergrowth rather than keep it.

questions.question_text: Besides controlling light, what additional hidden function does Ron discover the Deluminator has during the Horcrux hunt?
questions.correct_answer: It can guide him back to Harry and Hermione
distractors: It can turn invisible objects visible
It can extinguish a Dark Mark
questions.explanation: The Deluminator releases a ball of light that leads Ron directly back to his friends after he abandons them.

questions.question_text: What does Dumbledore use to repel the Inferi that attack Harry inside the cave?
questions.explanation: Dumbledore conjures a ring of flame to drive back the Inferi surrounding Harry in the lake.

questions.question_text: By what other nicknames, besides the Elder Wand, is the most powerful of the three Deathly Hallows also known?
questions.correct_answer: The Deathstick and the Wand of Destiny
distractors: The Doom Wand and the Wand of Ages
The Hallow Rod and the Ender Wand
The Grim Wand and the Fate Stick
questions.explanation: Xenophilius Lovegood and other sources refer to the wand by these additional dramatic nicknames.

questions.question_text: In 'The Tale of the Three Brothers,' which Hallow does Death give to the wisest, youngest brother?
questions.explanation: The youngest brother asks for a way to hide from Death itself, so Death gives him its own Cloak of Invisibility.

questions.question_text: What happens on the Marauder's Map if the wrong person, such as Snape, tries to force it to reveal its secrets?
questions.correct_answer: Insulting messages from its four creators appear on it
distractors: It sounds an alarm audible throughout the castle
questions.explanation: When Snape confiscates the map and demands it reveal itself, it instead insults him under the Marauders' aliases.

questions.question_text: How does Dolores Umbridge unknowingly come into possession of Slytherin's locket Horcrux?
questions.correct_answer: She confiscates it from Mundungus Fletcher and wears it as a status symbol
distractors: She buys it at a Knockturn Alley auction
She inherits it from a distant relative
She finds it hidden in Grimmauld Place herself
questions.explanation: Umbridge seizes the locket from Mundungus for selling stolen goods, mistakenly believing the Slytherin 'S' marks her as pure-blood nobility.

questions.question_text: What rare magical phenomenon occurs when Harry's and Voldemort's twin-cored wands connect during their graveyard duel?
questions.explanation: Because their wands share a phoenix-feather core, the connection forces Voldemort's wand to expel echoes of its past victims.

questions.question_text: What weapon, pulled from the Sorting Hat by Neville Longbottom, is used to behead Nagini during the Battle of Hogwarts?
questions.explanation: Neville draws the sword from the burning Sorting Hat and uses it to kill Voldemort's last Horcrux, Nagini.

questions.question_text: What single word, spoken in Parseltongue, is required to open Slytherin's locket Horcrux?
questions.explanation: Ron must hiss the word 'open' in Parseltongue, having heard Harry do it before, to unseal the locket.

questions.question_text: Whose old, cat-urine-scented tent do the Weasleys borrow for the Quidditch World Cup?
questions.explanation: Mr. Weasley borrows a tent from his co-worker Perkins, apologizing for the smell.

questions.question_text: Whose eye does Harry glimpse watching him through the two-way mirror shard just before the Battle of Hogwarts begins?
questions.explanation: Harry realizes the eye in the mirror shard belongs to Aberforth, who has been watching over him via a network of portraits and passages.

questions.question_text: What ultimately causes Peter Pettigrew's death when he hesitates to kill Harry?
questions.correct_answer: His own silver hand turns against him and strangles him
questions.explanation: The silver hand Voldemort gave Pettigrew turns on its owner the moment he shows mercy toward Harry.

questions.question_text: What visibly happens when Harry stabs Tom Riddle's diary with a Basilisk fang?
questions.correct_answer: Ink pours out of it like blood, and the memory of Riddle screams and disintegrates
distractors: It transforms into a real snake
questions.explanation: The diary reacts violently, spraying ink and Riddle's memory-form vanishing as the Horcrux is destroyed.

questions.question_text: What advanced charm, taught to herself from a library book, does Hermione use to link the fake Galleons so they all display the same message?
questions.explanation: The Protean Charm is a NEWT-level piece of magic that Hermione teaches herself in order to link the DA's coins.

questions.question_text: Which Hogwarts ghost, revealed to be Ravenclaw's own daughter, tells Harry where the lost diadem is hidden?
questions.explanation: Helena Ravenclaw, the Grey Lady, eventually reveals to Harry where she hid her mother's diadem.

questions.question_text: Which Hogwarts ghost, in life, killed Helena Ravenclaw after she stole and hid her mother's diadem?
questions.explanation: The Bloody Baron, who loved Helena, murdered her in a jealous rage when she refused to return with him.

questions.question_text: In which country did Helena Ravenclaw hide her mother's stolen diadem, hollowing out a tree to conceal it?
questions.explanation: Helena fled to Albania, where she hid the diadem before the Bloody Baron caught up with her.

questions.question_text: What phrase is engraved on Ravenclaw's lost diadem, extolling the value of wisdom?
questions.correct_answer: "Wit beyond measure is man's greatest treasure."
distractors: "Knowledge is the only wealth that grows."
"A wise mind is a kingdom in itself."
questions.explanation: This motto, engraved on the diadem, is echoed in the riddle used to enter the Ravenclaw common room.

questions.question_text: Where does young Tom Riddle hide Marvolo Gaunt's ring after murdering his father and grandparents?
distractors: In a cave by the sea
In the cellar of the Riddle House
questions.explanation: Riddle hides the ring back where he found it, in his mother's family's decrepit shack, a location Dumbledore later investigates.

questions.question_text: During a childhood trip with two fellow orphans, where does young Tom Riddle first discover the cave he later uses to hide a Horcrux?
questions.correct_answer: A seaside cave near the orphanage
distractors: A family vacation spot with the Gaunts
questions.explanation: Dumbledore's memory reveals that Riddle terrorized two other orphans on a trip to a coastal cave that he later chooses to hide a Horcrux in.

questions.question_text: What does R.A.B.'s note, left in place of the real locket Horcrux, say he hopes will happen to Voldemort?
questions.correct_answer: That he will be mortal once more when he meets his match
distractors: That he will be forgiven for his crimes
That he will be defeated by Harry Potter specifically
That his other Horcruxes will also be destroyed
questions.explanation: Regulus Black's note expresses his hope that stealing and destroying the Horcrux will help make Voldemort mortal again.

questions.question_text: What does Harry give Kreacher that finally wins the house-elf's genuine loyalty and devotion?
questions.correct_answer: Regulus Black's fake Horcrux locket, to keep as a memento
distractors: A full set of new clothes, freeing him
questions.explanation: Harry gives Kreacher the fake locket to treasure in memory of Regulus, transforming their relationship.

questions.question_text: Besides his unusual scar, what hobbies does Dumbledore's Chocolate Frog Card credit him with?
questions.explanation: Harry's first Chocolate Frog Card lists these two unexpected hobbies among Dumbledore's interests.

questions.question_text: Who secretly bankrolls the opening of Weasleys' Wizard Wheezes, using prize money he didn't want for himself?
questions.explanation: Harry gives Fred and George his Triwizard Tournament winnings to help fund their joke shop.

questions.question_text: Why does Slughorn warn that Felix Felicis, despite granting good luck, is dangerous if taken in excess?
questions.correct_answer: It causes giddiness, recklessness, and overconfidence
distractors: It slowly poisons the drinker over time
questions.explanation: Slughorn cautions his class that overuse of Felix Felicis leads to dangerous overconfidence.

questions.question_text: Why is Felix Felicis classified as a banned substance in official contests, according to Slughorn's lesson?
questions.correct_answer: It is considered an unfair advantage, similar to a performance-enhancing substance
distractors: It is classified as a controlled Dark artifact
It cannot legally be brewed by anyone under NEWT level
It is too expensive to regulate fairly
questions.explanation: Slughorn explains that Felix Felicis is banned from organized competitions because of the unfair edge it gives.

questions.question_text: What top speed is the Firebolt broomstick specified as capable of reaching?
questions.explanation: The Firebolt's specifications include a top speed of 150 mph, reached in ten seconds from a standstill.

questions.question_text: What potion, requiring a month of careful brewing and famously difficult to get right, does Hermione successfully complete in her second year despite being only twelve?
questions.explanation: Hermione manages an advanced potion well beyond her year, allowing Harry and Ron to infiltrate Slytherin.

questions.question_text: What creature guards the deepest, oldest vaults at Gringotts, later used by Harry, Ron, and Hermione to escape?
questions.explanation: A dragon, trained to associate a certain clashing sound with pain, guards the high-security vaults and carries the trio to freedom.

questions.question_text: What goblin, Imperiused by Harry, helps the trio gain access to the Lestrange vault at Gringotts?
questions.explanation: Bogrod, a Gringotts goblin, is placed under the Imperius Curse to help the trio past the vault's defenses.

questions.question_text: What everyday object do Amos Diggory and Mr. Weasley use as the Portkey to collect Harry and Cedric for the Quidditch World Cup?
questions.explanation: The Portkey used to fetch Harry and Cedric for the World Cup is disguised as a manky old boot.

questions.question_text: What portrait, hanging behind a hidden passage in the Room of Requirement that leads to the Hog's Head, depicts Aberforth's late sister?
questions.explanation: The secret passage out of the besieged castle during the Battle of Hogwarts runs through a portrait of Ariana in the Room of Requirement.

questions.question_text: What book does Harry find hidden upstairs in Bathilda Bagshot's house, containing a rare photograph of the young Dumbledore and Grindelwald together?
questions.correct_answer: Rita Skeeter's "The Life and Lies of Albus Dumbledore"
questions.explanation: The tell-all biography includes a startling photograph of a teenage Dumbledore alongside Gellert Grindelwald.

questions.question_text: What phrase, coined by Grindelwald himself, is carved above the gates of Nurmengard, the fortress-prison where he is later held?
questions.explanation: Grindelwald's old rallying slogan is grimly carved above the entrance to the very prison built to hold him.

questions.question_text: What motto, meaning "Always Pure," is inscribed on the Black family's coat of arms?
questions.explanation: The Black family tapestry displays this French motto beneath their crest, reflecting their obsession with blood purity.

questions.question_text: What object in the front hallway of Grimmauld Place must be kept behind drawn curtains to stop it from shrieking insults at intruders?
questions.explanation: Sirius's late mother's portrait screams abuse whenever the curtains covering it are disturbed.

questions.question_text: What grim decoration lines the staircase wall of Grimmauld Place, made from former Black family house-elves?
questions.explanation: The Black family's tradition of displaying the heads of deceased house-elves horrifies Sirius's guests.

questions.question_text: What must students read at the bottom of a teacup during Harry's very first Divination lesson with Professor Trelawney?
questions.explanation: Trelawney's opening lesson has students interpret patterns left by tea leaves, during which she famously spots a Grim in Harry's cup.

questions.question_text: Which Hogwarts founder is said to have originally owned the object that later became the Sorting Hat?
questions.explanation: All four founders later added their own knowledge to the Hat, but it began as Gryffindor's own hat.

questions.question_text: What does the Wanted poster circulated across the wizarding world show for escaped convict Sirius Black?
questions.correct_answer: His gaunt, screaming face from his Azkaban intake photograph
distractors: A photo of him as a young Hogwarts student
A photo of him in his Animagus dog form
questions.explanation: Sirius's Wanted poster uses his unsettling Azkaban mugshot, showing the toll years of imprisonment took on him.

questions.question_text: How must a wizard safely open the Monster Book of Monsters, according to instructions Hagrid neglects to give his students?
distractors: By tapping it three times with a wand
questions.explanation: Without stroking the spine first, the book thrashes and bites anyone who tries to open it.

questions.question_text: Which cat is able to press the hidden knot on the Whomping Willow's trunk, freezing it and allowing safe passage into the tunnel beneath it?
questions.explanation: Crookshanks knows how to still the Whomping Willow, which helps Sirius and Pettigrew pass safely as animals.

questions.question_text: What happens to the Ministry's entire stock of Time-Turners during the Battle of the Department of Mysteries?
questions.correct_answer: They are destroyed in the fighting
distractors: They are stolen by Death Eaters
They are confiscated by Dumbledore beforehand
They stop working due to a curse
questions.explanation: A shelf of Time-Turners is smashed during the chaotic battle, destroying the Ministry's supply.

questions.question_text: What sinister magical object, displayed for sale at Borgin and Burkes, provides light only to whoever is holding it?
questions.explanation: Harry and Ron overhear Draco Malfoy in the shop, where such Dark objects as the Hand of Glory are for sale.

questions.question_text: What warning is displayed beneath a cursed opal necklace in a cabinet at Borgin and Burkes, foreshadowing its later use against Katie Bell?
questions.correct_answer: A placard noting it has killed several previous Muggle owners
distractors: A note claiming it grants eternal youth
A sign claiming it is merely decorative and harmless
A warning that it turns its wearer invisible
questions.explanation: The same type of cursed opal necklace seen for sale years earlier resurfaces as the weapon used against Katie Bell.

questions.question_text: What is the Bloody Baron, the Slytherin house ghost, said to be bound in as penance for killing Helena Ravenclaw?
questions.explanation: The Bloody Baron wears chains and bloodstains as a permanent, visible mark of his crime against Helena Ravenclaw.

questions.question_text: What kind of food is deliberately served at Nearly Headless Nick's five-hundredth deathday party?
questions.correct_answer: Rotten, moldy food such as a putrid haggis
distractors: Nothing at all, since ghosts don't eat
questions.explanation: The ghosts prefer their food decayed, so Nick's deathday party features deliberately spoiled dishes.

questions.question_text: What one-eyed statue in a Hogwarts corridor conceals the secret passage leading directly into Honeydukes' cellar?
distractors: The statue of Gregory the Smarmy
questions.explanation: Tapping the humpbacked one-eyed witch statue and saying 'Dissendium' opens the passage to Honeydukes.

questions.question_text: Which blustering knight portrait temporarily guards Gryffindor Tower after the Fat Lady's portrait is slashed, known for absurdly complicated passwords?
questions.explanation: Sir Cadogan replaces the injured Fat Lady and drives students to distraction with his ever-changing, convoluted passwords.

questions.question_text: What ingredients does Snape ask Harry about in his very first Potions lesson, whose combination produces the Draught of Living Death?
questions.correct_answer: Powdered root of asphodel and an infusion of wormwood
distractors: Powdered moonstone and syrup of hellebore
Powdered unicorn horn and dragon blood
questions.explanation: Snape's opening question, which Harry cannot answer, describes the exact ingredients for the Draught of Living Death.

questions.question_text: During the 'Seven Potters' operation, what mode of transport does the real Harry travel by, riding alongside Hagrid?
questions.explanation: Harry rides with Hagrid on the enchanted motorbike Sirius once used to carry infant Harry to Privet Drive.

questions.question_text: Which Peverell brother received the unbeatable wand from Death and was murdered for it that same night?
questions.explanation: The eldest brother's boastfulness about his wand gets him killed for it almost immediately.

questions.question_text: Which Peverell brother owned the Resurrection Stone, using it in a doomed attempt to bring back a lost love?
questions.explanation: The second brother's use of the stone ends in tragedy, as the person it summons is only a sorrowful shade.

questions.question_text: According to the Deathly Hallows story, Harry descends from which Peverell brother through his possession of the Cloak of Invisibility?
questions.explanation: The Cloak passed down through generations from Ignotus Peverell, the youngest brother, eventually reaching James and then Harry Potter.

questions.question_text: Which Marauder nickname belongs to Remus Lupin, a reference to his condition as a werewolf?
questions.explanation: Lupin's friends nicknamed him Moony for his monthly transformations under the full moon.

questions.question_text: Which Marauder nickname belongs to James Potter, based on his stag Animagus form?
questions.explanation: James's antlered stag form earned him the nickname Prongs among his fellow Marauders.

questions.question_text: In the Triwizard Tournament's second task, what must each champion retrieve from the bottom of the Black Lake within an hour?
questions.correct_answer: A person they would sorely miss
questions.explanation: The merpeople hold something each champion values highly, in Harry's case Ron, hostage underwater for the task.

questions.question_text: How must a Triwizard champion listen to the golden egg's clue in order to understand its message?
distractors: By having a Mermish interpreter present
questions.explanation: The egg's screeching becomes an intelligible song only when opened beneath water.

questions.question_text: What do the initials 'R.A.B.,' found on the note inside the fake locket Horcrux, actually stand for in full?
questions.explanation: Regulus Arcturus Black is revealed to be the 'R.A.B.' who stole and tried to destroy the real Horcrux.

questions.question_text: According to Ministry policy in the Hall of Prophecy, who alone may safely remove a given prophecy sphere from its shelf?
questions.correct_answer: The person, or one of the people, the prophecy concerns
distractors: Only the sitting Minister of Magic
Whoever originally spoke the prophecy aloud
questions.explanation: Prophecy spheres are keyed so that only their subjects can remove them without consequence.

questions.question_text: What does Kreacher eventually reveal happened to Regulus Black after he ordered the house-elf to leave him behind in the Horcrux cave?
questions.correct_answer: Regulus was pulled under and drowned by the Inferi
distractors: Regulus escaped the cave safely afterward
Regulus was captured and executed by Voldemort directly
Regulus destroyed the Horcrux himself before dying peacefully
questions.explanation: Kreacher's account reveals that Regulus sacrificed himself to the Inferi so Kreacher could escape with the real locket.

questions.question_text: What growing personal collection does Dobby accumulate for himself after becoming a free, paid Hogwarts employee?
questions.correct_answer: A collection of hats and mismatched socks
distractors: A collection of Chocolate Frog Cards
A collection of old Daily Prophets
questions.explanation: Dobby delights in wearing an ever-growing, mismatched assortment of hats and socks as a free elf.

questions.question_text: What enchanted document, signed by every member of Dumbledore's Army, curses anyone who betrays the group's secret with a lasting facial hex?
questions.explanation: Hermione's jinx causes the word 'SNEAK' to erupt in pustules across the face of Marietta Edgecombe after she tells Umbridge about the group.

questions.question_text: Where does Harry hide his old Half-Blood Prince potions textbook after the Sectumsempra incident, fearing it will be confiscated?
questions.correct_answer: Inside the Room of Requirement, among the Room of Hidden Things
distractors: In his trunk under a false bottom
In the Restricted Section of the library
questions.explanation: Harry stashes the book among the castle's other hidden objects, the very place the lost diadem is later found.

questions.question_text: Why is Harry initially unaware the broken two-way mirror shard from Sirius could still be useful, according to the account given in his sixth and seventh years?
questions.correct_answer: He had thrown it away or broken it further in grief after Sirius's death, not realizing it still worked
distractors: He gave it away to Kreacher out of spite
He lost it during the escape from Privet Drive
He deliberately smashed it to keep anyone else from using it
questions.explanation: Harry only discovers the mirror shard still functions when he sees an eye watching him through it much later.
questions.source_ref: Order of the Phoenix / Deathly Hallows

questions.question_text: What protection does Voldemort place around Nagini during the Battle of Hogwarts, after realizing she is his last remaining Horcrux?
questions.correct_answer: A large, magically protected enchanted cage
questions.explanation: Voldemort keeps Nagini enclosed in a protective magical enchantment for safekeeping once he realizes how vulnerable his last Horcrux is.

questions.question_text: What does the goblin Griphook demand in exchange for helping Harry, Ron, and Hermione break into Gringotts?
questions.correct_answer: The Sword of Gryffindor, once they no longer need it
distractors: A share of the vault's gold
questions.explanation: Griphook's price for aiding the break-in is the Sword of Gryffindor itself, reflecting goblin views on its rightful ownership.

questions.question_text: What tiny engraving on a sink in Moaning Myrtle's bathroom must be addressed in Parseltongue to open the entrance to the Chamber of Secrets?
questions.explanation: The scratched image of a snake on one of the taps responds only to a Parseltongue command.

questions.question_text: What creature delivers both the Sorting Hat and, hidden within it, the Sword of Gryffindor to Harry in the Chamber of Secrets?
questions.explanation: Fawkes flies the Sorting Hat down to Harry in his moment of need, and the sword emerges from within it.

questions.question_text: What weapon does Dumbledore use, revealed only later, to destroy the Horcrux inside Marvolo Gaunt's ring, explaining the sword's later Horcrux-destroying power?
questions.explanation: Dumbledore destroys the ring Horcrux with the sword, which had already absorbed Basilisk venom, permanently giving it the power to destroy Horcruxes.

questions.question_text: What error appears in the icing on the birthday cake Hagrid bakes for Harry's eleventh birthday?
questions.correct_answer: It misspells the greeting as "Happy Birthdae Harry"
distractors: It is addressed to the wrong person entirely
It is missing a candle for each year
questions.explanation: Hagrid's homemade cake is a heartfelt gesture marred by a charming misspelling in green icing.

questions.question_text: What message, apparently written in blood, is found on a Hogwarts corridor wall beside Mrs. Norris's petrified body?
questions.correct_answer: "The Chamber of Secrets has been opened. Enemies of the Heir, beware."
distractors: "Beware the monster within, Mudbloods will fall."
questions.explanation: The chilling message on the wall is the first sign that the Chamber of Secrets has truly been reopened.

questions.question_text: What accidental side effect results when Hagrid, using the broken half of his snapped wand, tries to threaten Dudley Dursley?
questions.correct_answer: Dudley grows a curly pig's tail
questions.explanation: Hagrid's spell doesn't quite work as intended, leaving Dudley with an embarrassing tail that has to be surgically removed.

questions.question_text: Who originally gives Harry the Marauder's Map, having stolen it themselves from Filch's office years earlier?
questions.explanation: Fred and George pass the map on to Harry in his third year, having swiped it from Filch as first-years.

questions.question_text: In which office is the Marauder's Map originally kept as a confiscated item before Fred and George Weasley steal it?
questions.explanation: The map sits confiscated in a filing cabinet in Filch's office until the Weasley twins liberate it.

questions.question_text: Besides Trelawney herself, who is the only other person confirmed to have heard the complete original prophecy about Harry and Voldemort?
questions.explanation: Snape overheard only the prophecy's opening portion before being caught eavesdropping and thrown out of the Hog's Head; Dumbledore alone heard it in full.

questions.question_text: What unusual piece of jewelry does Bill Weasley wear, a souvenir from his years working for Gringotts in Egypt?
questions.explanation: Bill's earring, rumored to be made from a fang found in an Egyptian tomb, reflects his adventurous curse-breaking career.

questions.question_text: Where does Barty Crouch Jr. keep the real Alastor Moody imprisoned for nearly the entire school year while impersonating him with Polyjuice Potion?
questions.correct_answer: Inside a magically expanded trunk in Moody's own office
questions.explanation: The real Moody is kept alive but transfigured and locked in a hidden compartment of his own magical trunk.

questions.question_text: Whose two names, along with the label 'Dark Lord,' appear on the shelf tag of the prophecy record Harry retrieves in the Department of Mysteries?
questions.explanation: The prophecy record is labeled with the names of the people it concerns: Dumbledore, the one it was given to, and Harry, the one it's about.

questions.question_text: Who originally created the pair of two-way mirrors, decades before Sirius gives one half to Harry, so they could talk during separate detentions?
questions.correct_answer: Sirius Black and James Potter, as Hogwarts students
questions.explanation: Sirius explains that he and James made the mirrors as schoolboys to keep in touch whenever one of them was in detention.

questions.question_text: Besides practical warnings like 'mortal peril,' what more whimsical setting can the Weasley family clock's hands also point to?
questions.explanation: Alongside urgent statuses, the Weasley clock's hands can point to everyday, mundane settings as well.

questions.question_text: What luxurious feature does the Prefects' bathroom have, which Cedric Diggory suggests Harry use to help solve the golden egg's clue?
questions.correct_answer: A huge tub-like bath with dozens of taps producing colorful, scented bubbles
distractors: A heated pool with only a diving board
questions.explanation: Harry takes Cedric's hint and opens the egg while soaking in the extravagant Prefects' bathroom.

questions.question_text: According to Dumbledore's count, how many Horcruxes did Voldemort intentionally create, not including the accidental fragment of soul lodged in Harry?
questions.explanation: Dumbledore counts six deliberately made Horcruxes: the diary, ring, locket, cup, diadem, and Nagini, with Harry as an unplanned seventh.

questions.question_text: In Harry's third-year Boggart lesson, what ridiculous outfit does Neville imagine Professor Snape wearing to make his fear less frightening?
questions.correct_answer: His grandmother's clothes, including a hat topped with a stuffed vulture
questions.explanation: Neville's Boggart takes the shape of Snape dressed in Neville's grandmother's own distinctive vulture-topped hat and clothes.

questions.question_text: Who delivers Harry's Hogwarts letter to him in person after owls repeatedly fail to reach him?
questions.explanation: Hagrid arrives on Harry's eleventh birthday to deliver the letter and explain that Harry is a wizard.

questions.question_text: What pet does Hagrid give Harry as an eleventh-birthday present?
questions.explanation: Hagrid buys Harry a snowy owl, which Harry names Hedwig.

questions.question_text: At which Diagon Alley shop does Harry buy his wand?
questions.explanation: Ollivanders is the famous wandmaker's shop where Harry's wand chooses him.

questions.question_text: What magical creature's feather forms the core of Harry's wand?
questions.explanation: Harry's wand contains a phoenix feather core, which happens to come from Fawkes.

questions.question_text: Which London pub hides the magical entrance to Diagon Alley?
questions.explanation: Hagrid taps the bricks behind the Leaky Cauldron to reveal the entrance to Diagon Alley.

questions.question_text: Which house does the Sorting Hat seriously consider for Harry before he silently asks not to be placed there?
questions.explanation: The Hat notes Harry could do well in Slytherin, but sorts him into Gryffindor at his request.

questions.question_text: What device does Neville Longbottom's grandmother send him to help him remember what he's forgotten?
questions.explanation: The Remembrall glows red when its holder has forgotten something, though it doesn't say what.

questions.question_text: Who challenges Harry to a midnight wizard's duel that turns out to be a trap to get him in trouble?
questions.explanation: Malfoy never intends to show up; the invitation is meant to get Harry caught out of bed.

questions.question_text: On what holiday is a mountain troll let loose inside Hogwarts during Harry's first year?
questions.explanation: The troll incident during the Halloween feast is what first brings Harry, Ron, and Hermione together as friends.

questions.question_text: Where is the troll discovered, with Hermione trapped inside, on Halloween?
questions.explanation: Harry and Ron rush to warn Hermione and end up fighting the troll in the girls' bathroom.

questions.question_text: Which professor recruits Harry for the Quidditch team after watching him catch a falling Remembrall?
questions.explanation: McGonagall is impressed by Harry's flying skill and arranges for him to become Seeker.

questions.question_text: Who captains the Gryffindor Quidditch team during Harry's first year?
questions.explanation: Oliver Wood is Gryffindor's Keeper and team captain when Harry joins as Seeker.

questions.question_text: What does the Mirror of Erised show anyone who gazes into it?
questions.explanation: Dumbledore explains that the mirror shows neither knowledge nor truth, only a person's heart's desire.

questions.question_text: What does Harry see when he first looks into the Mirror of Erised?
questions.correct_answer: His deceased parents standing beside him
questions.explanation: Harry sees his parents, James and Lily, for the first time, alongside himself in the reflection.

questions.question_text: Which of the trio ends up unconscious after playing a life-sized game of wizard's chess?
questions.explanation: Ron sacrifices himself as a knight to let Harry continue toward the Stone.

questions.question_text: Which of the trio solves a logic puzzle involving potion bottles to pass safely through purple flames?
questions.explanation: Hermione works out which potions are safe to drink, allowing her and Harry to proceed.

questions.question_text: Which professor does Harry wrongly suspect of jinxing his broom during his very first Quidditch match?
questions.explanation: Harry assumes Snape is cursing his broom, when in fact Snape is protecting him.

questions.question_text: Who actually jinxes Harry's broom during his first Quidditch match?
questions.explanation: Quirrell secretly curses the broom while Snape counter-jinxes it to save Harry.

questions.question_text: What does Hermione do to Snape during Harry's first Quidditch match, mistakenly believing he's cursing Harry's broom?
distractors: Locks him out of the stands
questions.explanation: Hermione sets Snape's robes alight to break his supposed eye contact with Harry's broom.

questions.question_text: Which professor is ultimately revealed to have Voldemort attached to the back of his head?
questions.explanation: Quirrell's turban conceals Voldemort's weakened face on the back of his skull.

questions.question_text: What happens to Quirrell whenever he tries to touch Harry directly?
questions.explanation: Lily's protective sacrifice makes physical contact with Harry agonizing for Quirrell/Voldemort.

questions.question_text: Which house wins the House Cup at the last moment thanks to points awarded for the trio's bravery?
questions.explanation: Dumbledore's last-minute points swing the House Cup to Gryffindor at the end-of-year feast.

questions.question_text: Which shy first-year is awarded ten points for standing up to his own friends, helping Gryffindor win the House Cup?
questions.explanation: Dumbledore praises Neville's courage in trying to stop his friends from breaking rules.

questions.question_text: Where do the Dursleys flee in a desperate attempt to stop Harry's Hogwarts letters from reaching him?
questions.correct_answer: A shack on a rock in the sea
questions.explanation: Uncle Vernon takes the family to an isolated hut on a rock, but Hagrid finds them anyway.

questions.question_text: Where does Harry sleep for most of his childhood at the Dursleys' house?
questions.explanation: Harry is kept in the small cupboard under the stairs before his letters begin arriving.

questions.question_text: At which shop does Harry first meet Draco Malfoy, before either boy has started at Hogwarts?
questions.correct_answer: Madam Malkin's Robes for All Occasions
questions.explanation: The two boys meet while being fitted for their school robes.

questions.question_text: Which three students are sent into the Forbidden Forest as detention alongside Draco Malfoy?
questions.explanation: Harry, Hermione, and Neville join Malfoy for detention with Hagrid in the Forbidden Forest.

questions.question_text: What are Harry and his detention companions sent to investigate in the Forbidden Forest?
questions.explanation: They are tasked with following a trail of unicorn blood to find the creature harming them.

questions.question_text: Which centaur rescues Harry from the hooded figure drinking unicorn blood in the Forbidden Forest?
questions.explanation: Firenze allows Harry to ride on his back to safety after chasing off the cloaked figure.

questions.question_text: Which of Ron's older brothers arranges for Norbert the dragon to be safely collected from Hogwarts?
questions.explanation: Charlie, who studies dragons in Romania, sends friends to collect Norbert.

questions.question_text: From where do Ron and Hermione help smuggle Norbert the dragon away at night?
questions.correct_answer: The top of the Astronomy Tower
questions.explanation: Under the Invisibility Cloak, they carry Norbert's crate up to the tallest tower to hand him off.

questions.question_text: Which magical creature must Harry and his friends get past first among the obstacles guarding the Philosopher's Stone?
questions.explanation: Fluffy guards the trapdoor that leads down to the rest of the obstacles.

questions.question_text: Which obstacle guarding the Stone involves a plant that binds tighter the more its victim struggles?
questions.explanation: Devil's Snare relaxes its grip only when its victim stops struggling, as Hermione recalls.

questions.question_text: Which professor's obstacle is the giant, life-sized game of wizard's chess?
questions.explanation: McGonagall's transfiguration skills are behind the enchanted chess set the trio must play.

questions.question_text: Whose potion riddle, involving a puzzle of bottles and fire, must be solved to move forward toward the Stone?
questions.explanation: Snape's logic puzzle protects the Stone with deadly and harmless potions among seven bottles.

questions.question_text: Who does Harry find waiting for him in the final chamber, instead of the person he expected?
questions.explanation: Harry expects to confront Snape but instead finds Quirrell guarding the Mirror of Erised.

questions.question_text: Who explains to Harry, in the hospital wing, why Quirrell could not bear to touch him?
questions.explanation: Dumbledore visits Harry afterward and explains the protective power of his mother's love.

questions.question_text: According to Dumbledore, what protects Harry from Voldemort's touch through his own skin?
questions.explanation: Lily's death to save Harry leaves a protective mark that makes his skin unbearable to Voldemort.

questions.question_text: What keepsake does Hagrid put together and give Harry at the end of his first year?
questions.correct_answer: A photo album of his parents
distractors: A framed letter from Lily Potter
A pocket watch of James Potter's
A model of the Hogwarts Express
questions.explanation: Hagrid secretly gathers old photographs of James and Lily to give Harry as a gift.

questions.question_text: What magical means of transport carries new students across the lake to Hogwarts on their first night?
questions.explanation: First-years famously cross the lake in little boats, getting their first view of the castle.

questions.question_text: Who greets the first-years at the castle doors and leads them in to be Sorted?
questions.explanation: McGonagall explains the Sorting process before leading the nervous first-years into the Great Hall.

questions.question_text: What must first-years do to be placed into one of the four Hogwarts houses?
distractors: Answer a riddle from a ghost
Draw a card from an enchanted deck
questions.explanation: The Sorting Hat is placed on each student's head and calls out their house.

questions.question_text: What does Hagrid win in a game of cards with a mysterious stranger early in the school year?
questions.explanation: Hagrid wins the egg that later hatches into Norbert, without realizing who he was really talking to.

questions.question_text: Who is Harry's very first friend, met while sharing a compartment on the Hogwarts Express?
questions.explanation: Ron and Harry become friends on the train ride to Hogwarts before either has arrived at school.

questions.question_text: What does Harry buy from the trolley witch to share with Ron, who only has corned beef sandwiches?
questions.correct_answer: A large assortment of wizarding sweets
distractors: A box of Chocolate Frogs only
questions.explanation: Harry, having money for the first time, buys plenty of sweets for himself and Ron to share.

questions.question_text: Which subject does Harry study under the strict, seemingly unfair Professor Snape?
questions.explanation: Snape teaches Potions and appears to favor Slytherin students over Harry throughout the book.

questions.question_text: Which magical sport, played on broomsticks, does Harry excel at from his very first year?
questions.explanation: Harry becomes the youngest House Quidditch player in a century after his talent is discovered.

questions.question_text: Which ball must a Seeker catch to end a Quidditch match and earn a large number of points?
questions.explanation: Catching the tiny, winged Golden Snitch ends the match and awards 150 points to the Seeker's team.

questions.question_text: Which house-elf tries desperately to stop Harry from returning to Hogwarts for his second year?
questions.explanation: Dobby warns Harry of danger at Hogwarts and even blocks the platform barrier to keep him away.

questions.question_text: What does Dobby do at the Dursleys' important dinner party to try to get Harry in trouble?
questions.correct_answer: Drops a pudding on the guests
distractors: Sets off fireworks in the garden
Releases pixies into the dining room
questions.explanation: Dobby's floating pudding disaster is meant to convince the Dursleys to keep Harry home.

questions.question_text: Which cat is found petrified as the first victim when the Chamber of Secrets reopens?
questions.explanation: Mrs Norris is discovered petrified, hanging near the message about the Chamber's opening.

questions.question_text: What message is found painted on the wall beside the first petrified victim?
questions.correct_answer: "The Chamber of Secrets has been opened. Enemies of the Heir, beware."
questions.explanation: The threatening message, written in what appears to be blood, alarms the entire school.

questions.question_text: Who is wrongly blamed and briefly arrested when the Chamber of Secrets reopens, having been expelled decades earlier for the same accusation?
questions.explanation: Hagrid was expelled as a student for supposedly opening the Chamber and is arrested again as a precaution.

questions.question_text: Which giant spider does Hagrid keep hidden in the Forbidden Forest, once suspected of being the Chamber's monster?
questions.explanation: Aragog is innocent of the attacks, though he and his colony are still extremely dangerous.

questions.question_text: Which student is attacked while holding a mirror, found petrified with a page torn from a library book in hand?
questions.explanation: Hermione is petrified after researching the Basilisk, having used a mirror to avoid its direct gaze.

questions.question_text: What does Gilderoy Lockhart attempt to do to Harry and Ron's memories before his plan backfires?
distractors: Put them under the Imperius Curse
questions.explanation: Lockhart tries to erase their memories to take credit for defeating the Chamber's monster.

questions.question_text: Whose broken wand does Lockhart use in his Obliviate attempt, causing it to backfire on himself instead?
questions.explanation: Ron's wand, cracked since the car crash, malfunctions and wipes out Lockhart's own memory.

questions.question_text: What happens to the Weasleys' enchanted Ford Anglia after it crashes into the Whomping Willow?
questions.correct_answer: It runs wild and lives in the Forbidden Forest
distractors: It is confiscated by the Ministry
It flies back home on its own
questions.explanation: The car escapes into the forest and goes feral, later reappearing to help Harry and Ron.

questions.question_text: How does the feral Ford Anglia end up helping Harry and Ron later in the same year?
questions.correct_answer: It rescues them from Aragog's colony of spiders
distractors: It carries them to the Chamber of Secrets
It flies them home for the holidays
It fights off Dementors near Hogwarts
questions.explanation: The car bursts out of the forest to drive Harry and Ron to safety, away from the Acromantulas.

questions.question_text: What is revealed to be the source of Gilderoy Lockhart's supposedly heroic adventures in his books?
questions.correct_answer: Stolen accounts from real witches and wizards, whom he then Obliviated
distractors: Pure fabrication with no basis at all
Exaggerated retellings of his own minor deeds
questions.explanation: Lockhart confesses that he never performed the deeds himself, having erased the memories of those who did.

questions.question_text: What does Fawkes the phoenix bring to Harry inside the Chamber of Secrets to help him fight the Basilisk?
questions.correct_answer: The Sorting Hat, which produces the Sword of Gryffindor
distractors: A mirror to avoid the Basilisk's gaze
questions.explanation: Fawkes delivers the Sorting Hat on Dumbledore's orders, and the Sword of Gryffindor emerges from it.

questions.question_text: What does Fawkes do to save Harry's life after he is stabbed by a Basilisk fang?
questions.correct_answer: He cries healing tears onto the wound
distractors: He carries Harry to the hospital wing instantly
He gives Harry a Phoenix feather to hold
questions.explanation: Phoenix tears have powerful healing properties, saving Harry from the Basilisk's fatal venom.

questions.question_text: What item does Harry trick Lucius Malfoy into giving to Dobby, thereby setting the house-elf free?
questions.correct_answer: A sock, hidden inside a book
questions.explanation: A house-elf is freed when its master gives it clothing; Harry disguises a sock as Riddle's diary's wrapping.

questions.question_text: What potion does Madam Pomfrey use to revive all the students petrified during the Chamber of Secrets attacks?
questions.explanation: A batch of Mandrake Restorative Draught, brewed once the Mandrakes mature, cures the petrified victims.

questions.question_text: Which escaped prisoner is the entire wizarding world searching for at the start of Prisoner of Azkaban?
questions.explanation: Sirius Black's escape from Azkaban, the first ever recorded, terrifies the wizarding world.

questions.question_text: What does Harry accidentally do to his Aunt Marge that forces him to flee Privet Drive in anger?
questions.explanation: Harry's uncontrolled magic causes Aunt Marge to swell up after she insults his parents.

questions.question_text: What rescues Harry from the street after he runs away from Privet Drive following the Aunt Marge incident?
questions.explanation: Harry flags down the triple-decker Knight Bus, which whisks stranded witches and wizards away.

questions.question_text: Which magical creatures patrol Hogwarts and search the Hogwarts Express for Sirius Black?
questions.explanation: Dementors are posted around Hogwarts as security, despite the danger they pose to students.

questions.question_text: Who teaches Harry to conjure a Patronus in private lessons during his third year?
questions.explanation: Lupin gives Harry extra lessons to help him defend himself against Dementors.

questions.question_text: What mistake allows Sirius Black to break into Gryffindor Tower and slash the Fat Lady's portrait?
questions.correct_answer: Neville loses his written-down list of passwords
distractors: Fred and George give it away as a prank
questions.explanation: Neville's careless habit of writing down changing passwords lets Sirius find his way in.

questions.question_text: Whose bed curtains does Sirius Black slash when he breaks into the dormitory, having mistaken his target?
questions.explanation: Sirius is actually hunting Ron's pet rat, Scabbers, not Harry, though it terrifies the whole tower.

questions.question_text: What magical map do Fred and George Weasley give Harry, revealing everyone's location within the castle?
questions.explanation: The map shows every room, secret passage, and moving footstep inside Hogwarts.

questions.question_text: The Marauder's Map credits itself to Moony, Wormtail, Padfoot, and which fourth nickname?
questions.explanation: Prongs is James Potter's Animagus nickname, referring to his stag form.

questions.question_text: Which creature does Draco Malfoy provoke into attacking him during his first Care of Magical Creatures lesson?
questions.explanation: Malfoy insults Buckbeak after being warned to be respectful, and is injured as a result.

questions.question_text: What potion does Snape brew for Professor Lupin each month to help him keep his mind during his transformations?
questions.explanation: Snape's grudging brewing of Wolfsbane allows Lupin to remain himself as a werewolf, though not harmless.

questions.question_text: Who resigns as Defence Against the Dark Arts professor after his werewolf secret becomes public knowledge?
questions.explanation: Lupin steps down once parents learn a werewolf has been teaching their children.

questions.question_text: Which Ministry official personally visits Hogwarts to warn students about the dangers of Sirius Black?
questions.explanation: Fudge, the Minister for Magic, addresses the school's safety concerns about the escaped convict.

questions.question_text: Whose true identity is uncovered when Ron's pet rat, Scabbers, is finally cornered?
questions.explanation: Scabbers is revealed to be Pettigrew, hiding in Animagus form for over a decade.

questions.question_text: Which two countries compete in the Quidditch World Cup Final that opens Goblet of Fire?
questions.explanation: Ireland trounces Bulgaria in goals despite Krum catching the Snitch.

questions.question_text: Which player catches the Golden Snitch during the World Cup Final even though his team still loses the match?
questions.explanation: Krum realizes the game is already lost and catches the Snitch to end Ireland's onslaught.

questions.question_text: What is conjured over the Quidditch World Cup campsite, sparking panic among the crowd?
distractors: A giant serpent of green sparks
questions.explanation: The Dark Mark's sudden appearance terrifies campers, who fear Death Eaters have returned.

questions.question_text: Which house-elf is wrongly blamed at first for casting the Dark Mark over the Quidditch World Cup campsite?
questions.explanation: Winky is found near Harry's dropped wand and blamed, though she was actually trying to stop her master.

questions.question_text: What unprecedented event occurs when the Goblet of Fire selects the Triwizard champions?
questions.correct_answer: It selects four champions instead of three
distractors: It selects no champions at all
It catches fire and burns the parchment
questions.explanation: Harry's name emerges as an illegal fourth champion, shocking everyone present.

questions.question_text: What magical contract binds the selected champions to compete in the Triwizard Tournament, regardless of their wishes?
questions.correct_answer: The Goblet of Fire's own binding magical contract
distractors: A written agreement with the Ministry
questions.explanation: Once chosen, a champion cannot back out, as the Goblet's magic constitutes a binding contract.

questions.question_text: Which journalist turns out to be an unregistered Animagus who spies on people in beetle form?
questions.explanation: Hermione discovers Skeeter's secret beetle form, which lets her eavesdrop on private conversations.

questions.question_text: Who takes Hermione Granger to the Yule Ball, surprising much of the school?
questions.explanation: Hermione's date with the Durmstrang champion causes a stir, especially with Ron.

questions.question_text: Which missing Ministry employee's disappearance before the World Cup turns out to be connected to Voldemort's return?
questions.explanation: Bertha Jorkins was captured, tortured for information, and killed by Voldemort and Wormtail.

questions.question_text: Who is revealed, at the end of Goblet of Fire, to have been impersonating Mad-Eye Moody all year using Polyjuice Potion?
questions.explanation: Crouch Jr., thought dead, had escaped Azkaban and posed as Moody to help Voldemort's return.

questions.question_text: Where was the real Alastor Moody kept hidden for most of the school year?
questions.correct_answer: Locked inside his own magical trunk
questions.explanation: Crouch Jr. kept the real Moody alive but imprisoned in a compartment of his own enchanted trunk.

questions.question_text: What organization does Dumbledore reconvene at the end of Goblet of Fire in response to Voldemort's return?
questions.explanation: Dumbledore gathers his old allies once more to resist Voldemort's rise.

questions.question_text: Which Ministry official's refusal to believe Voldemort has returned drives much of the conflict in Order of the Phoenix?
questions.explanation: Fudge's denial leads to a Ministry smear campaign against Harry and Dumbledore.

questions.question_text: What does Harry cast to protect himself and Dudley from Dementors in Little Whinging, leading to his Ministry hearing?
questions.explanation: Harry's underage use of a Patronus to fend off Dementors results in a disciplinary hearing at the Ministry.

questions.question_text: What object does Harry use to summon Ron back after Ron abandons him and Hermione during their search for Horcruxes?
questions.explanation: The Deluminator, a gift from Dumbledore, leads Ron back to Harry and Hermione when he needs it most.

questions.question_text: Beyond simply extinguishing lights, what does Dumbledore's Deluminator actually let Ron do when he activates it?
questions.correct_answer: Follow a ball of light that leads him back to Harry and Hermione's voices
questions.explanation: The device releases a light that Ron follows, guiding him back to his friends after he leaves in anger.

questions.question_text: Who dies protecting Harry during the "Seven Potters" decoy operation fleeing Privet Drive?
questions.explanation: Moody is killed by Voldemort during the ambush on the decoys escorting Harry away from Privet Drive.

questions.question_text: Which of Harry's own pets dies during the battle over Privet Drive at the start of Deathly Hallows?
questions.explanation: Hedwig is killed by a stray curse while trapped in her cage during the escape.

questions.question_text: Which Weasley loses an ear during the escape from Privet Drive, hit by a curse meant to be fatal?
questions.explanation: George is injured by a curse from Snape (deflected from someone else) during the chaotic battle.

questions.question_text: Whose wedding is interrupted by news that the Ministry of Magic has fallen to Voldemort's control?
questions.explanation: A Patronus arrives mid-celebration warning that the Ministry has fallen and Death Eaters are coming.

questions.question_text: Who becomes the Ministry's puppet Minister for Magic under the Imperius Curse after the Ministry falls to Voldemort?
questions.explanation: Thicknesse is placed under the Imperius Curse and installed as a figurehead Minister.

questions.question_text: What does Xenophilius Lovegood ultimately betray to Death Eaters in an attempt to save his kidnapped daughter?
distractors: The location of the real Horcruxes
The Order of the Phoenix's headquarters
questions.explanation: Desperate to get Luna back safely, Xenophilius tips off Death Eaters that Harry is in his house.

questions.question_text: What does Hermione do to Harry's face to disguise him from Snatchers, shortly before their capture?
questions.correct_answer: Disfigures it with a stinging jinx
distractors: Cuts his hair and beard off
questions.explanation: Hermione's jinx swells Harry's face just before Snatchers seize the trio, delaying his identification.

questions.question_text: Who throws the knife that fatally wounds Dobby during the escape from Malfoy Manor?
questions.explanation: Bellatrix hurls a knife at the fleeing group, striking Dobby just after he Apparates them to safety.

questions.question_text: How do Harry and his friends escape Malfoy Manor's cellar to reach the safety of Shell Cottage?
distractors: They use a Portkey hidden in a teacup
They Floo out through the fireplace
questions.explanation: Dobby's timely rescue and Apparition get the group out just as Bellatrix attacks.

questions.question_text: What payment does the goblin Griphook demand in exchange for helping the trio break into Gringotts?
distractors: A share of the vault's gold
questions.explanation: Griphook insists on taking the sword as his price for planning the Gringotts heist.

questions.question_text: What does Griphook do once he actually receives the Sword of Gryffindor, betraying his agreement with the trio?
questions.correct_answer: He keeps it and flees with it
distractors: He hands it over to the goblins' council
He melts it down for gold
questions.explanation: Griphook escapes with the sword during the Gringotts break-in, leaving Harry and friends without it.

questions.question_text: Whose portrait provides the trio a secret passage from the Hog's Head into Hogwarts during Deathly Hallows?
questions.explanation: Aberforth reveals a hidden tunnel behind his late sister Ariana's portrait, leading into the castle.

questions.question_text: Who has been secretly leading a revived version of Dumbledore's Army at Hogwarts during the trio's absence?
questions.explanation: Neville steps up as a leader of resistance against Snape's regime at Hogwarts.

questions.question_text: Which ghost tells Harry about the lost diadem, revealing her true identity as Ravenclaw's own daughter?
questions.explanation: The Grey Lady confides in Harry about the diadem she stole from her mother and where it is hidden.

questions.question_text: Whose disarming of Dumbledore atop the Astronomy Tower actually transfers the Elder Wand's true allegiance, unbeknownst to Snape?
questions.explanation: Wand lore holds that defeating a wand's owner in combat transfers its true loyalty, which Draco does by disarming Dumbledore.

questions.question_text: How does Harry, rather than Draco, ultimately become the Elder Wand's true master before the final duel with Voldemort?
questions.correct_answer: By disarming Draco Malfoy at Malfoy Manor
distractors: By defeating Voldemort in an earlier duel
By inheriting it directly from Dumbledore's will
By retrieving it from Dumbledore's tomb himself
questions.explanation: Harry unknowingly wins the wand's allegiance when he disarms Draco during the escape from Malfoy Manor.

questions.question_text: What does Harry choose to do with the Elder Wand after finally defeating Voldemort?
questions.correct_answer: Return it to Dumbledore's tomb after repairing his own wand
distractors: Keep it as his primary wand
Give it to Ron for safekeeping
questions.explanation: Harry decides the wand's power is too dangerous to keep and restores it to Dumbledore's resting place.

questions.question_text: What happens to Peter Pettigrew's own silver hand when he hesitates to kill Harry in the cellar at Malfoy Manor?
questions.explanation: Voldemort's magical gift punishes Pettigrew's momentary mercy with a fatal, uncontrollable grip.

questions.question_text: Why does Pettigrew's silver hand ultimately turn against its own owner in that cellar confrontation?
questions.correct_answer: Because Harry once showed him mercy, creating an unpaid life-debt
distractors: Because it was defective from the start
Because Voldemort ordered it to punish failure automatically
questions.explanation: Pettigrew's hesitation, rooted in the life-debt he owes Harry from Prisoner of Azkaban, triggers the hand's betrayal.

questions.question_text: Which Horcrux does Hermione destroy using a Basilisk fang during the Battle of Hogwarts?
questions.explanation: Hermione stabs the cup with a fang retrieved from the Chamber of Secrets, destroying that Horcrux.

questions.question_text: What does Harry use the Room of Requirement for during his fight against Snape's regime at Hogwarts?
questions.correct_answer: Hiding fellow resisters of Dumbledore's Army
questions.explanation: The Room of Requirement becomes a refuge where D.A. members hide from Death Eater teachers.

questions.question_text: Who kills Nagini, Voldemort's final remaining Horcrux, during the Battle of Hogwarts?
questions.correct_answer: Neville Longbottom, with the Sword of Gryffindor
distractors: Ron Weasley, with a Basilisk fang
questions.explanation: Neville pulls the sword from the burning Sorting Hat and beheads Nagini in one stroke.

questions.question_text: What does Voldemort's Killing Curse actually destroy within Harry in the forest, rather than killing him outright?
questions.correct_answer: The Horcrux, or soul fragment, lodged inside him
questions.explanation: The curse annihilates only the piece of Voldemort's soul that had clung to Harry since infancy.

questions.question_text: Who does Harry see and speak with in the strange, limbo-like "King's Cross" scene after being struck by Voldemort's curse?
questions.explanation: Harry finds himself in a bright, empty version of King's Cross Station, talking with Dumbledore.

questions.question_text: Which two figures, besides James and Lily, appear via the Resurrection Stone to walk with Harry into the forest?
questions.explanation: Harry turns the stone three times and is joined by his parents, Sirius, and Lupin for his final walk.

questions.question_text: What object, given to Harry in Dumbledore's will, is later discovered to contain the Resurrection Stone?
questions.correct_answer: A Golden Snitch, from Harry's first Quidditch match
questions.explanation: The Snitch only opens for Harry once he is willing to accept death, revealing the hidden stone inside.

questions.question_text: Whose Patronus, revealed via memory to take the form of a doe, proves his lifelong love for Lily Potter?
questions.explanation: Snape's doe Patronus matches Lily's own, a secret sign of devotion Harry only understands later.

questions.question_text: What Unbreakable Vow does Snape make with Narcissa Malfoy, obligating him to act if Draco fails his task?
questions.correct_answer: To protect Draco and complete his mission himself if necessary
distractors: To hide Draco from Voldemort entirely
To smuggle Draco out of the country
questions.explanation: The Vow ultimately binds Snape to kill Dumbledore when Draco cannot bring himself to do it.

questions.question_text: What task does Voldemort assign Draco Malfoy as punishment for his father Lucius's failure at the Ministry?
distractors: To infiltrate the Order of the Phoenix
questions.explanation: Draco is given an impossible mission meant to punish and likely doom the Malfoy family.

questions.question_text: What poisoned gift, originally meant for Dumbledore or Slughorn, nearly kills Ron Weasley instead?
questions.explanation: Ron drinks poisoned mead meant for someone else at a party, nearly dying before Harry intervenes.

questions.question_text: What antidote does Harry force-feed Ron immediately after the poisoning, saved thanks to Slughorn's private stock?
questions.explanation: Harry remembers Snape's old lesson that a bezoar can save someone from most poisons.

questions.question_text: What cursed object, smuggled into Hogwarts under an Imperius Curse, nearly kills Katie Bell?
questions.explanation: Katie is cursed after touching the necklace she was Imperiused into carrying to Hogwarts.

questions.question_text: Which spell, found scrawled in Harry's secondhand potions textbook, does he use against Draco Malfoy, nearly killing him?
questions.explanation: Harry uses the unfamiliar spell without knowing its full effects, causing Draco severe injuries.

questions.question_text: Whose handwriting turns out to belong to the mysterious "Half-Blood Prince" in Harry's potions textbook?
questions.correct_answer: Severus Snape's, from his own school days
questions.explanation: Snape had annotated the book as a student, nicknaming himself after his mixed parentage.

questions.question_text: What injury does Dumbledore already carry at the start of Half-Blood Prince, from destroying a Horcrux carelessly?
questions.explanation: Dumbledore's hand is cursed after he destroys the Gaunt ring Horcrux without proper caution.

questions.question_text: Which Horcrux, in the form of a ring, does Dumbledore destroy with the Sword of Gryffindor, cursing himself in the process?
questions.explanation: The ring carries a curse that begins killing Dumbledore slowly after he destroys it.

questions.question_text: What object do Dumbledore and Harry retrieve from the cave, only to discover it is a decoy rather than the real Horcrux?
questions.correct_answer: A locket, later found to be fake and signed by "R.A.B."
questions.explanation: The real locket had already been swapped out by Regulus Black years earlier.

questions.question_text: What must Dumbledore drink, in growing agony, before the fake locket can be retrieved from its basin in the cave?
questions.explanation: The potion causes Dumbledore immense suffering and hallucinations as he is forced to keep drinking it.

questions.question_text: What creatures rise from the water to attack Harry and Dumbledore in the lake surrounding the Horcrux cave?
questions.explanation: Reanimated corpses called Inferi swarm the lake, nearly dragging Harry under before Dumbledore intervenes.

questions.question_text: What does Dumbledore do to Harry atop the tower to keep him frozen and hidden during the confrontation with Malfoy?
questions.correct_answer: Casts a Body-Bind and conceals him under the Invisibility Cloak
distractors: Sends him back to the common room
Turns him temporarily invisible with a potion
Locks him in a broom cupboard
questions.explanation: Dumbledore immobilizes and hides Harry moments before Malfoy and the Death Eaters arrive.

questions.question_text: Besides Draco, which notorious werewolf enters Hogwarts through the repaired Vanishing Cabinet on the night of Dumbledore's death?
questions.explanation: Greyback is among the Death Eaters who slip into the castle alongside Draco that night.

questions.question_text: What must Wormtail sacrifice as his own contribution to the ritual that restores Voldemort's body?
distractors: A vial of his blood only
questions.explanation: The ritual demands "flesh of the servant, willingly given," and Wormtail severs his own hand.

questions.question_text: What does Barty Crouch Jr. do to his own father to prevent him from exposing the plot during the Triwizard Tournament?
distractors: Has him arrested by the Ministry
questions.explanation: Crouch Jr. kills his father near the edge of the Forbidden Forest to silence him.

questions.question_text: Where does Barty Crouch Jr. hide his father's body after killing him during the Triwizard Tournament?
questions.correct_answer: Buried in Hagrid's pumpkin patch, after transfiguring it into a bone
questions.explanation: The body is disguised and buried right under everyone's noses at Hagrid's hut.

questions.question_text: What ultimately happens to Barty Crouch Jr. before the Ministry can properly interrogate him about Voldemort's return?
questions.correct_answer: A Dementor administers the Kiss to him
distractors: He confesses fully and is sent to Azkaban
questions.explanation: Fudge brings a Dementor along, which sucks out Crouch Jr.'s soul before he can be questioned, to Dumbledore's fury.

questions.question_text: What part of the prophecy about Harry and Voldemort does Snape actually overhear before being caught eavesdropping?
questions.correct_answer: Only the first part, up to "born as the seventh month dies"
distractors: The entire prophecy, word for word
Only the final line naming Harry directly
Nothing at all; he only hears rumors of it later
questions.explanation: Snape is thrown out by the barman before hearing the prophecy's second half, which matters greatly later.
questions.source_ref: Order of the Phoenix / Half-Blood Prince

questions.question_text: Besides Harry, which other baby born at the end of July fits the prophecy's description just as well?
questions.explanation: Both Harry and Neville were born as the seventh month died to parents who had thrice defied Voldemort.

questions.question_text: On what date is Neville Longbottom born, one day before the boy the prophecy ultimately comes to mark?
questions.explanation: Neville's birthday falls the day before Harry's, making him the prophecy's other possible subject.

questions.question_text: According to Trelawney's prophecy, when must the one with power to vanquish the Dark Lord be born?
distractors: On the Dark Lord's own birthday
questions.explanation: This phrase refers to the end of July, matching both Harry's and Neville's birthdates.

questions.question_text: According to Dumbledore and Slughorn's theory on Horcruxes, into how many total soul-fragments did Voldemort intend to split himself?
questions.explanation: Voldemort was drawn to the magical significance of the number seven when planning his Horcruxes.

questions.question_text: Not counting the fragment that remained in his own body, how many Horcruxes did Voldemort intentionally create?
questions.explanation: Voldemort deliberately made six Horcruxes, intending seven total fragments including himself.

questions.question_text: Which of Voldemort's soul-fragments was created entirely by accident, without his knowledge or intent?
questions.correct_answer: The piece that lodged inside Harry
questions.explanation: The backfiring curse on the night he attacked baby Harry accidentally split off an extra fragment of soul.

questions.question_text: Which Horcrux is destroyed first among all of Voldemort's soul-fragments, in the chronology of the books?
questions.explanation: Harry destroys the diary Horcrux with a Basilisk fang at the end of Chamber of Secrets, years before the others are found.

questions.question_text: Which Horcrux does Dumbledore destroy on his own, sometime before the events of Half-Blood Prince even begin?
questions.explanation: Dumbledore destroys the ring shortly before the school year starts, cursing his hand in the process.

questions.question_text: Which Horcrux is destroyed last of all, during the Battle of Hogwarts itself?
questions.explanation: Neville beheads Nagini near the very end of the battle, moments before Harry's final confrontation with Voldemort.

questions.question_text: What relation is Regulus Black, who signed the note found in the fake locket as "R.A.B.", to Sirius Black?
questions.explanation: Regulus, though initially a Death Eater, secretly turned against Voldemort before his death.

questions.question_text: What experience ultimately turns Regulus Black against Voldemort, leading him to steal and hide the real locket Horcrux?
questions.correct_answer: Witnessing what the cave's potion and Inferi nearly did to Kreacher
distractors: Reading Dumbledore's private notes on Horcruxes
Falling in love with a Muggle-born witch
questions.explanation: Kreacher's harrowing account of the cave convinces Regulus that Voldemort must be stopped, whatever the cost.

questions.question_text: Whose detailed account of the Horcrux cave's dangers helps Harry finally deduce the truth about the fake locket?
questions.explanation: Kreacher recounts his ordeal serving Regulus at the cave, giving Harry the missing pieces of the puzzle.

questions.question_text: What finally wins Kreacher's genuine loyalty to Harry, after years of resenting the Order of the Phoenix?
questions.correct_answer: Harry's kindness in honoring Regulus's memory and giving Kreacher the locket
distractors: A direct order from Sirius Black
A gift of expensive house-elf clothing
questions.explanation: Kreacher's devotion shifts once Harry treats him with respect and returns Regulus's locket to him.

questions.question_text: What crucial truth about Snape's loyalty is confirmed to Harry only through memories viewed after Snape's own death?
questions.correct_answer: That Snape loved Lily and had protected Harry on Dumbledore's orders all along
distractors: That Snape had been secretly working for Voldemort the entire time
That Snape was never truly loyal to anyone
That Snape had been an Animagus in secret
questions.explanation: Snape's memories, given to Harry in his dying moments, reveal a lifetime of hidden loyalty to Lily and her son.

questions.question_text: What does Harry learn from Snape's memories that he must willingly do once he reaches the Forbidden Forest?
distractors: Turn himself in to the Ministry
Retrieve the Resurrection Stone from Dumbledore
questions.explanation: Harry discovers he himself is a Horcrux and must die for Voldemort to become mortal again.

questions.question_text: Why does Harry survive being struck by Voldemort's Killing Curse in the Forbidden Forest?
questions.correct_answer: Because only the Horcrux within him is destroyed, thanks to protection from his mother's blood in Voldemort's own body
distractors: Because he wandlessly cast a Shield Charm
Because the Elder Wand refused to kill its true master
Because Snape's Patronus intervened at the last moment
questions.explanation: Voldemort's use of Harry's blood to rebuild his body inadvertently extended Lily's old protection to Harry.

questions.question_text: What protection, extended unknowingly by Voldemort's own actions, shields Harry and the defenders in the Great Hall during the final battle?
questions.correct_answer: The blood protection Voldemort unwittingly gave Harry by using his blood to return
distractors: A ward cast earlier by Dumbledore
The combined magic of the four Hogwarts houses
questions.explanation: Because Voldemort used Harry's blood in his resurrection, Lily's old protective magic persists and extends to others Harry is protecting.

questions.question_text: Why is Neville Longbottom able to draw the Sword of Gryffindor from the burning Sorting Hat, despite not being its official owner?
questions.correct_answer: The sword can present itself to any true, worthy Gryffindor in a moment of need
distractors: Dumbledore had secretly bequeathed it to him
He is a distant descendant of Godric Gryffindor
He had stolen it earlier from Bellatrix's vault
