questions.question_text: Which single scene features Harry's own hair, six Polyjuice-disguised decoys, and Death Eaters attacking mid-flight?
questions.correct_answer: The 'Seven Potters' escape from Privet Drive in Deathly Hallows
distractors: The battle at the Department of Mysteries
The pursuit during the Triwizard Tournament's Second Task
questions.explanation: The Seven Potters plan combines all these elements as the Order tries to smuggle Harry to safety.

questions.question_text: Which of these accurately distinguishes the Girding Potion from the Wideye Potion, based on their names?
questions.correct_answer: One is meant to fortify or brace the drinker, the other to keep them awake and alert
distractors: Both are meant purely to induce euphoria
Both are meant purely to reverse aging
Both are banned from classroom use entirely
questions.explanation: Despite both appearing in the same NEWT textbook, the Girding Potion and Wideye Potion serve different implied purposes based on their names.

questions.question_text: Which single ingredient does Harry's supply list call for in powdered form as a first-year, and which is also the part of the creature NOT used as a wand core?
questions.explanation: Powdered unicorn horn is a listed Potions ingredient, distinct from unicorn hair, which serves as a wand core instead.

questions.question_text: Which of these is true about Fawkes's healing tears, based on how they are used in the series?
questions.correct_answer: They cure both Harry's Basilisk wound and heal Dumbledore's other injuries at various points
distractors: They can only be used once per phoenix's lifetime
They require a separate incantation to activate their healing power
They only work on injuries caused by Dark magic specifically
questions.explanation: Fawkes's tears prove broadly restorative across the series, notably saving Harry from Basilisk venom.

questions.question_text: Which single potion's brewing process both takes around six months according to Slughorn and produces a result Harry later pretends, rather than actually gives, to Ron?
questions.explanation: Felix Felicis takes about six months to brew properly, and it's this same potion Harry only pretends to slip into Ron's drink before a Quidditch match.

questions.question_text: Which of these is NOT a genuine reason Harry's OWL-year Potions class is disrupted, according to canon?
questions.correct_answer: A rogue Blast-Ended Skrewt escapes into the dungeon
distractors: Students are anxious about the upcoming exams
Draught of Peace mishaps occur during the practical exam
questions.explanation: Blast-Ended Skrewts belong to Care of Magical Creatures, not Potions, and never disrupt a Potions lesson in canon.

questions.question_text: Which single ingredient did Snape identify by three different names in Harry's first lesson, and which is also explicitly not a poison but a plant used in the Wolfsbane Potion?
questions.explanation: Aconite, known also as monkshood and wolfsbane, is the very plant behind Snape's opening riddle and the basis of the Wolfsbane Potion's name.

questions.question_text: Which of these best describes the relationship between the Draught of Living Death and the Wiggenweld-type antidotes some fans assume exist in canon?
questions.correct_answer: No such antidote is actually named or confirmed in the core books
distractors: The Wiggenweld Potion is explicitly named as its antidote in Half-Blood Prince
Felix Felicis is confirmed as its official antidote
Essence of Dittany is confirmed as its official antidote
questions.explanation: Despite popular fan assumptions, the core seven books never explicitly name an antidote to the Draught of Living Death.

questions.question_text: Which single character both teaches Potions after Snape's departure and is fooled into accepting Harry into NEWT Potions despite an 'Exceeds Expectations' O.W.L.?
questions.explanation: Slughorn both replaces Snape as Potions teacher and relaxes the entry standard, letting Harry join despite not earning an Outstanding.

questions.question_text: Which of these is the most accurate description of what happens to Neville's toad, Trevor, during a fourth-year Potions mishap?
questions.correct_answer: His legs vanish and then oddly regrow after Neville's botched Shrinking Solution
distractors: He is permanently transfigured into a teacup
He disappears entirely and is never seen again
He grows to the size of a large dog
questions.explanation: Neville's Shrinking Solution goes wrong, causing a strange reaction that affects Trevor's legs before Snape intervenes.

questions.question_text: Which single Potions-related object does Harry hide in the Room of Requirement after using a spell from it against Draco, fearing Snape will identify its true owner?
questions.correct_answer: The Half-Blood Prince's copy of Advanced Potion-Making
distractors: A vial of stolen Felix Felicis
A hidden batch of Polyjuice Potion
questions.explanation: After the Sectumsempra incident, Harry hides the annotated textbook among the countless objects in the Room of Requirement.

questions.question_text: Which of these is true about the ingredients Hermione steals from Snape's private stores for Polyjuice Potion?
questions.correct_answer: She takes them using a distraction, since simply asking Snape for them was never an option
distractors: Snape willingly supplies them once she explains the plan
She purchases them legally from the Apothecary instead
Dumbledore personally authorizes the theft in advance
questions.explanation: Getting caught with stolen ingredients from Snape's private stores would have meant serious trouble, so the trio relies on a distraction instead of permission.

questions.question_text: Which single plant's pods must be dug out from a thrashing root system in advanced Herbology, distinct from the plant that sprays Stinksap when squeezed?
questions.explanation: Snargaluffs are a separate, whip-rooted plant from Mimbulus Mimbletonia, requiring students to dig out pods while dodging its thrashing roots.

questions.question_text: Which of these is the most accurate statement about Golpalott's Third Law, as referenced in Harry's sixth-year Potions class?
questions.correct_answer: It concerns antidotes for blended poisons, not simple ones
distractors: It concerns the correct stirring direction for all potions
It concerns the legal requirements for brewing Polyjuice Potion
It concerns how long a potion must stew before use
questions.explanation: Golpalott's Third Law specifically addresses antidotes for poisons made of multiple components blended together.

questions.question_text: Which single detail ties together Ron's near-fatal poisoning by mead, Harry's first-year Potions lesson, and a stone found in a goat's stomach?
questions.correct_answer: The bezoar Harry uses to save Ron's life
distractors: The Wolfsbane Potion Snape brews monthly
The Felix Felicis Harry wins as a prize
The Draught of Peace from the O.W.L. exam
questions.explanation: All three details trace back to the same object: the bezoar first introduced in Harry's very first Potions class.

questions.question_text: How many Chasers play on each Quidditch team?
questions.explanation: Each team fields three Chasers, who handle the Quaffle and try to score goals.

questions.question_text: How many Beaters play on each Quidditch team?
questions.explanation: Two Beaters per team use bats to knock Bludgers away from their teammates.

questions.question_text: How many Keepers does each Quidditch team have on the pitch at once?
questions.explanation: A single Keeper guards each team's three hoops.

questions.question_text: How many Seekers does each Quidditch team have on the pitch at once?
questions.explanation: Each team has exactly one Seeker, tasked with catching the Golden Snitch.

questions.question_text: What color is the Quaffle?
questions.explanation: The Quaffle is a large red ball that Chasers pass and throw through the hoops.

questions.question_text: What color are the two Bludgers used in a Quidditch match?
questions.explanation: The Bludgers are coal-black iron balls that fly at players to knock them off their brooms.

questions.question_text: What color are the Golden Snitch's delicate wings?
questions.explanation: Although its body is gold, the Snitch's small wings are described as silver.

questions.question_text: About what size is the Golden Snitch?
questions.correct_answer: About the size of a walnut
distractors: About the size of a soccer ball
About the size of a grape
About the size of a human fist
questions.explanation: The Snitch is a tiny, walnut-sized ball, which is part of why it's so hard to catch.

questions.question_text: What shape is a standard Quidditch pitch?
questions.explanation: The Quidditch pitch is oval, with three hoops rising at each end.

questions.question_text: Counting both ends of the pitch together, how many goal hoops are used in a Quidditch match?
questions.explanation: There are three hoops at each end of the pitch, for six hoops total.

questions.question_text: What is the name of the trophy awarded to the Hogwarts house with the best Quidditch record each year?
questions.explanation: The Quidditch Cup is a separate prize from the overall House Cup, awarded for house Quidditch success.

questions.question_text: Which Hogwarts house does Harry Potter play Quidditch for?
questions.explanation: Harry is recruited onto the Gryffindor team as Seeker in his first year.

questions.question_text: What position does Cedric Diggory play for the Hufflepuff Quidditch team?
questions.explanation: Cedric is Hufflepuff's Seeker, and first faces Harry in a match during Prisoner of Azkaban.

questions.question_text: What colors make up the Gryffindor Quidditch team's robes?
questions.explanation: Gryffindor's house colors, scarlet and gold, are worn on their Quidditch robes.

questions.question_text: What colors make up the Slytherin Quidditch team's robes?
questions.explanation: Slytherin's house colors, green and silver, appear on their Quidditch robes.

questions.question_text: What colors make up the Ravenclaw Quidditch team's robes?
questions.explanation: Ravenclaw's house colors, blue and bronze, appear on their Quidditch robes.

questions.question_text: What colors make up the Hufflepuff Quidditch team's robes?
questions.explanation: Hufflepuff's house colors, yellow and black, appear on their Quidditch robes.

questions.question_text: What object does Harry chase and catch on his broom during his very first flying lesson, prompting Professor McGonagall to recruit him for Quidditch?
questions.explanation: Harry dives to catch Neville's dropped Remembrall after Malfoy throws it, impressing McGonagall.

questions.question_text: What must a Quidditch player use to fly during a match?
questions.explanation: All Quidditch players fly on broomsticks; no other means of flight is allowed in the game.

questions.question_text: The Quaffle is roughly comparable in size to what everyday object?
questions.explanation: The Quaffle is described as being about the size of a football (soccer ball).

questions.question_text: What piece of equipment does a Beater use to hit Bludgers away from teammates?
questions.explanation: Beaters carry small bats specifically to knock Bludgers off course.

questions.question_text: Aside from a match being called off, what event brings a normal Quidditch match to an end?
distractors: The referee blows a whistle at a set time
questions.explanation: A Quidditch match has no time limit and continues until the Snitch is caught.

questions.question_text: In what year at Hogwarts are students normally first allowed to bring their own broomsticks from home?
questions.explanation: First-years are ordinarily barred from having personal broomsticks at school; Harry is a rare exception.

questions.question_text: Before a Quidditch match begins, what does Madam Hooch tell the two team captains to do to each other?
questions.explanation: Madam Hooch has the captains shake hands before every match, sometimes tensely.

questions.question_text: Besides releasing the Bludgers and the Snitch, how does the referee start play at the beginning of a Quidditch match?
questions.correct_answer: By throwing the Quaffle into the air
distractors: By firing a spell into the sky
questions.explanation: Madam Hooch throws the Quaffle up to begin the match once the other balls are released.

questions.question_text: What happens when a Seeker catches the Golden Snitch during a Quidditch match?
questions.correct_answer: Their team gains 150 points and the match ends
distractors: Their team automatically wins regardless of score
questions.explanation: Catching the Snitch is worth 150 points and always ends the match immediately.

questions.question_text: What is the playing field where Hogwarts Quidditch matches take place commonly called?
questions.explanation: Hogwarts matches are played on the Quidditch pitch, an oval field with stands for spectators.

questions.question_text: Which house wins the Quidditch Cup at the end of Harry's second year, despite his arm shattering mid-match?
questions.explanation: Harry catches the Snitch one-handed just before collapsing, securing Gryffindor's win.

questions.question_text: In the Triwizard Tournament shown in Goblet of Fire, what object must each champion retrieve from a dragon during the first task?
questions.explanation: Each champion must snatch a golden egg from among a clutch guarded by a dragon.

questions.question_text: What kind of creature must each Triwizard champion get past during the tournament's first task?
questions.explanation: The first task pits each champion against a real, fully grown dragon.

questions.question_text: According to Professor McGonagall, Harry becomes the youngest Hogwarts Quidditch player of his kind in how long?
questions.explanation: McGonagall tells Wood that Harry will be the youngest Seeker in a century.

questions.question_text: What position does Draco Malfoy play for the Slytherin Quidditch team?
questions.explanation: Draco is Slytherin's Seeker, a spot his father's money helped secure for him in his second year.

questions.question_text: What position does Viktor Krum play for the Bulgarian national Quidditch team?
questions.explanation: Krum is renowned as one of the finest Seekers in the world.

questions.question_text: What position does Katie Bell play for the Gryffindor Quidditch team?
questions.explanation: Katie Bell is one of Gryffindor's Chasers for much of the series.

questions.question_text: What position does Alicia Spinnet play for the Gryffindor Quidditch team?
questions.explanation: Alicia Spinnet plays Chaser alongside Katie Bell and Angelina Johnson.

questions.question_text: Besides serving as Gryffindor's Quidditch captain, what position does Angelina Johnson play?
questions.explanation: Angelina Johnson is a Chaser who takes over as captain after Oliver Wood graduates.

questions.question_text: Which of Ron's older brothers was such a talented Hogwarts Seeker that he might have played for England, had he not left to study dragons in Romania?
questions.explanation: Charlie Weasley is remembered as a gifted Quidditch player who chose dragons over a professional career.

questions.question_text: Counting the Quaffle, the two Bludgers, and the Golden Snitch, how many balls are used in a standard Quidditch match?
questions.explanation: A Quidditch match uses four balls in total: one Quaffle, two Bludgers, and one Golden Snitch.

questions.question_text: Which of the following is NOT an official Quidditch playing position?
questions.explanation: The four real Quidditch positions are Chaser, Beater, Keeper, and Seeker; 'Striker' is not one of them.

questions.question_text: Among the choices below, which one is a made-up position that does not actually exist in Quidditch?
questions.explanation: The four real Quidditch positions are Chaser, Beater, Keeper, and Seeker; 'Blocker' is not one of them.

questions.question_text: What does the referee blow to signal the start of a Quidditch match?
questions.explanation: Madam Hooch blows her whistle to start play once the balls are released.

questions.question_text: Which two Quidditch positions are focused mainly on defense rather than scoring goals?
questions.explanation: Keepers guard the hoops and Beaters knock Bludgers away, while Chasers and the Seeker are the ones who score.

questions.question_text: If the Golden Snitch is worth 150 points, by how many points can a team be trailing and still win outright by catching it?
questions.explanation: Since the Snitch adds 150 points, a team behind by 149 or fewer will win the match if their Seeker catches it.

questions.question_text: Which Quidditch ball is round, dark, heavy, and tries to knock players off their brooms?
questions.explanation: The Bludgers are enchanted iron balls that fly at players to unseat them.

questions.question_text: Which Quidditch ball is large, red, and passed between Chasers to score goals?
questions.explanation: The Quaffle is the large red ball used for scoring through the hoops.

questions.question_text: Which Quidditch ball is tiny, gold, and has small silver wings?
questions.explanation: The Golden Snitch is the small winged ball that the Seeker chases.

questions.question_text: Which Quidditch position is often compared to a soccer goalkeeper?
questions.explanation: The Keeper defends the three hoops much like a goalkeeper defends a net.

questions.question_text: What position does Adrian Pucey play for the Slytherin Quidditch team?
questions.explanation: Adrian Pucey is one of Slytherin's Chasers during Harry's early years at Hogwarts.
questions.source_ref: Chamber of Secrets / Goblet of Fire

questions.question_text: What position does Miles Bletchley play for the Slytherin Quidditch team?
questions.explanation: Miles Bletchley guards Slytherin's hoops as their Keeper.

questions.question_text: Which Ministry of Magic department does Ludo Bagman head, overseeing wizarding sports?
questions.correct_answer: The Department of Magical Games and Sports
distractors: The Department of Magical Law Enforcement
The Department of International Magical Cooperation
questions.explanation: Bagman's Ministry job puts him in charge of organizing wizarding sporting events, including the World Cup.

questions.question_text: Which country hosts the Quidditch World Cup shown in Goblet of Fire?
questions.explanation: The 1994 World Cup final is held in Britain, drawing wizards from around the world.

questions.question_text: What does Professor McGonagall do with Harry's anonymously-gifted Firebolt before allowing him to ride it?
questions.correct_answer: She confiscates it to have it checked for hexes or curses
distractors: She immediately bans it from school forever
She sends it back to the anonymous sender
She has Professor Flitwick enlarge it
questions.explanation: Fearing Sirius Black sent it, McGonagall has the Firebolt examined before returning it to Harry.

questions.question_text: What charm does Hermione cast on Harry's glasses before a rain-soaked Quidditch match in Prisoner of Azkaban?
questions.explanation: Hermione's Impervius Charm repels water from Harry's glasses so he can see through the downpour.

questions.question_text: What does Oliver Wood call during the chaotic Chamber of Secrets match to check on Harry after a rogue Bludger keeps attacking him?
questions.explanation: Wood calls a time-out to have Harry's condition checked before play resumes.

questions.question_text: Who captains the Ravenclaw Quidditch team and also escorts Fleur Delacour to the Yule Ball?
questions.explanation: Roger Davies, a Ravenclaw Chaser and captain, is Fleur's Yule Ball date.

questions.question_text: Besides temporarily filling in as Seeker during Order of the Phoenix, what position does Ginny Weasley usually play for Gryffindor in Half-Blood Prince?
questions.explanation: Ginny settles into the Chaser role for Gryffindor once Harry returns to play Seeker himself.

questions.question_text: How do Fred and George Weasley dramatically leave Hogwarts for good during Order of the Phoenix?
questions.correct_answer: They fly off together on their broomsticks after setting off fireworks
distractors: They Apparate away in front of the whole school
They take the Hogwarts Express early
They use a Portkey arranged by their mother
questions.explanation: As a parting shot against Umbridge, the twins set off spectacular fireworks and fly away from Hogwarts on their brooms for good.

questions.question_text: In which book does no Hogwarts Quidditch season take place at all, because the school year is dominated by war?
questions.explanation: With Hogwarts under Death Eater control and the trio on the run, no Quidditch is played during the events of Deathly Hallows.

questions.question_text: How many judges score each task of the Triwizard Tournament, out of a possible ten points?
questions.explanation: The heads of the three schools plus two Ministry officials serve as the five judges.

questions.question_text: Whom does the Triwizard Tournament take as Viktor Krum's hostage for the second task's underwater rescue?
questions.explanation: Hermione is chosen as what Krum, as Harry's friend, would most miss, since he had grown close to her.

questions.question_text: When a foul is committed in Quidditch, what is the fouled team typically awarded?
questions.correct_answer: A free shot at goal (a penalty)
distractors: An extra Chaser for one minute
questions.explanation: As in many sports, a Quidditch foul results in a penalty shot for the wronged team.

questions.question_text: About how high up are the goal hoops mounted on their poles at each end of a Quidditch pitch?
questions.explanation: The three hoops are mounted high in the air, roughly fifty feet up, making accurate shooting difficult.

questions.question_text: Which two graduating Chasers, along with two departed Beaters, does Harry need to replace when he becomes Gryffindor's Quidditch captain in Half-Blood Prince?
questions.correct_answer: Angelina Johnson and Alicia Spinnet (Chasers), Fred and George Weasley (Beaters)
distractors: Katie Bell and Angelina Johnson, and Ron and Ginny Weasley
Cho Chang and Cedric Diggory, and Oliver Wood and Percy Weasley
Demelza Robins and Ginny Weasley, and Jimmy Peakes and Ritchie Coote
questions.explanation: Angelina and Alicia graduate while Fred and George leave school early, forcing Harry to rebuild much of the team.

questions.question_text: Which returning Gryffindor Chaser, previously the target of a cursed necklace, keeps her spot on the Quidditch team throughout Half-Blood Prince?
questions.explanation: Despite being harmed by Draco's cursed necklace earlier in the book, Katie Bell recovers and continues playing Chaser.

questions.question_text: How is Harry given the position of Gryffindor Quidditch captain in Half-Blood Prince?
questions.correct_answer: Professor McGonagall simply appoints him, with no team vote
distractors: The team elects him by a majority vote
He wins a captaincy tryout against Ron
questions.explanation: McGonagall hands Harry his captain's badge directly rather than holding any kind of election.

questions.question_text: Which two Quidditch positions are capable of directly adding points to their team's score?
questions.explanation: Chasers score goals worth ten points each, and the Seeker scores 150 points by catching the Snitch; Beaters and Keepers do not score directly.

questions.question_text: Of these four options, which one is not a genuine Quidditch position a player could be assigned to?
questions.explanation: The four real Quidditch positions are Chaser, Beater, Keeper, and Seeker; 'Guard' is not one of them.

questions.question_text: Which of the following is NOT one of the four balls used in an official Quidditch match?
questions.explanation: The Firebolt is a broomstick, not one of the four balls used in Quidditch.

questions.question_text: Roughly how wide (side to side) is a full-sized Quidditch pitch, according to its official dimensions?
questions.explanation: The pitch is oval, roughly 500 feet long and 180 feet wide.

questions.question_text: Which Slytherin player served as Seeker before Draco Malfoy took over the position in Chamber of Secrets, only to be pushed aside thanks to Lucius Malfoy's donations?
questions.explanation: Terence Higgs loses his Seeker spot when Lucius Malfoy buys the team's way onto the field with new brooms for Draco.

questions.question_text: What does Angelina Johnson become notorious for as Gryffindor's Quidditch captain in Order of the Phoenix?
questions.correct_answer: Running extremely long, grueling practice sessions
distractors: Insisting the team switch positions every week
questions.explanation: Angelina's marathon practices exhaust the team, much to their complaints.

questions.question_text: What nickname does the Chudley Cannons' poor Quidditch performance earn them among fans, reflecting their long losing streak?
questions.correct_answer: Perennial underdogs / a famously unsuccessful team
distractors: The most feared team in Britain
questions.explanation: The Chudley Cannons are a beloved but chronically underperforming professional team.

questions.question_text: In Prisoner of Azkaban, roughly how many points was Gryffindor leading by when Dementors invaded the pitch and Harry fell from his broom?
questions.explanation: Gryffindor was comfortably ahead when the Dementors' presence overwhelmed Harry mid-flight.

questions.question_text: During the Chamber of Secrets match, what does Draco Malfoy do to Harry's broom that should have been called as a foul?
questions.correct_answer: He grabs onto the tail of Harry's broom to slow him down
distractors: He curses the broom to buck wildly
He swaps Harry's broom for a hexed one
He throws his wand at Harry's broom
questions.explanation: Malfoy grabs Harry's broom tail during the chase for the Snitch, an obvious foul that goes unpunished.

questions.question_text: What is Snape actually doing while muttering under his breath and staring at Harry's broom during Harry's first Quidditch match?
questions.correct_answer: Casting a counter-curse to save Harry from Quirrell's jinx
distractors: Casting the curse that endangers Harry
Reciting a protective charm for himself
questions.explanation: Hermione wrongly assumes Snape is jinxing the broom, when he is actually countering Quirrell's curse.

questions.question_text: Which professor does Hermione wrongly blame and briefly set on fire, believing he is jinxing Harry's broom during Harry's first match?
questions.explanation: Hermione sets Snape's robes alight, unaware that Quirrell is the one actually cursing the broom.

questions.question_text: What is the final task of the Triwizard Tournament in Goblet of Fire?
questions.correct_answer: Navigating a giant hedge maze to reach the Triwizard Cup
distractors: Solving a series of riddles in the library
A duel between all four champions
questions.explanation: The third task sends champions into a dangerous, ever-shifting hedge maze.

questions.question_text: What magical object provided the clue Cedric Diggory shares with Harry about the second Triwizard task, hidden inside the golden egg?
distractors: A riddle written in invisible ink
questions.explanation: The golden egg wails horribly in air but reveals a mermaid song when opened underwater.

questions.question_text: Which Hufflepuff Chaser, later a member of Dumbledore's Army, is known among his housemates for being rather full of himself?
questions.explanation: Zacharias Smith plays Chaser for Hufflepuff and is portrayed as arrogant and argumentative in the DA.

questions.question_text: What must Harry do to help Gryffindor secure the Quidditch Cup at the end of Prisoner of Azkaban, after his Nimbus 2000 was destroyed earlier that year?
questions.correct_answer: Win the rescheduled match against Ravenclaw using his new Firebolt
distractors: Forfeit his final match to Slytherin
Sit out the rest of the season entirely
questions.explanation: With his Firebolt finally returned, Harry helps Gryffindor beat Ravenclaw and reclaim the Quidditch Cup.

questions.question_text: What is unusual about the enchanted gold that Fred and George win from Ludo Bagman after betting on the World Cup?
questions.correct_answer: It vanishes after a few hours because it is leprechaun gold
distractors: It turns into real, permanent gold
It is confiscated by the Ministry
questions.explanation: Leprechaun gold is famously unstable, which becomes an issue when Bagman uses it to pay a debt.

questions.question_text: Which two magical creatures serve as rival mascots for Ireland and Bulgaria at the Quidditch World Cup, respectively?
questions.explanation: Ireland's leprechauns and Bulgaria's Veela both put on dazzling displays before the World Cup final.

questions.question_text: What does Cornelius Fudge repeatedly and awkwardly do when introduced to the Bulgarian Minister of Magic in the Top Box at the World Cup?
questions.correct_answer: Greet him loudly and slowly in English, assuming he can't understand
questions.explanation: Fudge embarrasses himself by over-enunciating English at the Bulgarian minister, who in fact speaks it perfectly well.

questions.question_text: Which Weasley brother, despite being close with Ron and the twins, never plays for the Gryffindor Quidditch team during his time at Hogwarts?
questions.explanation: Unlike his more athletic siblings, Percy is never shown playing Quidditch, focusing instead on prefect and Head Boy duties.

questions.question_text: Which three Gryffindor Chasers play together as an all-female trio throughout Order of the Phoenix?
questions.correct_answer: Angelina Johnson, Katie Bell, and Alicia Spinnet
distractors: Angelina Johnson, Ginny Weasley, and Katie Bell
Katie Bell, Alicia Spinnet, and Demelza Robins
Angelina Johnson, Alicia Spinnet, and Cho Chang
questions.explanation: All three of Gryffindor's Chasers during this era are witches, with Angelina also serving as captain.

questions.question_text: In which book does Cho Chang first appear, facing off against Harry as Ravenclaw's rival Seeker?
questions.explanation: Cho Chang and her Ravenclaw team first play against Gryffindor in Prisoner of Azkaban.

questions.question_text: Which Hogwarts house matchup is traditionally treated as the fiercest rivalry of the school Quidditch season?
questions.explanation: Matches between Gryffindor and Slytherin are consistently portrayed as the most tense and high-stakes of the year.

questions.question_text: What ordinary object serves as the Portkey that carries Harry and the Weasleys to the Quidditch World Cup campsite?
questions.explanation: The group grabs hold of a manky old boot precisely at the appointed time to be whisked to Stoatshead Hill.

questions.question_text: Which fellow Hogwarts student and his father join Harry and the Weasleys on the hike to the World Cup Portkey?
questions.correct_answer: Cedric Diggory and his father, Amos Diggory
questions.explanation: Amos Diggory, an old friend of Arthur Weasley's, brings Cedric along to share the Portkey.

questions.question_text: What unusually specific bet do Fred and George Weasley place with Ludo Bagman before the Quidditch World Cup final?
questions.correct_answer: That Ireland would win, but Viktor Krum would catch the Snitch
distractors: That the match would end in a draw
That Bulgaria would win by exactly ten points
That the match would last more than a week
questions.explanation: Their improbable prediction turns out to be exactly right, though getting paid becomes its own headache.

questions.question_text: If a Quidditch player is too injured to continue and no substitutes are allowed mid-match, what is the team's only option?
questions.correct_answer: Play on with one fewer player
distractors: Call in a reserve from the stands
Pause the match until the player recovers
questions.explanation: Quidditch's no-substitution rule means an injured player's team must simply carry on shorthanded.

questions.question_text: What single word does Madam Hooch instruct first-years to say to command their broomsticks to rise from the ground?
questions.explanation: During their first flying lesson, students are told to say 'Up!' firmly to get their brooms to jump into their hands.

questions.question_text: Which top-of-the-line broomstick is famous for having no serial number or manufacturer stamp because it was handcrafted individually?
questions.explanation: The Firebolt is a bespoke, individually registered broom rather than a mass-produced model.

questions.question_text: Which Weasley brother's departure from the Gryffindor team, according to Oliver Wood, marked the last time before Prisoner of Azkaban's finale that Gryffindor had won the Quidditch Cup?
questions.explanation: Wood laments that Gryffindor hasn't lifted the Cup since Charlie, a talented Seeker, left Hogwarts.

questions.question_text: What does Hermione secretly do to Cormac McLaggen during Gryffindor Quidditch tryouts in Half-Blood Prince, ensuring Ron wins the Keeper spot?
questions.correct_answer: She casts a Confundus Charm on him
distractors: She hexes his broomstick to veer off course
She slips him a Sleeping Draught
questions.explanation: Hermione's secret Confundus Charm causes McLaggen to fly the wrong way at a crucial moment, handing Ron the win.

questions.question_text: Which Golden Snitch does Dumbledore bequeath to Harry in his will, later revealed to conceal the Resurrection Stone?
questions.correct_answer: The very first Snitch Harry ever caught, in his first Hogwarts Quidditch match
distractors: A Snitch used in the 1994 World Cup final
A Snitch personally signed by Viktor Krum
A specially enchanted training Snitch from Oliver Wood
questions.explanation: Dumbledore leaves Harry the Snitch he caught in his mouth during his very first match, which hides the Resurrection Stone.

questions.question_text: What words does Harry finally speak to open the Golden Snitch left to him in Dumbledore's will, on his way to face Voldemort?
distractors: "I solemnly swear that I am up to no good."
questions.explanation: The engraved phrase 'I open at the close' is the riddle; the Snitch actually opens when Harry accepts he is about to die.

questions.question_text: Why can only Harry open the Golden Snitch left to him in Dumbledore's will?
questions.correct_answer: Because Snitches have a flesh memory and bond to the first bare hand that ever touched them
distractors: Because it is keyed to his wand's core
Because Dumbledore cast a Fidelius Charm on it
Because only Gryffindor Seekers can open Snitches
questions.explanation: Hermione explains that Snitches remember the first person to touch them bare-handed, which is why it opens only for Harry.

questions.question_text: Starting in Order of the Phoenix, who serves as both Seeker and captain of the Slytherin Quidditch team?
questions.explanation: Draco is made captain in addition to his Seeker role, a favor arranged partly through Umbridge's influence.

questions.question_text: Which two of Draco Malfoy's cronies join the Slytherin Quidditch team as Beaters once he becomes captain?
questions.explanation: Crabbe and Goyle are added as Beaters more for their size than their skill once Draco takes charge.

questions.question_text: Which dragon does Harry draw for the first Triwizard task, a result that also makes him the last champion to compete?
questions.explanation: Harry draws the fiercest dragon, the Hungarian Horntail, and by the rules of the draw he goes last.

questions.question_text: Which former professional Beater and Ministry official provides commentary for both the Quidditch World Cup final and the Triwizard Tournament's tasks?
questions.explanation: Bagman, a former Wimbourne Wasps Beater turned Ministry sports official, commentates both events.

questions.question_text: In Half-Blood Prince, what disastrous mistake does Cormac McLaggen make while filling in as Keeper for an injured Ron during a match?
questions.correct_answer: He knocks Harry unconscious by swinging a Beater's bat without warning
distractors: He accidentally scores a goal for the other team
He drops the Quaffle into the crowd
questions.explanation: Eager to give the Beaters advice, McLaggen swings a bat and knocks Harry out, costing Gryffindor the match.

questions.question_text: Which three new players does Harry recruit for the Gryffindor Quidditch team as Chaser and Beaters in Half-Blood Prince?
questions.correct_answer: Demelza Robins (Chaser), and Jimmy Peakes and Ritchie Coote (Beaters)
distractors: Andrew Kirke, Jack Sloper, and Colin Creevey
Vicky Frobisher, Geoffrey Hooper, and Dean Thomas
Luna Lovegood, Neville Longbottom, and Seamus Finnigan
questions.explanation: Harry rebuilds the team around Demelza Robins, Jimmy Peakes, and Ritchie Coote after several departures.

questions.question_text: Which opposing house does Gryffindor defeat in the deciding match that wins them the Quidditch Cup at the end of Half-Blood Prince, with Ginny filling in for the detained Harry?
questions.explanation: Ginny catches the Snitch against Ravenclaw while Harry is stuck in detention with Snape, sealing the Cup for Gryffindor.

questions.question_text: Who eventually overturns Dolores Umbridge's lifetime Quidditch ban on Harry, Fred, and George?
questions.correct_answer: Professor McGonagall, after Umbridge is removed from power
distractors: Albus Dumbledore, before he leaves the school
questions.explanation: Once Umbridge's authority collapses, McGonagall lifts the unjust bans on the three players.

questions.question_text: Why does Harry keep playing through a shattered arm rather than leaving the pitch during the Chamber of Secrets match?
questions.correct_answer: Because Quidditch rules do not allow mid-match substitutions
distractors: Because Madam Hooch refuses to stop the match
Because Gryffindor had already used its one substitution
Because leaving would have disqualified the whole team
questions.explanation: With no substitutes permitted once play begins, Harry has to keep flying if Gryffindor is to have any chance.

questions.question_text: In what order does Madam Hooch release the four Quidditch balls at the very start of a match?
questions.correct_answer: The Snitch and Bludgers first, then the Quaffle thrown up last
distractors: The Quaffle first, then the Bludgers, then the Snitch
All four balls are released simultaneously
The Bludgers first, then the Snitch, then the Quaffle
questions.explanation: The Snitch and Bludgers are set loose before the whistle, with the Quaffle thrown into the air to actually start play.

questions.question_text: Does a goal scored through a Quidditch hoop's smaller, harder-to-reach top ring count for more points than one through a lower hoop?
questions.correct_answer: No, every hoop is worth the same ten points
distractors: Yes, twenty points, since it's harder to reach
Yes, but only five extra points
Yes, fifteen points for the top hoop
questions.explanation: Despite differing heights, every goal through any of the six hoops is worth the standard ten points.

questions.question_text: Which position does Demelza Robins play after joining the Gryffindor team in Half-Blood Prince?
questions.explanation: Demelza Robins joins as one of Gryffindor's new Chasers under Harry's captaincy.

questions.question_text: Which position do both Jimmy Peakes and Ritchie Coote play after joining the Gryffindor team in Half-Blood Prince?
questions.explanation: Peakes and Coote are recruited as the team's new Beaters after Fred and George leave.

questions.question_text: Which minor Slytherin Chaser is mentioned playing alongside Adrian Pucey during Harry's early Hogwarts years?
questions.explanation: Warrington plays Chaser for Slytherin's squad in the years surrounding the Chamber of Secrets and Goblet of Fire matches.

questions.question_text: What does the term 'Wronski Feint' describe in Quidditch?
questions.correct_answer: A risky fake dive meant to lure the opposing Seeker into a dangerous fall
distractors: A defensive formation used by Chasers
An illegal grab of an opponent's broom tail
A method of enchanting a Bludger
questions.explanation: Krum performs the Wronski Feint against Ireland's Seeker during the World Cup final.

questions.question_text: Which Gryffindor Chaser and Quidditch captain conducts notoriously exhausting practice sessions in Order of the Phoenix?
questions.explanation: As captain, Angelina pushes the team through grueling, lengthy practices.

questions.question_text: What mocking song do Slytherin students sing about Ron Weasley's Keeper performance in Half-Blood Prince?
questions.explanation: Slytherins mockingly sing 'Weasley Is Our King' to rattle Ron before and during matches.

questions.question_text: According to the strict letter of Quidditch's rules, which position is actually barred from ever touching the Quaffle?
questions.correct_answer: None; every position is technically allowed to touch the Quaffle
distractors: The Keeper, once a goal attempt begins
questions.explanation: There is no rule preventing any player, including the Seeker, from handling the Quaffle, though it rarely happens in practice.

questions.question_text: Which Ravenclaw Quidditch player also serves as Fleur Delacour's Yule Ball escort and later captains his house team in matches against Gryffindor?
questions.explanation: Roger Davies plays Chaser and captains Ravenclaw, in addition to attending the Yule Ball with Fleur.

questions.question_text: Which Prisoner of Azkaban match does Harry lose control of his broom in and fall, thanks to Dementors invading the pitch?
questions.explanation: The Dementor-disrupted match is against Hufflepuff, with Cedric Diggory catching the Snitch as Harry falls.

questions.question_text: Besides losing his broomstick to the Whomping Willow, what does Harry lose consciousness from during the Dementor-disrupted Prisoner of Azkaban match?
questions.correct_answer: The overwhelming effect of the Dementors' presence, causing him to faint mid-air
distractors: A Bludger strike to the head
A hex cast by Draco Malfoy
questions.explanation: The Dementors' aura is so powerful that Harry faints and falls from a great height.

questions.question_text: How many total professional teams make up the British and Irish Quidditch League, according to Quidditch Through the Ages?
questions.explanation: The British and Irish Quidditch League famously features thirteen teams, including the Chudley Cannons and Puddlemere United.

questions.question_text: What is the final score of the Quidditch World Cup final in Goblet of Fire, once Krum catches the Snitch for Bulgaria?
questions.explanation: Ireland's early lead from their Chasers is enough to win even after Krum's catch adds 150 points for Bulgaria.

questions.question_text: What are the surnames of Ireland's three Chasers at the 1994 Quidditch World Cup, praised for their perfectly synchronized attacking play?
questions.explanation: Ireland's trio of Chasers is renowned for their seamless coordination during the World Cup final.

questions.question_text: What is unusual about how the golden egg from the first Triwizard task reveals its clue, compared to how it sounds in open air?
questions.correct_answer: It wails horribly in air but sings an intelligible song underwater
distractors: It is silent unless touched by a champion's own wand
It only opens exactly at midnight
It shows a moving image instead of making any sound
questions.explanation: The egg shrieks unpleasantly above water, and champions must work out that it must be opened underwater instead.

questions.question_text: What formal role does the Golden Snitch's catch traditionally end, no matter the current score?
distractors: The current team's turn with the Quaffle
questions.explanation: Catching the Snitch always concludes the match immediately, regardless of the score at that point.

questions.question_text: What is the name of the spectacular fireworks product Fred and George Weasley set off during their dramatic departure from Hogwarts in Order of the Phoenix?
questions.explanation: The twins' own fireworks line, Wildfire Whiz-Bangs, provides a fittingly explosive send-off.

questions.question_text: What shape do the giant fireworks take as they chase Dolores Umbridge through the halls of Hogwarts?
questions.explanation: One of the twins' fireworks forms an enormous fire-breathing dragon that pursues Umbridge through the corridors.

questions.question_text: Under which official Hogwarts role does Dolores Umbridge claim the authority to ban Harry, Fred, and George from Quidditch for life?
distractors: Her position as Minister for Magic
Her position as Head of Slytherin House
questions.explanation: Umbridge wields her High Inquisitor powers, not any headship, to hand down the lifetime ban.

questions.question_text: Which broom, given to Harry the following school year, outclasses the fleet of Nimbus 2001s that Lucius Malfoy buys for the Slytherin team?
questions.explanation: The Firebolt, which Harry receives in his third year, is faster than the Nimbus 2001s Slytherin flies in his second.
questions.source_ref: Chamber of Secrets / Prisoner of Azkaban

questions.question_text: How do the Durmstrang students dramatically arrive at Hogwarts for the Triwizard Tournament?
questions.correct_answer: Their ship rises up out of the lake
distractors: They fly in on a fleet of broomsticks
They arrive by a fleet of flying carriages
They walk through a hidden tunnel from Hogsmeade
questions.explanation: The Durmstrang delegation makes a striking entrance as their ship surfaces from the depths of the lake.

questions.question_text: What breed of giant winged horses pulls the Beauxbatons carriage to Hogwarts for the Triwizard Tournament?
questions.explanation: The Beauxbatons carriage is drawn by a team of enormous palomino Abraxan horses.

questions.question_text: Which two schools field the other Triwizard champions alongside Hogwarts, one attended by star Seeker Viktor Krum and the other by part-Veela Fleur Delacour?
questions.explanation: Krum represents Durmstrang while Fleur represents Beauxbatons in the Triwizard Tournament.

questions.question_text: Which two broom models are explicitly established as faster than Harry's original Nimbus 2000?
distractors: The Cleansweep Eleven and the Comet 260
The Shooting Star and the Twigger 90
The Silver Arrow and the Moontrimmer
questions.explanation: Both the Nimbus 2001, bought for Slytherin, and Harry's later Firebolt outpace the original Nimbus 2000.
questions.source_ref: Chamber of Secrets / Prisoner of Azkaban

questions.question_text: Which of the following is NOT a real professional Quidditch team mentioned anywhere in the books?
questions.explanation: The Appleby Arrows and the Chudley Cannons are both real teams in the books, but 'the Appleby Cannons' conflates the two and doesn't exist.

questions.question_text: Which of the following is NOT a real broomstick model mentioned anywhere in the books?
questions.explanation: Only the Nimbus 2000 and 2001 exist in the books; no 'Nimbus 3000' is ever mentioned.

questions.question_text: Which of the following is NOT an actual Quidditch rule referenced across the books?
questions.correct_answer: Players may not fly above the height of the goal hoops
distractors: No substitutions are allowed once a match has started
A foul earns the other team a free shot at goal
Every hoop is worth the same ten points regardless of height
questions.explanation: There is no height restriction on play in Quidditch; the other three statements are all genuine rules referenced in the books.

questions.question_text: How is a champion's placement in the Triwizard Tournament actually decided, given that Harry sometimes finishes tasks after his rivals?
questions.correct_answer: By points awarded from five judges, up to ten each, rather than simply finishing order
distractors: By a popular vote among the students
By whichever champion collects the most golden eggs
questions.explanation: Judges score each task's performance out of ten, meaning a slower but more skillful performance can still score well.

questions.question_text: Which two of the three Triwizard tasks are explicitly scored by the panel of judges out of ten points each, unlike the final task?
questions.correct_answer: The first task (the dragons) and the second task (the lake)
distractors: The second task and the third task (the maze)
All three tasks, including the maze
questions.explanation: The dragon and lake tasks receive judged marks out of ten, while the maze is instead decided by whoever reaches the Cup first.

questions.question_text: Under which pen name did J.K. Rowling write the real-world companion book 'Quidditch Through the Ages'?
questions.explanation: Rowling published Quidditch Through the Ages under the in-universe author name Kennilworthy Whisp.

questions.question_text: What are the first two named broomsticks Harry is personally given across the series, apart from any school brooms?
distractors: The Cleansweep Eleven and the Nimbus 2000
questions.explanation: Harry receives a Nimbus 2000 in his first year and a Firebolt anonymously in his third.

questions.question_text: Which of the following is NOT one of the five judges who score the Triwizard Tournament's tasks in Goblet of Fire?
questions.explanation: The judging panel is made up of Dumbledore, Karkaroff, Madame Maxime, Bagman, and Crouch — not Fudge.

questions.question_text: After Fred and George Weasley leave Hogwarts early in Order of the Phoenix, which two hastily-recruited students become Gryffindor's new Beaters for the rest of the season?
questions.explanation: Kirke and Sloper are pressed into service as Beaters, though neither proves especially skilled.

questions.question_text: Which clumsy substitute Beater manages to knock himself unconscious with his own bat during a Gryffindor practice in Order of the Phoenix?
questions.explanation: Sloper's poor aim leads him to strike himself rather than a Bludger, injuring himself instead of an opponent.

questions.question_text: Which two players, chosen as Gryffindor reserves during Order of the Phoenix tryouts, quit the team almost immediately due to scheduling conflicts?
questions.explanation: Frobisher and Hooper are picked as reserves but drop out almost right away over conflicting commitments.

questions.question_text: Which two Slytherin Beaters do Crabbe and Goyle effectively replace once Draco Malfoy becomes team captain in Order of the Phoenix?
questions.explanation: Derrick and Bole had been Slytherin's Beaters in earlier years before Crabbe and Goyle took over the role.

questions.question_text: Who becomes Slytherin's new Quidditch captain in Half-Blood Prince, after Draco Malfoy stops playing to pursue other goals?
questions.explanation: With Draco preoccupied elsewhere, Urquhart takes over as Slytherin's Quidditch captain.

questions.question_text: Which Golden Snitch does Dumbledore leave Harry in his will, and what secret object is later found hidden inside it?
questions.correct_answer: The Snitch from Harry's first Hogwarts match, hiding the Resurrection Stone
distractors: A World Cup souvenir Snitch, hiding a Portkey
A Ministry-issued Snitch, hiding a memory vial
A Triwizard Snitch, hiding a map of Hogwarts
questions.explanation: The very first Snitch Harry ever caught turns out to contain one of the three Deathly Hallows.

questions.question_text: The engraved words on Dumbledore's bequeathed Snitch read "I open at the close" — but what specific words actually cause it to open?
questions.explanation: The engraving is a riddle; Harry only unlocks the Snitch by accepting, aloud, that he is about to die.

questions.question_text: Why does the Golden Snitch bequeathed to Harry refuse to open for anyone else who tries, such as Hermione or Ron?
questions.correct_answer: Because Snitches bond via flesh memory to the first person who ever touched them bare-handed
distractors: Because it was sealed with the Fidelius Charm
Because only a Seeker's wand can unlock it
Because it responds only to Gryffindor blood
questions.explanation: Hermione deduces that a Snitch remembers whoever first touched it without gloves, which was Harry himself.

questions.question_text: Which Weasley brother's graduation, according to a running lament from Oliver Wood, marked the last Gryffindor Quidditch Cup win before the team's victory at the end of Prisoner of Azkaban?
questions.explanation: Wood repeatedly notes that Gryffindor hasn't won since Charlie Weasley, a former Seeker, left school.

questions.question_text: Which opposing team does Gryffindor defeat to reclaim the Quidditch Cup at the end of Prisoner of Azkaban, thanks to Harry's newly-returned Firebolt?
questions.explanation: Gryffindor's rescheduled match against Ravenclaw, delayed after the Dementor incident, becomes the decisive Cup-winning game.

questions.question_text: In Half-Blood Prince, what mistake by Cormac McLaggen while substituting at Keeper directly causes Gryffindor to lose a match?
questions.correct_answer: He swings a Beater's bat and accidentally knocks Harry unconscious mid-match
distractors: He lets in an easy goal in the final seconds
He accidentally passes the Quaffle to Slytherin
He flies into the Whomping Willow
questions.explanation: McLaggen's overeager attempt to coach the Beaters ends with him striking Harry with a bat, costing Gryffindor the win.

questions.question_text: Which charm does Hermione secretly use on Cormac McLaggen during Half-Blood Prince Quidditch tryouts, later admitted only to Harry?
questions.explanation: Hermione confesses she Confunded McLaggen so he'd fly the wrong way, letting Ron win the Keeper spot fairly in appearance.

questions.question_text: Which three new Gryffindor players fill the Chaser and Beater vacancies left by Angelina Johnson, Alicia Spinnet, Fred, and George in Half-Blood Prince?
questions.correct_answer: Demelza Robins, Jimmy Peakes, and Ritchie Coote
distractors: Vicky Frobisher, Geoffrey Hooper, and Andrew Kirke
Katie Bell, Colin Creevey, and Dennis Creevey
Luna Lovegood, Ginny Weasley, and Dean Thomas
questions.explanation: Harry rebuilds his team around these three newcomers after so many departures.

questions.question_text: Against which house does Gryffindor play its Cup-deciding final match in Half-Blood Prince, a match Harry misses due to a detention with Snape?
questions.explanation: Ginny, filling in as Seeker, catches the Snitch against Ravenclaw to win the Cup while Harry serves detention.

questions.question_text: Whose lifetime Quidditch ban, imposed by Umbridge after a fight with Malfoy, is eventually overturned once she loses her authority as Headmistress?
questions.explanation: Professor McGonagall lifts the unjust bans once Umbridge is removed from power at Hogwarts.

questions.question_text: During Harry's first Quidditch match, Hermione sets a professor's robes on fire believing he is jinxing Harry's broom — but who is the real culprit, and what is the mistakenly-blamed professor actually doing?
questions.correct_answer: Quirrell is cursing the broom, while Snape (wrongly blamed) is casting a counter-curse
distractors: Snape is cursing the broom, while Quirrell is casting a counter-curse
Filch is cursing the broom, while Snape is casting a counter-curse
Quirrell is cursing the broom, while Flitwick is casting a counter-curse
questions.explanation: The true jinx comes from Quirrell, while Snape, the one Hermione blames, is actually trying to save Harry.

questions.question_text: Which Hufflepuff Chaser and later Dumbledore's Army member is portrayed as notably self-important, even irritating his own Quidditch teammates?
questions.explanation: Zacharias Smith's arrogance carries over from Quidditch into his behavior within Dumbledore's Army.

questions.question_text: Which dragon does Harry draw for the Triwizard Tournament's first task, and how does this draw also determine his position in the running order?
questions.correct_answer: The Hungarian Horntail, meaning Harry competes last
distractors: The Chinese Fireball, meaning Harry competes first
The Swedish Short-Snout, meaning Harry competes second
The Common Welsh Green, meaning Harry competes third
questions.explanation: As the fiercest of the four dragons, the Horntail is saved for last, and drawing it means Harry goes last.

questions.question_text: Which character commentates both the 1994 Quidditch World Cup final and the tasks of the Triwizard Tournament that same school year?
questions.explanation: Bagman's Ministry role as head of Magical Games and Sports has him commentating both marquee sporting events.

questions.question_text: What is the actual final score of the Quidditch World Cup final, given that Bulgaria's Seeker catches the Snitch but Bulgaria still loses?
questions.correct_answer: 170 points to Ireland, 160 points to Bulgaria
distractors: 160 points to Ireland, 150 points to Bulgaria
200 points to Ireland, 150 points to Bulgaria
150 points to Ireland, 140 points to Bulgaria
questions.explanation: Ireland's Chasers score enough goals before the catch that Bulgaria's 150-point Snitch catch isn't enough to win.

questions.question_text: Which three Irish Chasers earn praise for their tightly coordinated play at the 1994 World Cup, appearing by surname in Rowling's account of the match?
questions.explanation: The trio of Irish Chasers move so seamlessly that commentators liken them to a single player split into three.

questions.question_text: In what specific order does Madam Hooch release the Quidditch balls before a match actually begins with her whistle?
questions.correct_answer: The Snitch, then the two Bludgers, and finally the Quaffle, which she throws to start play
distractors: The Quaffle first, followed by the Bludgers, and the Snitch last
All four balls simultaneously, followed by the whistle
The Bludgers first, then the Quaffle, then the Snitch
questions.explanation: The Snitch and Bludgers are let loose ahead of time, with the thrown Quaffle marking the true start of play.

questions.question_text: Which Slytherin captain is the subject of a long-running fan observation that he seems impossibly old for a student, having apparently been held back several years?
questions.explanation: Marcus Flint's apparent age relative to his supposed year has long been a point of fan debate.

questions.question_text: According to a strict reading of Quidditch's rules, is any playing position actually forbidden from touching the Quaffle during a match?
questions.correct_answer: No — even the Seeker is technically permitted to touch the Quaffle
distractors: Yes, the Seeker is barred from touching it
Yes, the Keeper may not touch it outside the goal area
Yes, Beaters are barred from touching it
questions.explanation: No rule bars any position from handling the Quaffle, though in practice only Chasers and occasionally the Keeper do so.

questions.question_text: Which two departing Chasers' spots, alongside two vacated Beater spots, does Harry fill using Demelza Robins, Jimmy Peakes, and Ritchie Coote in Half-Blood Prince?
questions.correct_answer: Angelina Johnson and Alicia Spinnet's Chaser spots, and Fred and George's Beater spots
distractors: Katie Bell and Ginny Weasley's Chaser spots, and Andrew Kirke and Jack Sloper's Beater spots
Cho Chang and Roger Davies's spots on a rival team
Oliver Wood and Cormac McLaggen's Keeper spots
questions.explanation: With Angelina, Alicia, Fred, and George all gone, Harry recruits three newcomers to rebuild the squad.

questions.question_text: During the tense Slytherin-Gryffindor match that gets Harry, Fred, and George banned for life, what specifically triggers the on-pitch fight?
questions.correct_answer: Draco Malfoy insults Harry's parents after the match
distractors: Crabbe hits Harry with an illegal Bludger shot
Umbridge orders the fight to begin
questions.explanation: It's Malfoy's cruel remark about Harry's parents that provokes Harry, Fred, and George to attack him after the match ends.

questions.question_text: By what margin must Gryffindor beat Ravenclaw in their final Order of the Phoenix match to win the Quidditch Cup outright, given their earlier loss to Slytherin?
questions.explanation: Because Gryffindor lost heavily to Slytherin while Harry was banned, they need a lopsided win over Ravenclaw for the Cup.

questions.question_text: Which Gryffindor player fills in at Seeker for part of Order of the Phoenix, only to later settle into a Chaser role for most of Half-Blood Prince?
questions.explanation: Ginny plays Seeker during Harry's ban in Order of the Phoenix, then becomes a regular Chaser once Harry returns to the position.
questions.source_ref: Order of the Phoenix / Half-Blood Prince

questions.question_text: Which Ministry official's professional Beater career for the Wimbourne Wasps connects him to both the Quidditch World Cup broadcast and, years later, a Ministry gold-related scandal involving the Weasley twins?
questions.explanation: Bagman, a former Wasps Beater, commentates the World Cup and later pays a debt to the twins in unstable leprechaun gold.

questions.question_text: What potion must Harry drink overnight to regrow the bones lost from his arm after Lockhart's botched healing spell, a treatment famous for being agonizing?
questions.explanation: Skele-Gro regrows bones but is notorious among students for how painful the process is.

questions.question_text: How does the injury Harry suffers from a bewitched Bludger in Chamber of Secrets ultimately get worse rather than better?
questions.correct_answer: Professor Lockhart's spell removes all the bones from his arm instead of mending it
distractors: Madam Pomfrey misdiagnoses it as a sprain
Snape's counter-curse shatters the bone further
The Bludger strikes the same arm a second time
questions.explanation: Lockhart's incompetent charm leaves Harry's arm completely boneless, requiring a night of Skele-Gro to fix.

questions.question_text: Which house-elf is responsible for bewitching a Bludger to relentlessly target Harry during a Chamber of Secrets match, hoping to injure him enough to send him home?
questions.explanation: Dobby rigs the Bludger, believing an injury will keep Harry safely away from Hogwarts.

questions.question_text: Which two Gryffindor Chasers were on the team alongside Angelina Johnson before both graduated at the end of Order of the Phoenix?
questions.explanation: Katie Bell continues into Half-Blood Prince, while Alicia Spinnet graduates alongside Angelina.

questions.question_text: What happens to the World Cup Top Box tickets that allow Harry and the Weasleys to watch the 1994 final in prime seats?
questions.correct_answer: Ludo Bagman provides them, repaying a favor connected to a bet with Arthur Weasley
distractors: Percy Weasley wins them in a Ministry raffle
Dumbledore arranges them as a school prize
Amos Diggory buys them for the group
questions.explanation: Bagman secures the family's excellent seats as part of settling up over a wager with Mr. Weasley.

questions.question_text: Which two Quidditch positions did Charlie Weasley reportedly excel at during his own time on the Gryffindor team, before choosing dragons over a professional career?
questions.correct_answer: He was Seeker and team captain
distractors: He was Keeper and team captain
He was a Chaser and Beater
He was a Beater and team captain
questions.explanation: Charlie's talent as Seeker and captain was such that he might have played for England.

questions.question_text: How many total teams make up the professional British and Irish Quidditch League that the Chudley Cannons and Puddlemere United both belong to?
questions.explanation: Quidditch Through the Ages establishes thirteen teams in the British and Irish League.

questions.question_text: Which two Quidditch-playing characters both serve as Ravenclaw's Seeker and, separately, Chaser and captain, during Harry's years at Hogwarts?
questions.correct_answer: Cho Chang (Seeker) and Roger Davies (Chaser and captain)
questions.explanation: Cho Chang seeks for Ravenclaw while Roger Davies both plays Chaser and captains the team.

questions.question_text: What connects the Golden Snitch given to Harry in Dumbledore's will to the very first Quidditch match Harry ever played?
questions.correct_answer: It is the exact Snitch Harry caught in his mouth during that match
distractors: It is a replica Dumbledore commissioned afterward
It once belonged to Harry's father, James
It was the Snitch used in Harry's final Hogwarts match
questions.explanation: Dumbledore had kept the actual Snitch Harry first caught, later leaving it to him with the Resurrection Stone inside.

questions.question_text: Which two Gryffindor Beaters were on the team throughout Harry's early years, before both graduating early partway through Order of the Phoenix?
questions.explanation: Fred and George serve as Gryffindor's Beaters for years before leaving school before their final exams.

questions.question_text: Why does Cedric Diggory feel little pride in defeating Gryffindor during the Dementor-disrupted Prisoner of Azkaban match?
questions.correct_answer: Because he feels he won unfairly, since Harry only fell due to the Dementors and not fair play
distractors: Because he was later found to have fouled Harry
Because Hufflepuff still lost the House Cup that year
Because Madam Hooch nearly disqualified the win
questions.explanation: Cedric even offers Gryffindor a rematch, feeling the circumstances of his win were unfair to Harry.

questions.question_text: Which two Weasley twins' Ministry-funded joke shop success traces back partly to the unstable leprechaun gold Ludo Bagman used to pay a Quidditch-related bet?
questions.explanation: The vanishing leprechaun gold from Bagman's bet is an early, frustrating setback for the twins' business ambitions.

questions.question_text: What is the actual mechanism by which the Golden Snitch tests Harry's identity before it will open, according to Hermione's explanation in Deathly Hallows?
questions.correct_answer: It recognizes the flesh of whoever first touched it bare-handed
distractors: It reads the intent behind the words spoken to it
It responds only to a Gryffindor's Patronus
It requires the caster's blood to be smeared on it
questions.explanation: Hermione explains that Snitches are enchanted to remember their first bare-handed toucher, which lets them recognize that person later.

questions.question_text: Which two matches make up the pair of Prisoner of Azkaban games most remembered for weather and supernatural disruption, respectively?
questions.correct_answer: The storm-soaked match against Hufflepuff, and the Dementor-disrupted match, also against Hufflepuff
distractors: The storm-soaked match against Ravenclaw, and the Dementor-disrupted match against Slytherin
The rainy match against Slytherin, and the Dementor match against Ravenclaw
Both disrupted matches are against Slytherin
questions.explanation: Gryffindor's early-season match against Hufflepuff is played in a storm, and the rescheduled Dementor-disrupted match is against the same team.

questions.question_text: How does Gryffindor's loss to Slytherin, played without a banned Harry, factor into the Quidditch Cup math at the end of Order of the Phoenix?
questions.correct_answer: It forces Gryffindor to beat Ravenclaw by more than 200 points to win the Cup outright
distractors: It knocks Gryffindor out of Cup contention entirely
It means Gryffindor only needs to draw their final match
It is offset automatically by Umbridge's ban being overturned
questions.explanation: The heavy loss to Slytherin means only a lopsided win over Ravenclaw can secure the Cup for Gryffindor.

questions.question_text: Which character both plays Beater professionally for the Wimbourne Wasps and later heads the Ministry department responsible for organizing the Quidditch World Cup?
questions.explanation: Bagman's playing career as a Wasps Beater precedes his Ministry role overseeing magical games and sports.

questions.question_text: What is notable about the timing of Gryffindor's Quidditch Cup win in Prisoner of Azkaban, relative to Harry's broom troubles that same year?
questions.correct_answer: Harry wins the deciding match with a brand-new Firebolt, replacing the Nimbus 2000 destroyed earlier that season
distractors: Harry wins the deciding match on a borrowed school broom
Harry sits out the deciding match due to injury
Harry wins the deciding match despite still lacking a broom
questions.explanation: Harry's Nimbus 2000 is destroyed by the Whomping Willow, but his newly-returned Firebolt carries Gryffindor to the Cup.

questions.question_text: Which two Slytherin players are added to the team specifically because Draco Malfoy, as captain, favors them over more skilled options?
questions.explanation: Draco stacks the team with his friends Crabbe and Goyle as Beaters once he gains control as captain.

questions.question_text: What single piece of information, revealed only well after Ron's tryout victory, casts doubt on whether Ron truly beat Cormac McLaggen fairly for the Keeper position?
questions.correct_answer: Hermione secretly Confunded McLaggen during the tryout
distractors: Ron secretly bribed Katie Bell to vouch for him
McLaggen was disqualified for arriving late
Harry rigged the tryout in Ron's favor
questions.explanation: Hermione's confession that she Confunded McLaggen reveals Ron's win wasn't entirely on merit.

questions.question_text: Which four departures — two graduating Chasers and two early-leaving Beaters — force Harry to overhaul the Gryffindor Quidditch roster as captain in Half-Blood Prince?
questions.correct_answer: Angelina Johnson, Alicia Spinnet, Fred Weasley, and George Weasley
distractors: Katie Bell, Ginny Weasley, Ron Weasley, and Oliver Wood
Cho Chang, Roger Davies, Cedric Diggory, and Zacharias Smith
Demelza Robins, Jimmy Peakes, Ritchie Coote, and Andrew Kirke
questions.explanation: With Angelina and Alicia graduating and the twins gone, Harry must recruit three replacements.

questions.question_text: What ultimately proves ironic about Umbridge's lifetime ban on Harry, Fred, and George from Quidditch?
questions.correct_answer: It is overturned well before any of the three would have otherwise stopped playing, once Umbridge loses her authority
distractors: None of the three ever wanted to play Quidditch again anyway
It was accidentally applied to the wrong students at first
It was reversed by Cornelius Fudge personally
questions.explanation: The supposedly permanent ban ends up lasting only until Umbridge's fall from power at Hogwarts.

questions.question_text: Besides playing Beater for the Wimbourne Wasps, what international honor does Ludo Bagman hold from his playing days?
questions.correct_answer: He was capped for the England national Quidditch team
distractors: He captained the Irish national team
He played in three World Cups as a Seeker
He was never capped internationally, only played locally
questions.explanation: Bagman's playing career included international caps for England, adding to his celebrity as a retired star.

questions.question_text: Which real-world charity benefits from sales of the companion books 'Quidditch Through the Ages' and 'Fantastic Beasts and Where to Find Them'?
questions.explanation: Both slim companion volumes were published by J.K. Rowling in aid of Comic Relief.

questions.question_text: How is Ludo Bagman's commentary made audible to the entire crowd at the Quidditch World Cup final?
questions.correct_answer: His voice is magically magnified, amplified by a charm
distractors: Loudspeakers are set up around the stadium
Multiple wizards relay his words to the back rows
questions.explanation: Bagman's voice booms out over the whole stadium thanks to a magical amplification charm.

questions.question_text: What is the title of the Goblet of Fire chapter that covers the Quidditch World Cup final match itself?
questions.explanation: The match itself is recounted in the chapter titled 'The Quidditch World Cup.'

questions.question_text: What two colors make up the giant shamrock formation the leprechauns create in the sky above the Quidditch World Cup pitch?
questions.explanation: The leprechauns' aerial shamrock display shines green and gold before showering the crowd with gold coins.

questions.question_text: Which Ministry office does Arthur Weasley work for, tangentially connecting him to the boot Portkey arranged for his family's trip to the World Cup?
questions.correct_answer: The Misuse of Muggle Artifacts Office
distractors: The Department of Magical Games and Sports
The Department of International Magical Cooperation
The Improper Use of Magic Office
questions.explanation: Arthur's day job dealing with enchanted Muggle objects sits at an ironic remove from the sporting spectacle his Portkey ride leads to.

questions.question_text: Which Educational Decree establishes Dolores Umbridge's position as Hogwarts High Inquisitor, the authority she later invokes to ban students from Quidditch for life?
questions.explanation: The decree creating the High Inquisitor post is what Umbridge later leans on to hand down her lifetime Quidditch ban.

questions.question_text: Which charm is used to clean up dirt, stains, or mess with a single word?
questions.explanation: Scourgify is the standard Cleaning Charm, used for scrubbing away grime (and threatened by Mrs. Weasley on her sons' mouths).

questions.question_text: Which spell siphons a liquid, such as ink or blood, off a surface rather than simply cleaning it?
questions.explanation: Tergeo draws a substance away, notably used by Snape to clean blood from Malfoy after the Sectumsempra incident.

questions.question_text: Which spell makes an object disappear completely, rather than merely hiding it?
questions.explanation: Evanesco is the Vanishing Spell, used to make objects vanish entirely, as practiced in Transfiguration class.

questions.question_text: Which charm conjures a jet of water straight from the tip of a wand?
questions.explanation: Aguamenti, the Water-Making Spell, produces a stream of water and is used to douse fires during the Battle of Hogwarts.

questions.question_text: Which spell was used on the flying keys guarding the Philosopher's Stone to stop one particular key from moving?
questions.explanation: Immobulus is the Freezing Charm, used to root a moving target in place; Hermione uses it to freeze the correct flying key.

questions.question_text: Which curse causes a violent, explosive blast capable of blowing objects apart?
questions.explanation: Bombarda is a blasting curse used to create explosions, including to blast open doors and walls during the Battle of Hogwarts.

questions.question_text: Which curse, known as the Reductor Curse, is used to blast solid objects into pieces?
questions.explanation: Reducto smashes solid objects apart and is used repeatedly during battles at the Ministry of Magic and Hogwarts.

questions.question_text: Which spell propels the caster rapidly upward, used by Harry to shoot out of the lake during the Second Task?
questions.explanation: Ascendio launches the caster upward through water or air; Harry and others use it to surface quickly in the Second Task.

questions.question_text: What phrase activates the Marauder's Map, revealing its hidden contents?
questions.correct_answer: I solemnly swear that I am up to no good
distractors: I solemnly swear I mean no harm
questions.explanation: Speaking this phrase to the blank parchment causes the Marauder's Map to appear.

questions.question_text: What phrase clears the Marauder's Map and makes it appear blank again?
distractors: I solemnly swear that I am up to no good
questions.explanation: Saying "Mischief managed" wipes the map clean until it is activated again.

questions.question_text: What incantation turns an ordinary object into a Portkey?
questions.explanation: Portus is the spell used to charm an object into a Portkey that transports anyone touching it to a set destination.

questions.question_text: What method of wizarding travel involves throwing powder into a lit fireplace and stepping through it?
questions.explanation: Floo powder lets witches and wizards travel between connected fireplaces; Harry famously mispronounces his destination and ends up in Knockturn Alley.

questions.question_text: According to Mr. Ollivander, which of the following best describes how a wand is matched to its owner?
distractors: Wands are assigned randomly by the Ministry
Only pure-blood wizards can choose their own wand
questions.explanation: Ollivander famously tells Harry that it is the wand that chooses the wizard, not the other way around.

questions.question_text: What wood and core make up Harry Potter's own wand?
questions.correct_answer: Holly wood with a phoenix feather core
distractors: Yew wood with a phoenix feather core
Holly wood with a dragon heartstring core
Vine wood with a unicorn hair core
questions.explanation: Harry's wand is eleven inches, made of holly with a phoenix feather core, as Ollivander determines in his first year.

questions.question_text: What color is the flash of light produced by the Killing Curse?
questions.explanation: Avada Kedavra produces a distinctive blast of green light, described repeatedly throughout the series.

questions.question_text: What color light does the Stunning Spell, Stupefy, typically produce?
questions.explanation: Stupefy fires a jet of red light at its target, rendering them unconscious.

questions.question_text: What is the very first Transfiguration exercise Professor McGonagall assigns her first-year students?
questions.correct_answer: Turning a matchstick into a needle
distractors: Turning a teacup into a mouse
Turning a beetle into a button
Turning a feather into a bird
questions.explanation: First-years practice basic Transfiguration by attempting to turn a matchstick into a needle.

questions.question_text: Which potion allows the drinker to temporarily assume the exact appearance of another person?
questions.explanation: Polyjuice Potion transforms the drinker into a physical copy of someone else; Harry, Ron, and Hermione use it to sneak into Slytherin's common room.

questions.question_text: What must be added to Polyjuice Potion for the drinker to transform into a specific person?
questions.correct_answer: A physical part of that person, such as a hair
distractors: A drop of that person's blood only
A lock of that person's clothing
questions.explanation: Polyjuice Potion requires a piece of the person to be copied, commonly a strand of hair, stirred into the brew.

questions.question_text: Which potion, when swallowed, compels the drinker to answer questions truthfully?
questions.explanation: Veritaserum is a powerful truth potion; Barty Crouch Jr. is forced to drink it and confess under its effects.

questions.question_text: Which potion is famously described as the most powerful love potion in existence?
questions.explanation: Amortentia creates a powerful infatuation in the drinker and is demonstrated in Slughorn's Potions class.

questions.question_text: Which potion is nicknamed "liquid luck" and grants the drinker good fortune for a set period?
questions.explanation: Felix Felicis grants temporary good luck; Harry wins a dose from Slughorn and later uses it to obtain a crucial memory.

questions.question_text: What is the term for the magical injury that occurs when a wizard leaves part of their body behind during a botched Apparition?
